data.jd_text:
**Contact** 
 : daniel.sherwood@forsythbarnes.com
 



  





 We are seeking an AI PMO Manager to design and shape enterprise AI and automation use cases across finance and wider business functions. The role focuses on identifying high\-value opportunities, defining solution approaches, and guiding build vs buy decisions to maximise ROI. It combines strong technical literacy with business transformation experience, acting as an architect for AI\-enabled change rather than a delivery coder or large\-scale programme owner.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Identify and prioritise AI, GenAI, ML, and automation opportunities across the enterprise
* Translate business problems into structured, high\-ROI use cases and delivery roadmaps
* Define solution approaches across AI agents, ML, GenAI, RPA, and supporting infrastructure
* Evaluate build vs buy options and advise on architecture and deployment models (cloud, hybrid, on\-prem)
* Assess full solution economics including model usage, token costs, infrastructure, and run costs
* Lead and shape proofs of concept and pilots, including success criteria and evaluation frameworks
* Support development of AI governance, risk, and adoption standards
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, technology, and finance to present options and recommendations



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Background in transformation, PMO, consulting, or programme delivery within complex organisations
* Strong understanding of AI, automation, ML, GenAI, and enterprise architecture concepts
* Able to assess technical solutions and infrastructure trade\-offs without being a hands\-on developer
* Strong commercial mindset with experience building ROI cases and evaluating technology costs
* Comfortable operating across business and technical stakeholders at senior level
* Analytical, structured, and execution\-focused with strong problem\-solving ability



  





  





 If this role would be of interest, apply today!

data.jd_text:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.
   

  

 Join us as our next
 **Head of Systems Strategy – Regulatory,** 
 reporting to our Global Head of Regulatory Compliance \& Digital Strategy. We are looking for an experienced Solution Lead with a track record in leading delivery of system\-by\-design solutions, and data lake design within the FMCG industry. You will combine your transformation expertise and leadership, systems capability knowledge and project management to lead complex, projects within the Fragrance \& Beauty systems ecosystem, leading our digital transformation strategy.
   

  

 You will be a bridge between Regulatory Affairs, Product Safety, IT, and Business and other departmental teams. You will lead cross\-functional collaboration from concept to delivery, promoting compliance innovation that enhances capability, speed, quality, and trust across our organisation, and to the benefit of our customers.
   

  

**Location** 
 NJ (USA), Dubai (U.A.E); Sau Paulo (Brazil); Europe, Singapore or Shanghai (China) \- (Fragrance \& Beauty).
   

  

**In this exciting role you will**
* Lead multiple regulatory compliance system design projects, from concept to delivery, aligned with Givaudan's multi\-year digital transformation programme.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design scope, testing and validation of solutions, and driving overall project goals.
* Partner with multiple cross functional stakeholders, combining programme leadership, stakeholder engagement, and strategic foresight.
* Stakeholder \& Team Coordination Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (data scientists, developers, business analysts) and translate complex Technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure regulatory understanding of modern cloud, data, and product architectures.
* Promote delivery practices across the project portfolio, with emphasis on value delivery, risk management, and continuous improvement.
* Champion data model integrity, compliance by\-system\-design, and intellectual proprietary privacy in all compliance related data and processes.
* Manage timelines, dependencies, and risks, supported by KPI and reporting mechanisms \- ensuring project progress transparency, accountability and on\-time deliverables are met.
* Troubleshoot technical roadblocks and manage risks.
* Foster a culture of proactive compliance, continuous improvement, and dynamic, scalable controls.
* Define and validate regulatory data models within S/4HANA architecture.
* Ensure regulatory processes are embedded within S/4 standard and extended capabilities.


**Required Qualifications**
* University Degree in Data Science, Compliance Management, IT or a related discipline. Understanding of machine learning, AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), and data pipelines.
* 10\+ years in Digital Transformation Leadership, which could include SAP\-enabled Data Management, Regulatory Platform Design, Programme Management.
* Experience of Regulatory data or Compliance\-related projects within global, cross\-functional environments in the FMCG Industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience of interpreting and operationalising complex regulatory frameworks into system and design solutions is strongly preferred.
* Experience engaging diverse stakeholders.


**Additional Requirements**
* Experience in SAP ECC to S/4HANA transition project is preferred.


**What We Can Offer You**
* Healthcare Plan
* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Vacation days


 At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives. You work within an inspiring teamwork culture – where you can thrive, collaborate and learn from other talented and passionate people across disciplines, regions and divisions.
   

  

 Every essence of you enriches our world. Diversity drives innovation and creates closer connections with our employees, customers and partners. Givaudan embraces diversity and is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone impacts our world.

data.jd_text:
At Coface, we’ve been managing credit risk for more than 75 years to help companies navigate and grow in an uncertain and volatile environment.
   

  

 We act for trade.
   

  

 As a global leading player in trade credit risk management, we support the growth of 100,000 clients across some 200 markets.
   

  

 Whatever their size, location or sector, we offer companies a full range of solutions: Trade Credit Insurance, Business Information, Debt Collection, Single Risk insurance, Surety Bonds, Factoring.
   

  

 Every day, we leverage our unique expertise and cutting\-edge technology to make trade happen, in both domestic and export markets.
   

  

**Commitments**
**Diversity, equity, and inclusion**
 Coface is fully committed to creating a work atmosphere that respects the individualities and diversity of its teams. Given the nature of its business, which operates across a global scope, Coface must remain a multicultural company. To that end, employees must benefit from an inclusive and non\-discriminatory work environment. This allows for collaborative and fruitful work between teams representing 80 nationalities and working in 58 countries.
   

  

 Coface has been focusing in particular on gender equity and gender balance in career opportunities, and diversity in senior management roles. Coface has initiated numerous actions plans in that field, together with indicators for monitoring progress.
   

  

 Accordingly, diversity and inclusion are a key component of the Group Human Resources strategy. Coface work environment must be seen as inclusive and the company as a place where employees can thrive and contribute their authenticity to their professional activities.
   

  

 To that end, Coface has introduced training and awareness\-raising initiatives to encourage the transformation of the corporate culture towards greater openness to diversity.… more
   

  

**Career growth and learning**
 At Coface, we strive to establish and develop a lasting relationship of trust, encouraging integration, and supporting professional development; these are our priorities and commitments.
   

  

 We have a dedicated program called “Move \& Grow” to boost internal mobility. In fact, we believe in internal mobility as an accelerator of career growth, as much as a fantastic opportunity to learn and grow from a more personal standpoint. We encourage you to seize every opportunity to get out of your comfort zone, by changing jobs and taking on new responsibilities.
   

  

 In parallel, we have a program dedicated to new comers, which provides access to all the information necessary for integration and allows them to follow a path marked out by individual meetings, immersive experiences, training and informal sharing moments. Furthermore, in order to continually develop your individual talent, we have a digital training platform with a wide range of content which encourages the sharing of exchanges and experience between the group's employees. We also have mentoring programs and much more to support your career development.
   

  

**Description**
**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities \- Build\-up and manage transformation programs, according to the company's strategy ; \- Build\-up and manage process efficiency with the fronters, to reach better quality of service. \- Set up local governance for Projects portfolio management; \- Coordinate requirements collection and change management for tools enhancements/corrections requests ; \- Animate local committees to gather needs \& development requests ; \- Plan \& follow up the activities, motivate and inspire team to successfully complete tasks ; \- Build strong relationships, achieve buy\-in of key stakeholders and influence others ; \- Risk management: coordinate the issues to be solved and decisions to be taken ; \- Ensure key deliverables are met, the projects finishes on time and budget ; \- Apply continuous improvement in project methodology ; \- Report at different levels (tactical/operational/board of directors) with timely and effective communication on opportunities, wins, financial impacts, KPIs, and concerns ; \- Manage successful handoffs to business owners and project closing ; \- All this activities will be performed with the support of a regional PMO team in charge of the strategic projects portfolio (coordination of projects \& provide global vision and coherency between projects).
   

  

**Missions**
 In the framework of Operations department, we are looking for a Transformation \& Business Process Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for projects and change management. You will also support process mapping, gap analysis and actions plan to improve quality, efficiency and customers / partners satisfaction. The main contact points will be with Business all functions, IT, Marketing, control functions. Key the participation in international working group and steering committees. This position will be based in Dubai and will report directly to local Country Manager and functionally to MAR Chief Operations Officer. Transformation Office believes in creating an exciting work environment in which we can develop professional skills around leading change, inspiring teams and developing professional collaboration in an international environment. Team members from all backgrounds get together here to tackle complex strategic transformation projects. We believe in sharing knowledge and collaborating, because only if we can improve ourselves, we will be able to help Coface improve sustainably.
   

  

**Experiences**
 Job Experience
   

  

* Knowledge of Coface business
* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management or process management
* Knowledge of Coface products and processes is a plus


 Competencies
   

  

 Technical skills :
   

  

* Knowledge of project \& change management processes and tools (Waterfall, Agile Project Management tools)
* Ability to anticipate risks, and manage mitigation with key stakeholders
* Excellent level of English required
* Previous experience in LEAN / Processes mapping and improvement
* Easiness with data analysis and KPIs definition and monitoring


 Soft skills
   

  

* Process/IT Curiosity \& ability to find out of the box solutions ;
* Strong leadership capacity, ability to drive and positively influence the motivation and development of project teams, capacity to take responsibility, management of virtual teams
* Authenticity, collaboration and open communication
* Ability to facilitate project meetings, negotiate with business or technical players, know how to get things done through formal channels and informal networks, effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.
* Ability to adapt to frequent changes and contingencies, management of time pressure priorities
* Ability to set clear values, priorities and standards, strong orientation to results, eager for achievement
* Excellent abilities to communicate at all levels of the organization


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or similar
   

  

**Additional Information**
* A culture focused on teamwork, continuous learning, and professional development
* Competitive base salary \+ performance based bonus
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance

data.jd_text:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we'll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. Working at Jacobs offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
   

  

 People are Jacobs’ greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.
   

  

 Jacobs Advisory is seeking a senior
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 to play a pivotal role in the growth of our Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East.
   

  

 This is a leadership position for an experienced transformation professional who will both grow and shape an evolving regional capability and personally lead complex, high‑profile engagements for government and major private‑sector clients across the region.
   

  

 The role suits a leader with deep experience in public\-sector and infrastructure‑related transformation, someone who is comfortable operating at executive level, guiding large organisations through strategy, operating model redesign, and enterprise‑scale change, while building a strong, sustainable internal team around them.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 will
   

  

* Grow and shape Jacobs Advisory’s Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East
* Act as lead advisor and engagement head on major transformation assignments
* Partner with senior government and private‑sector leaders to define direction and deliver lasting organisational change
* Develop people, methods, and market presence to support long‑term regional growth


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Grow and Shape the Regional Strategy \& Transformation Capability
   

  

* Play a leading role in maturing and scaling an existing Strategy \& Transformation capability, strengthening its market positioning, depth, and impact across the Middle East.
* Shape service offerings, approaches, and intellectual property across areas such as
* Public‑sector and infrastructure strategy
* Target operating model design
* Organisational Restructuring and governance
* Transformation delivery and change management
* Mentor, develop, and retain senior and mid‑level consultants, building a high‑performing, trusted team.
* Work collaboratively across Jacobs Advisory and the wider Jacobs business, integrating strategy and transformation with technical, digital, and delivery capabilities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, market engagement, and strategic pursuits aligned to government and city‑scale transformation agendas.


 Lead Complex Client Engagements
   

  

* Act as lead engagement partner for major, complex assignments, particularly for government, municipal, infrastructure, and regulated‑sector clients.
* Personally lead strategy and transformation programme spanning
* Enterprise and sector strategies
* Target operating models and organisational design
* Service delivery improvement
* Capability, governance, and performance frameworks
* Large‑scale change and implementation oversight
* Engage directly with senior client stakeholders, including Director Generals, executives, board members, and senior officials.
* Facilitate executive‑level discussions, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and guide clients through ambiguity, change, and decision‑making.
* Ensure engagements deliver practical, implementable outcomes with clear impact.


 Support Market Growth and Client Relationships
   

  

* Build long‑term trusted relationships with senior clients across government and the private sector.
* Lead or support major pursuits, shaping compelling propositions that reflect Jacobs integrated advisory and delivery capabilities.
* Represent Jacobs Advisory confidently in high‑level client forums, industry events, and strategic discussions across the region.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

 You are a senior strategy and transformation leader with the presence, judgement, and experience to operate at the highest levels of client organisations while building strong internal teams.
   

  

 You will bring
   

  

* 20\+ years experience in strategy, transformation, or management consulting, with significant exposure to public‑sector, infrastructure, utilities, or regulated environments
* A strong track record leading large\-scale Strategy and Transformation Programmes , including enterprise or sector‑wide change across complex organisations.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing
* Target operating models
* Organizational and governance structures
* Performance and capability frameworks
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior executives and public‑sector leaders, acting as a trusted advisor rather than a technical specialist.
* Experience growing teams, mentoring senior professionals, and shaping advisory capabilities within a consulting or professional services environment.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills, with the credibility to operate confidently in complex,high‑profile client environments.


 A degree in a relevant discipline (such as strategy, engineering, management, public policy, or similar) is expected. Career progression, leadership capability, and delivery track record are considered more important than specific academic backgrounds.
   

  

 Jacobs. A world where you can.
   

  

 From our inclusive employee networks to our positive mental health champions – we are committed to driving a culture of caring where you can be you. Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally \- and together, our diverse perspectives and unique backgrounds power our collective strength. We collaborate and share! By supporting one another, we all succeed. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we have gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies

data.title: Director of Strategy & Operations
data.raw_snippet:
**About Moove**

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility wil
data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.

 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.

 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.

 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation.  If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- Amazon Middle East and North Africa FZ\-LLC

**About SUMWON STUDIOS** 




**SUMWON STUDIOS** 
 is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes

 and
 **KSTM.** 




  





 In just a few years, we have grown from start\-up to one of the fastest\-scaling brand platforms in the
 
 industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital\-first world.
 



  





 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.
 



  





 The primary purpose of this position is to act as a force multiplier for the CEO and leadership team, increasing the speed, quality and effectiveness of decision making and execution across the organisation.
 



  





 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered. You will lead transformation programmes, drive organisational effectiveness, champion AI and automation adoption, and take ownership of high\-impact strategic projects.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO.
* Independently lead major initiatives with minimal direction.



 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation
 


* Lead the identification, prioritisation and implementation of AI, automation and technology initiatives across the business.
* Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes and operating models using technology.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage.
* Establish a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.



 Organisational Effectiveness
 


* Drive company\-wide OKRs, governance and accountability frameworks.
* Improve decision\-making processes and organisational operating rhythms.
* Help ensure the business scales effectively as teams, brands and markets grow.
* Support leadership teams in defining structures, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Remove complexity and improve cross\-functional collaboration.



 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development
 


* Lead high\-priority projects on behalf of the CEO.
* Support acquisitions, partnerships, market expansion and new business initiatives.
* Coordinate due diligence, integration planning and execution activities.
* Develop business cases, strategic recommendations and implementation plans.



 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.
* Help align teams around business objectives and organisational change.
* Support investor, board, media and external stakeholder communications where required.
* Prepare executive presentations, board materials and strategic updates.



 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.
* Contribute to succession planning and future leadership development.



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience both advising businesses and operating within them.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Experience driving transformation, technology or AI initiatives is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environments.
* Highly organised with exceptional execution capabilities.



  





**What we'll bring** 



* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year
* 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Company social events
* The opportunity to work with a high\-performing team building brands at global scale



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi\-brand platform operating across global markets.

 The Business Unit Director – Oncology is responsible for leading the oncology and hematology portfolio across Gulf markets, driving sustainable growth and maximizing the value of current and future assets. **Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic leadership**
* Develop and execute the oncology and hematology business strategy across Gulf markets, aligned with global and regional priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities across the portfolio, including lifecycle management and new indications.
* Lead long\-range planning, forecasting and portfolio prioritization.


**P\&L ownership**
* Own and manage full profit and loss responsibility for the oncology business.
* Deliver revenue, profitability and market share targets across the region.
* Optimize resource allocation to maximize return on investment and ensure financial discipline.


**Sales and marketing leadership**
* Lead and integrate sales and marketing functions to drive execution excellence across diverse Gulf healthcare systems.
* Oversee brand strategy, campaign development and omnichannel customer engagement.
* Ensure strong field force effectiveness and customer\-centric engagement with healthcare professionals.


**Product launch excellence**
* Lead end\-to\-end launch planning and execution for new oncology and hematology assets in Gulf markets.
* Partner with global and regional teams to ensure successful localization of launch strategies.
* Drive rapid uptake and market penetration following launch, in line with compliance requirements.


**Cross\-functional collaboration**
* Partner closely with medical, regulatory, market access and supply chain teams.
* Ensure alignment across functions to deliver compliant and impactful business outcomes.
* Engage appropriate external stakeholders, such as healthcare institutions and relevant decision\-makers across the Gulf region, in line with GSK policies and local regulations.


**Team leadership and capability building**
* Build, lead and inspire a high\-performing, diverse team across multiple Gulf markets.
* Develop organizational capabilities in sales, marketing and leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, innovation and continuous improvement, aligned with GSK’s values and Code of Conduct.


**Key Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in a scientific or business discipline is strongly preferred.
* Extensive experience in oncology and/or hematology with a strong track record in these therapeutic areas.
* Deep scientific understanding of oncology, including disease biology, treatment paradigms and evolving clinical data.
* Proven ability to translate complex scientific insights into effective commercial strategies.
* Significant senior leadership experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial roles (sales and marketing).
* Demonstrated P\&L management experience with consistent delivery of business results.
* Strong track record of successful product launches and lifecycle management in oncology.
* Experience in Gulf markets is highly preferred, with strong understanding of local healthcare systems, market access dynamics and regulatory environments.
* Established knowledge of key stakeholders in the Gulf region (e.g. health authorities, payers and leading oncology centers) is a strong advantage.

* Strategic thinker with strong business and scientific acumen.
* Results\-oriented with a focus on execution excellence.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong people leadership with the ability to build and scale high\-performing teams in a multicultural environment.
* High ethical standards, integrity and a strong commitment to compliance and patient focus.

data.jd_text:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Vous pilotez, organisez, gérez et représentez l’Alliance française de Dubaï (AFD) et l’action culturelle française à Dubaï et dans les Emirats du Nord. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la mondialisation , le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'AFD dispose d'une médiathèque, une salle de cinéma/spectacle, une salle d’expositions, salles de classe. Dans ce cadre, vous devrez assurer les: \-élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l’établissement sur les plans culturel et pédagogique (programmation commune, dates d’examens, etc.). Poursuite de la diversification de l’offre de cours de langue impulsée depuis plusieurs années ; \- organisation d’événements annuels en collaboration avec les partenaires locaux ou sur fonds propres ; \- gestion des réseaux sociaux, \- développement de Culturethèque et du fonds de la médiathèque. Organisation d'événements internes. \- recherche de partenariats avec les entreprises françaises (BNP, Soc. Générale…) ou locales (émigration, douanes, municipalité, universités…) pour le développement des diplômes TCF (test de connaissance du français)/ TEF (test d'évaluation de français) et e.TEF/Delf Adulte, DELF junior et DELF Prim ; \- élaboration du budget prévisionnel de l'établissement, en accord avec le CA, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi, le budget concernant les pôles pédagogique, culturel et communication, administratif et médiathèque. \-établissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays comme avec les partenaires pédagogiques (directeurs d’établissements, départements universitaires notamment); \-Préparation et remise de rapports réguliers d’activité et compte\-rendu des réalisations et du contexte au C.A. lors des réunions trimestrielles, au conseiller culturel, à l'ambassadeur lors des réunions sur l’Ambassade et au Département (Direction générale de la Mondialisation \-DGM\-) lors de l’envoi de rapports.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Niveau Bac \+5 ou équivalent. Expérience avérée de direction d’un établissement public ou privé à l’étranger ou en France, dans des institutions culturelles ou des collectivités territoriales. La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

 This position acts as the execution engine of the commercial organization, connecting strategy, global priorities, and market delivery to achieve sustainable growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

**RFQs (Request for Quotation Management)**
* Oversee the end‑to‑end RFQ process, ensuring speed, quality, competitiveness, and compliance.

**Global Accounts**
* Build and strengthen relationships with Global and Strategic Accounts across EMEA.
* Govern and improve on‑time performance, delivery reliability, and overall customer experience for global customers.

**Distributor Excellence**

* Define performance KPIs, governance models, and execution standards for distributor‑led channels.

**Tender \& Contracting**

* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and leading transformation


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Senior commercial, execution, or excellence leadership experience
* Proven EMEA or similarly complex regional exposure

* About Arada


 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

data.jd_text:
Join our dynamic vertical transportation design consultancy in Dubai! We are seeking a
 **Senior Document Controller** 
 to manage document control governance and CDE (Common Data Environment) for our projects. In this role, you’ll keep our projects moving by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding all technical documentation. You will own version control, transmittals, and audit trails so teams can trust they’re working from the latest approved information. This is a full\-time, office\-based position reporting to the Head of Design/PMO.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* **Govern Document Control and CDE Management:** 
 Oversee our Common Data Environment (e.g. Oracle Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360/ACC, SharePoint) and implement EDMS tools/configuration in line with project requirements and quality policies.
  
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** 
 Work closely with engineers, architects, consultants and other stakeholders to streamline documentation workflows. Provide training and guidance on document standards and best practices to project teams and partners.
  
* **Maintain Registers and Reports:** 
 Produce and update document registers, status reports and dashboards. Ensure all drawings and deliverables are properly version\-controlled, accessible and audit\-ready.
  
* **Audit Readiness:** 
 Support internal and external audits by compiling turnover dossiers, as\-built packages and ensuring compliance checks. Keep document libraries always organized and audit compliant.
  
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Develop KPIs and refine document control processes for greater traceability. Enforce ISO\-aligned documentation controls (ISO 9001/19650\) and incorporate lessons learned into improved workflows.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* **Experience:** 
 7–10\+ years of document control experience (ideally in engineering or design consultancy projects). Experience leading or mentoring a document control team is a plus.
  
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Proven proficiency with CDE/DMS platforms such as Oracle Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360 (ACC), MS SharePoint, etc. Hands\-on experience configuring document workflows and maintaining complex libraries.
  
* **Industry Background:** 
 Experience in Vertical Transportation (elevators/escalators) or related MEP disciplines is highly valued. Familiarity with reading and managing lift/escalator design drawings and specifications.
  
* **Standards \& Compliance:** 
 Good understanding of ISO 9001/19650 standards and quality management. Comfortable managing audit processes and documentation compliance.
  
* **Skills:** 
 Excellent communication, organization and leadership skills. Ability to coordinate across teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  


  

 Benefits
   


 We are a Dubai\-based
 **Vertical Transportation design consultancy** 
 , providing expert lift and escalator system design and advisory services across the UAE. Our collaborative team works on high\-profile buildings, ensuring efficient and compliant VT solutions in every project. You can be a part and grow with us.
 


  


**Ready to Elevate Your Career?** 
 If you are a motivated document control professional with a passion for keeping projects on track, we want to hear from you.
 **Apply now** 
 or
 **reach out** 
 to discuss this exciting opportunity. Please feel free to share this post with your network or tag anyone who might be a great fit!

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Office Director to oversee and coordinate all aspects of the Office’s activities. This leadership role will focus on managing strategic partnerships, insights, and convenings while effectively managing a team. The Office Director will play a key role in strengthening communication and coordination among government and business leaders locally and internationally.
 



  





 The Office Director will ensure that strategic objectives are met by driving engagements, developing relationships, leading high\-level meetings, and fostering cross\-sectoral collaborations. This individual should possess deep expertise in managing partnerships, delivering insights, organizing convenings, and guiding team members to advance key initiatives.
 



  





**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Partnerships Leadership:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders in government and business sectors locally and in priority global regions.
* Oversee the identification, engagement, and management of partnerships with multilateral organizations, international forums, and influential family and corporate entities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for partners, facilitating productive interactions and ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with Embassies, diplomats, and government ministries to align partnership initiatives with Office goals and diplomatic missions.
* Drive the creation and management of a partnership database and maintain records of strategic engagements.



  





**2\. Insights Generation and Dissemination:** 



* Lead the design and execution of research projects, including studies, surveys, and workshops that inform strategy.
* Facilitate and manage regular insights sessions for senior businesses and governmental stakeholders on emerging geo\-economic and strategic issues.
* Oversee the development of high\-quality reports, briefings, and presentations that synthesize research findings into actionable insights.
* Guide content development in collaboration with team members to ensure alignment with Office objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the Communications Manager to ensure effective dissemination of insights through appropriate channels.



  





**3\. Convenings Management:** 



* Oversee the planning and execution of high\-level convenings, such as roundtables, conferences, and multi\-stakeholder meetings locally and key international locations.
* Ensure seamless coordination of event logistics, including venue selection, participant engagement, and on\-site management.
* Work collaboratively with team members to develop event agendas, speaker briefings, and session formats that align with strategic themes.
* Maintain a comprehensive annual convening strategy and identify opportunities to enhance or expand convening activities.
* Direct the collection and analysis of event feedback and post\-event reporting to guide continuous improvements.



  





**4\. Communication and Coordination with the Communications Manager:** 



* Establish and maintain open channels of communication with the Communications Manager to align messaging strategies with key objectives.
* Coordinate on the development of high\-quality content for various platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with strategic themes.
* Work collaboratively on media relations, press releases, and social media campaigns to enhance visibility.
* Guide the Communications Manager in crafting strategic communication plans for key events and projects.



  





**5\. Coordination with the Office Manager:** 



* Regularly engage with the Office Manager to oversee day\-to\-day administrative activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Collaborate on project timelines, office logistics, and team schedules to ensure alignment with priorities.
* Review and approve budget tracking, expense reports, and procurement activities managed by the Office Manager.
* Ensure that HR processes, onboarding, and team member support initiatives are aligned with the Office's overall strategy.



  





**6\. Reporting and Accountability Activities:** 



* Lead the development of comprehensive reports and updates, summarizing the progress of strategic projects and partnerships.
* Implement standardized reporting practices for all functions within the Office to maintain accountability and transparency.
* Oversee the preparation of policy briefings and reports for key stakeholders.
* Ensure timely submission of reports to senior leadership, facilitating informed decision\-making and strategic planning.



  





**7\. Supervisory Responsibilities:** 



* Mentor and provide performance oversight for the Office Staff team members.
* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages proactive problem\-solving and innovation.
* Oversee team collaboration and ensure team members have the resources and guidance needed to achieve key objectives.



  





**Essential Professional Experience / Skills** 




 This role requires a dynamic, strategic thinker with exceptional interpersonal skills and a deep understanding of the interplay between government and business. The ideal candidate will be adept at navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and passionate about fostering collaborations that advance the Office's interests on the global stage.
 


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in senior management roles involving partnerships, strategic insights, and event convenings, ideally in government or diplomatic settings.
* Proven track record of developing and sustaining high\-level partnerships across business and governmental sectors.
* Strong understanding of the global landscape of business and diplomacy, with experience in strategic research and insights generation.
* Exceptional communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills with a diplomatic approach.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple large\-scale projects simultaneously.
* Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
* Experience in leading and managing diverse, multicultural teams.
