data.jd_text:
**Posted on the Senna Private Equity Careers Network.**
**Overview**
 This Senior Project Manager role is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the project management function of a real estate company. The position carries direct accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-disciplined real estate projects on behalf of clients, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout. The successful candidate will lead experienced project teams, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and ensure that budget, schedule, quality, and risk objectives are met across each engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage all facets of project management — budget, schedule, procurement, quality, and risk — across individual real estate projects from inception through closeout.
* Interface directly with clients to define project requirements; prepare scope of work, resource plans, cost estimates, budgets, cash flow projections, work plan schedules, milestones, quality controls, and risk registers.
* Read, interpret, and apply standards to complex project documents including contracts, agreements, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys, and architectural drawings.
* Identify and qualify project delivery resources; conduct requests for proposals, lead bid analysis, facilitate evaluation interviews, and recommend appointments to clients.
* Lead and provide direction to multi\-disciplined project delivery teams, guiding them toward defined project goals.
* Implement and maintain a structured communication plan, including regular meetings, written reports, and meeting minutes, to keep clients and project teams consistently informed.
* Ensure project documentation governance aligns with company and client requirements; maintain data integrity, accuracy, and timely coordination of all project records.
* Track project progress against approved goals, budgets, and timelines; report on status and variances; develop and execute action plans to address deviations.
* Manage change control processes — assess change requests, evaluate impacts on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk, secure client approvals, and issue change orders accordingly.
* Identify complex project risks, lead constructability reviews, and develop and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans.
* Apply understanding of business context — including business cases, economic implications, and risk — to project management decisions.
* Analyse inputs from the wider team and make recommendations with direct impact on project and business outcomes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BEng, or BArch) in a technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Minimum of five years of directly relevant experience in the UAE.
* Demonstrated prior experience managing multi\-disciplined project teams in a similar senior role.
* PMP certification is required.
* MRICS designation is preferred.
* Full professional fluency in English, both written and verbal; Arabic or additional languages are advantageous.
* Valid UAE driver's licence.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings.
* Working knowledge of MS Project, lease structures, construction contracts, and construction practices.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; ability to solve complex problems and evaluate multiple options in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex business and contractual documents.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles; ability to forecast, prepare, and manage budgets and conduct financial analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce reports and deliver persuasive presentations to senior stakeholders and client groups.
* Proven ability to motivate, influence, and negotiate effectively with key team members, senior management, and clients.


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

* Direct client\-facing accountability on complex, high\-value real estate projects across the UAE market.
* Opportunity to lead experienced, multi\-disciplined teams on projects spanning the full real estate lifecycle.
* A full\-time, permanent position within a structured and established real estate company operating in one of the world's most active real estate markets.


 Application Process
   

  

 This role was posted on 22 June 2026 with Job ID 282466\. Interested candidates should ensure they meet the mandatory PMP certification requirement and the minimum five years of UAE\-based experience before applying. Applications should be submitted through the relevant posting channel associated with this reference.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

**Waagner Biro Bridge Services** 
 has been a leading construction and engineering company in Dubai and the UAE for over 50 years. Serving both government and private sector clients, the company delivers innovative, end\-to\-end solutions — from design and construction to maintenance.
   

  





 Backed by a multidisciplinary team of civil, mechanical, structural, and electrical engineers, Waagner Biro Bridge Services is committed to quality, precision, and reliable infrastructure delivery across the region.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager – Marine** 
 to lead and deliver complex marine and coastal infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing marine construction works such as quay walls, jetties, breakwaters, dredging, and coastal protection, ensuring projects are executed safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Lead the
 **end\-to\-end execution of marine construction projects** 
 , including planning, resource allocation, and delivery.
* Manage construction activities related to
 **jetties, quay walls, breakwaters, revetments, dredging, and shoreline protection** 
 .
* Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, and progress against key milestones.
* Coordinate with
 **clients, consultants, port authorities, and regulatory bodies** 
 to ensure smooth project execution.
* Oversee subcontractors, marine crews, and site teams, ensuring optimal productivity and performance.
* Ensure compliance with
 **HSE standards** 
 , particularly marine safety protocols, lifting operations, and offshore risks.
* Review and approve method statements, risk assessments, and technical submittals.
* Manage procurement of marine equipment such as
 **barges, tugs, cranes, and dredgers** 
 .
* Identify project risks (weather, tides, logistics constraints) and implement mitigation strategies.
* Lead project meetings, progress reviews, and reporting to senior management and stakeholders.
* Ensure all works comply with contractual obligations, quality standards, and local authority regulations.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Marine Engineering, or related field.
* **15\+ years of experience** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **marine and coastal infrastructure projects** 
 .
* Proven track record in delivering projects involving:
	+ Marine structures (quay walls, jetties, breakwaters)
	+ Dredging and reclamation works
* Strong knowledge of
 **marine construction methodologies, sequencing, and logistics** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **UAE authorities (Ports, Municipalities, or similar regulatory bodies)** 
 is highly preferred.
* Sound understanding of
 **FIDIC contracts and project commercial management** 
 .
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams in challenging marine environments.

With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.

**Job title: Project Manager**

 At Johnson Matthey, your work will matter. As a Project Manager, you’ll join a world leader in platinum group metals with over 200 years of history.  As a
 **Project Manager,** 
 you will help drive our goals by:
   

  

* Leading the planning and delivery of business and IT\-enabled projects, ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, budget and quality expectations
* Developing clear, structured project plans, including milestones, dependencies, resources and deliverables in line with governance standards
* Establishing and managing project governance, including stage gates, RAID management and change control
* Coordinating cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to manage dependencies and enable smooth delivery
* Monitoring progress, managing risks and issues, and ensuring timely escalation and mitigation of blockers
* Providing clear and concise reporting to sponsors and governance forums to support informed decision\-making

* Proven experience delivering end\-to\-end business and technology projects in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Strong understanding of structured project delivery frameworks and methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall or hybrid approaches
* Ability to translate business requirements into detailed, actionable project plans aligned with technical delivery
* Effective stakeholder management with the ability to influence and communicate clearly at all levels
* Strong organisational, analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high attention to detail
* Experience using project planning and delivery tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira or Azure DevOps

 We make sure salaries are fair, competitive and aligned to individual roles, experience and responsibilities. * Competitive retirement savings
* Company matched Share Incentive Plan

* Medical plans/health assessments
* Retailer and Wellbeing discounts

 Ready to make a meaningful impact on your career and the environment? Join us and help shape a sustainable future while advancing your career!

 All applications are carefully considered and your details will be stored on our secure Application Management System. This is used throughout Johnson Matthey for the selection of suitable candidates for our vacancies as they arise. Johnson Matthey respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
   

  

 For more information about how your personal data is used please view our privacy notice:  Johnson Matthey Privacy Notice. By applying for this role and creating an account you are agreeing to the notice.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

 Success in this role will be measured by:

**Description**
 About Amazon:
   

  

 Amazon is a global e\-commerce and cloud computing company guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long\-term thinking.  We are seeking a highly motivated and Technical Program Manager to drive innovation and optimization within AMET, leveraging the power of Amazon Web Services (AWS) . This role will be instrumental in identifying, developing and implementing solutions that improve efficiency, improve results, reduce costs, and enhance the overall customer experience. This role will require strong leadership, technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.

* Solution Design: Collaborate with engineering, operations and other stakeholders to design and develop innovative automation solutions. This includes defining functional requirements, developing technical specifications and overseeing the integration of new systems within the AWS ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization. Communicate project updates effectively and ensure alignment on goals and objectives.
* Team Leadership: Mentor and develop automation capability. Provide guidance, support, and opportunities for growth, fostering expertise in AWS and SCOT technologies.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor the performance of implemented solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Implement changes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness, leveraging analytics tools.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external stakeholders, particularly those specializing in AWS integrations. Negotiate contracts and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.

* Excellent project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, budgets, and resources.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

 The
 **Monad Foundation**

 The Monad Foundation is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own and orchestrate the delivery of complex and cross\-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with exceptional organizational and communication skills, enabling fast, coordinated delivery in a rapidly evolving blockchain environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Collaborate with leadership to identify key priorities, and shepherd and spearhead the delivery of special projects and initiatives.

data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.

 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.

*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

data.jd_text:
You have previously articulated a clear academic vision and taken full ownership of the results. Your leadership has been visible and direct, not confined to planning rooms. When it comes to the science of learning, your involvement has been substantive—you have created something tangible, produced measurable outcomes that validate the approach, and established the credibility to present that work publicly. If this describes your experience, 2 Hour Learning seeks its central figure in academic leadership.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning operates on a model in which students achieve learning gains at twice the typical rate within a two\-hour daily window. This is made possible through AI\-based tutoring, mastery\-oriented progression, and a significant redesign of traditional classroom structures. The outcomes have been robust. We now require a leader capable of aligning execution across varied school environments, elevating the standard of academic leadership, and representing a movement rooted in evidence\-based learning science to external audiences.
   

  

 This position is not centered on theoretical exploration. It is a leadership imperative. You will be accountable for academic strategy in its applied form, establish explicit performance standards, diagnose breakdowns in execution, and develop high\-performing teams to produce tangible results. You will convert our scientific underpinnings into operational rigor and advocate for this model on a global stage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Developing academic frameworks that convert learning science into actionable direction for curriculum design, student motivation systems, and application interfaces.
* Overseeing academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to confirm that school teams maintain alignment, accountability, and performance.
* Integrating findings from data analysis, stakeholder interviews, and direct observation into comprehensive academic ecosystem evaluations that identify the most critical obstacles to accelerated learning and recommend concrete solutions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through structured planning, continuous feedback mechanisms, and progress tracking focused on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the principal representative of 2 Hour Learning in high\-profile settings, including keynote presentations and meetings with Ministries of Education, to influence global perspectives on education.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Engaging in limited curriculum initiatives that do not produce broader systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from measurable student outcomes or operational implementation.
* Transferring responsibility for performance management to mid\-level staff or external advisors.
* Depending on institutional prestige or conceptual arguments to convince resistant audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and refine 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by coordinating execution across multiple schools, raising leadership performance standards, and serving as the authoritative public advocate for a movement founded on rigorous scientific principles and demonstrated outcomes.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. **About the Council** 





 The Sharjah Council for Higher Education and Scientific Research (SCHESR) is an advisory body established by Amiri Decree No. (14\) of 2025\. The Council aims to advance the higher education and scientific research ecosystem in the Emirate of Sharjah by promoting quality and excellence standards, fostering integration among higher education institutions, and supporting a research environment that drives innovation and sustainable development. The Council is committed to consolidate the position of the Emirate of Sharjah as a leading scientific hub in the fields of education and knowledge, and as an incubating environment for creativity that contributes to preparing generations capable of keeping pace with future demands.
 




  





**Job Description** 





 The Director of Strategic Planning and Institutional Excellence is responsible for leading and advancing the strategic planning and institutional excellence framework for the higher education sector in the Emirate of Sharjah. The role ensures the alignment of higher education institutions’ plans and initiatives with national development goals and the strategic priorities of the United Arab Emirates. The role oversees the development of academic programs and research capabilities, enhances institutional integration among relevant stakeholders, and advances the data and strategic indicators framework.
 





 Furthermore, the Director leads efforts to leverage advanced analytics and artificial intelligence technologies to support decision\-making, while monitoring institutional and academic performance alongside local and international rankings. This contributes to elevating the quality of education and scientific research outcomes, while strengthening the institutional leadership and competitiveness of higher education institutions across the Emirate of Sharjah.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 • Lead and develop strategic planning for the higher education sector in alignment with national priorities and the Emirate’s strategic directions.

 • Develop the academic program frameworks and foster leadership and innovation within higher education.
 





 • Support the growth and development of academic and research talent to elevate the overall quality of education and scientific research.
 





 • Oversee the management of institutional data and analytics, leveraging them to support policy formulation and decision\-making.
 





 • Monitor performance indicators and benchmark rankings to boost the competitiveness of higher education institutions.
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Strategic Planning in Education, Higher Education Management, Policy and Leadership in Education or any related field.
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in strategic planning, higher education management, educational policy development, or a related field.

 • Ability to analyze institutional data and indicators to extract actionable recommendations that support decision\-making.
 





 • In\-depth knowledge of global trends and best practices in higher education and scientific research.

* Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
* Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.

* Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


**Customer Engagement \& External Alignment**
* Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
* Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
* Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.

* Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
* Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.

* Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.

* Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
* Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
* Prior experience in R\&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


**Skills**

* Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  


     
   

**JOB PURPOSE:**
 To lead the development and execution of all of EGA’s operational and technical training initiatives for all operational training systems within EGA, ensuring alignment with corporate and operational goals.
 



  
 



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
 Strategic Development
 



  

 •    Drive the formulation and implementation of operational \& technical training strategies that align with EGA’s overall strategy, Human Capital and Talent Management.
 



 Safety, Quality, and Environmental Compliance
   

 •    Ensure adherence to all safety, quality, and environmental management policies and procedures within the department to uphold employee safety and regulatory compliance.
   

 •    Ensure all training materials are compliant with internal and external requirements for all operational areas across EGA
 



 Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance
   

 •    Ensure all training programs meet international and local regulatory standards and promote a culture of quality within the technical training team.
   

 •    Liaise with relevant government entities (e.g., KHDA, ACTVET) to secure recognition for EGA’s technical courses and advance the establishment of EGA as a recognized Training Academy.
 



 Training Management
   

 •    Oversee the design and management of a comprehensive training curriculum for operational and technical skill development across all Areas of EGA UAE, including JA, AT and ATA operations.
   

 •    Oversee the thorough training needs analyses to identify and deliver training programs for non\-supervisory operational employees and National Trainees
   

 •    Lead the design and development of technical and operational training courses, and acquire necessary training materials to facilitate cost\-effective delivery.
   

 •    Implement systems ensuring that 30% of operations employees are prepared for their next roles to minimize operational disruptions due to vacancies.
   

 •    Manage the Labour Training pool, including recruitment and selection, training and deployment into the Areas for approximately 150 employees at any one time
   

 •    Manage approximately 140 National Trainees for various training programs on behalf of EGA
   

 •    Ensure the availability of suitable training equipment, resources, and qualified personnel across EGA’s three sites to meet both short\- and long\-term manpower development objectives.
 



 Training Innovation and strategy 
   

 •    Lead the identification and development of modern training tools aligned with Industry 4\.0 technologies, such as AR, VR, MR, and simulators.
 



 On\-Job Excellence
   

 •    Lead the design and execution of the On\-Job Excellence program with 30 on\-job coaches supporting operations
   

 •    Monitor and report on progress of skill upgrades and readiness for new employees
 



 Budget Management
   

 •    Prepare and recommend the annual budget for the Technical and Operations Training for EGA (approximately US$4\-5M), analysing data to support funding requests on behalf of all of EGA operational areas
   

 •    Monitor financial performance against budget, identifying and addressing areas of concern while capitalizing on improvement opportunities.
 



 Collaboration and Coordination
   

 •    Collaborate with various plant areas to ensure that training aligns with operational needs, supporting EHS, Emiratisation, Recruitment, and Workforce Planning departments.
 



 Emiratisation Initiatives
   

 •    Design and implement technical training programs for Graduate and Non\-Graduate National trainees, focusing on achieving Emiratisation targets and promoting gender diversity.
   

 •    Manage the training and development of approximately 180 National Trainees through various programs, ensuring clear career pathways and regular engagement with senior leadership.
   

 •    Oversee the design, development and execution of the National Traineeship Program covering all a diverse range of technical requirements across of EGA, including Operations, Power, Maintenance, ATA, Casthouse, Administration, Fire \& Rescue and Technical Laboratory \& Quality
 



 Staff Development
   

 •    Coach and mentor the Technical and Operational Training staff to enhance their skills and capabilities.
 



 Reporting and Communication
   

 •    Provide regular updates to HC management on training plans, progress, and activities, ensuring accurate documentation and timely reporting of critical issues that may impact operations.
 



  

  
 



**AUTHORITY/ DECISION MAKING:**
     Know\-How: The job holder must possess a deep understanding of EGA’s operational and technical requirements, training methodologies, operational standards, and industry regulations. This knowledge enables the individual to interpret policies effectively and determine the best approaches to implement them within the training framework.
 



     Problem Solving: Working within clearly defined policies and objectives, the job holder is responsible for identifying what needs to be done to achieve organisational wide goals. This involves establishing actionable plans, prioritizing tasks, and prescribing processes to address training needs. The role requires critical thinking to assess potential risks and devise solutions that align with EGA’s strategic objectives.
 



     Accountability: The decisions made by the job holder can have significant implications for both safety and financial performance within operations. The individual is accountable for ensuring that training initiatives support operational excellence and mitigate risks. This level of responsibility requires a strong commitment to upholding safety standards and delivering results that align with corporate goals.
 



  
 



**QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

     Bachelor’s degree preferably in Human Resources, Business Management or Engineering. Approved qualification in training design and delivery is preferable.
 



 Minimum Experience:
   

     10\-12 years relevant experience in operations and technical training and development including at least 3 years in positions of progressively increasing managerial responsibilities.
 



  
 



 Skills:
   

     Leadership Skills
   

     Strong skills in building relationships and engaging others;
   

     Ability to coach and deliver technical training; 
   

     Knowledge of Smelting Process Operations
   

     Environment, Health and Safety Focus
   

     Problem solving and decision making
   

     Capable of leading a large and diverse team 
   

     Planning and organizational skills, action\-oriented, service focused  
   

     Conflict management skills

**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.jd_text:
**About GTN** 




 GTN is a FinTech\-powered brokerage business operating through its regulated subsidiaries. Backed by NTG Global Holdings Limited (Dubai), International Finance Corporation (IFC) of the World Bank Group, and SBI Ventures Singapore (a subsidiary of SBI Holdings Japan), GTN aims to create the most comprehensive global trading ecosystem. With a global team of over 500 people, GTN provides a multi\-market, multi\-asset class trading platform for institutional clients, operating on a B2B and B2B2C model.
 



 GTN currently serves clients through regulated subsidiaries in London, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the USA. As part of our global expansion, we are focused on bringing our innovative trading platform to more markets worldwide. Our platform is designed for buy\- and sell\-side financial institutions and fintech companies, such as digital banks, wallet providers and neo brokers, offering a seamless experience across trading, wealth management, and API solutions.
 








**About the Role** 




 The Programme Manager will play a critical role in driving the successful delivery and governance of strategic initiatives across GTN Middle East. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for complex, cross\-functional programmes, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with the firm's strategic, commercial, and regulatory objectives.
 



 A key responsibility of this role is the implementation, operation, and ongoing oversight of the New Product Approval (NPA) process, ensuring new products are assessed, governed, and delivered in line with internal controls, regulatory requirements, and executive expectations.
 



 This role suits a senior programme professional with strong judgement, structured thinking, and the confidence to operate with autonomy while engaging and collaborating closely with all levels of stakeholders, including executive leadership.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**Programme \& Project Leadership** 



* Own and manage programmes and projects from initiation, execution to closure, with full accountability for scope, timelines, and outcomes.
* Translate strategic and commercial objectives into clear, executable programme plans with defined milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Oversee multiple workstreams concurrently, ensuring prioritisation and alignment across teams.



**New Product Approval (NPA) Governance** 



* Lead the implementation and ongoing management of the New Product Approval (NPA) process across the organisation.
* Act as the central point of coordination for new product initiatives, ensuring appropriate stakeholder input, approvals, and documentation are completed.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 GENERAL PURCHASING
   

  

* Purchases a variety of goods and services for both Campuses from local and international sources in line with the University By\-Laws.
* Materials procured range from: computers (hardware, software, consumables, accessories), audio video equipment, office equipment, office and classroom furniture, lab equipment, printing materials, stationery, text books, periodicals, vehicles, building materials and renovation services, rental of equipment/vehicles and maintaining the University Insurance Policies (Public Liability, Fire, Burglary and Vehicular), for both campuses.
* Interprets purchase requests, investigates supply sources and negotiates best terms and conditions in line with user specifications.
* Scrutinizes specifications carefully to ensure that they are generic in nature during enquiry preparation stage, and to advise or obtain clarification from end user when such anomalies appear.
* Solicits quotations in line with the purchasing method approved by the Director/line manager. Scrutinizes vendor quotations and prepares bid summaries as required. Makes recommendations where possible.
* Vets and benchmarks prices obtained through referring to historical data, web published prices, and/or checking with end users to compare budgeted and estimated costs with actual prices.
* Expedites orders to ensure that goods and services are delivered within contractual deadlines and ensures that end users are kept advised of delivery situation at all times.
* Liaises with vendors regarding discrepancies and damage reports to ensure correct replacement of materials in accordance with order specifications.
* Issues amendments in case of increase/decrease of quantities and cancellation of orders and ensures accuracy of data at all times.
* Ensures through liaison with end users that vendor invoices routed for payment approval, are not held up without reason.
* When requested by line manager, must be able to produce and place on record the complete history of a specific purchase, for presentation or audit purposes.
* Answers vendor and client queries as required.


 TENDERS
   

  

* Prepares vendor tender documents complete with technical specifications, conditions, bill of quantities, date for opening envelopes, tender validity, terms of payment and guarantee, in line with the Director’s/line manager’s instructions.
* Monitors closing dates for tenders and ensures that tender opening sessions are held on the day of closing.
* Receives tender documents and prepares appropriate record in preparation of the tender opening session.
* Passes on all tenders with appropriate record to the tender opening committee.
* Forwards technical documents/catalogues to appointed Technical Committee for technical evaluation. Addresses clarifications arising from technical queries by evaluation teams.
* On receipt of technical evaluation from end user, opens Commercial envelopes and prepares the Bid Summary.
* On the advice of the Director/ line manager, prepares orders/fax of intent.
* Prepares blanket orders according to standards, procedures and University By\-Laws.
* Collects Performance Bonds and Bank Guarantees and maintains their security through the Finance Department. Returns bonds to unsuccessful vendors as required.
* Monitors contractual delivery and completion deadlines and liaises with Contracts Specialist for any delays in contract delivery.


**Other**
* Must be fully conversant with, and able to prepare and issue requests for quotations on the Tejari.com business to business exchange.
* Must be fully conversant with the Purchasing module of the Banner System and be able to process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with adopted procedures.
* Maintains confidentiality of purchasing information and does not disseminate information to any Party, unless authorized by the Director/line manager.
* Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of all procedures in the By\-Laws and the University’s purchasing terms and conditions.
* Must be conversant with the Storekeeper’s functions to fill in duties when required to do so.
* Identify, mitigate and escalate procurement risks to enable the organization to meet its obligations and maximize business opportunities
* Maintain and update procurement records and generate reports on procurement and contract activity to meet organizational compliance requirements and provide access to procurement information
* Performs other related duties as assigned and needed.


 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Works independently to deal with different clients while maintaining confidentiality and a professional manner. Coordinates and directs a variety of purchasing requests, tenders, queries and correspondence. Mainly works to meet deadlines and must be able to function under time constraints.


 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

* Works closely with the Director/line manager, C\&P, members in the Department and other departments, particularly Finance to ensure that the complete procurement cycle is completed effectively, through payment of invoices to vendors.
* Must communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external clients.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Must possess a Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and 2 years relevant professional experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Experience working in a similar role in a government or higher education institution will be highly preferred.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent computer skills required.
* Knowledge of purchasing procedures is preferred.
* Arabic/ English bilingual an asset.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
* Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
* Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
* Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.
