data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

data.jd_text:
**Role:** 




 An Associate Director in Financial Crime Risk in Supervision is responsible for executing the Financial Crime Risk Team’s work plan. The Associate Director must ensure that a risk based, proportionate and efficient approach is maintained towards all the team’s supervisory activities.
 



  





 An Associate Director is expected to oversee assigned regulatory projects related to financial crime risk and relevant business model within the team, across the Supervision Department and the DFSA, as well as supporting on related policy work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 The Associate Director is expected to devote the majority of his/her time towards managerial and operational level tasks, as well as support policy development. The Associate Director will assist the Director and contribute to the work of the team with the following key responsibilities:
 



  






 Technical Guidance
 



* Act as a technical expert in respective risk area and provide internal trainings as needed.
* Provide guidance to the team in all aspects of financial crime risk for regulated entities in order to ensure delivery of effective and efficient risk\-based supervision.
* Support DFSA Divisions by providing guidance in all aspects of financial crime risk in line with the DFSA’s objectives.
* Monitor developments in relevant international and regional regulatory standards and in the financial services industry and provide inputs and updates.



  






 Strategy Formulation, Implementation, Planning and Projects
 




  




* Contribute to DFSA\-wide and Supervision Division\-wide strategic direction, business planning and policy formation. Ensure effective cascading of approved strategy, business plans and policies into the day\-to\-day management of the team.
* Participate in the development and implementation of supervision strategy for the team, consistent with the DFSA\-wide goals and objectives.
* Ensure DFSA\-wide projects as captured in the Business Plan relevant to the AD are completed effectively, on\-time and within budget.
* Be expected to devote a considerable level of time toward managerial, policy, outreach and other assigned projects.



  






 People Management
 



* Manage and support the effective achievement of the objectives of respective areas of focus through setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, provision of formal and informal feedback and appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and the overall performance.
* Ensure the key performance indicators, performance reviews, leave approvals and timesheets are completed in an accurate and timely manner for self and team members.
* Support the professional development programs of the DFSA through program development, delivery and participation. Support and contribute to the DFSA graduates training program.
* When requested, effectively lead the team in the absence of the Director.



  





**Educational Background** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management or Economics. A post graduate degree in similar fields would be considered as an advantage.
* Evidence of continuing professional education relevant to target position.
* Professional qualifications in finance, risk management, quantitative analysis, etc. such as ACAMS, CFA, FRM, PRM, etc. would be considered as a plus.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of regulatory, compliance or risk management experience required in a broadly equivalent financial services regulator and/or a regulated entity, with a minimum of 2 years in managerial/ supervisory roles in one or more of these functions being desirable. Managerial roles might include project leadership / management roles or equivalent with a demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate staff.
* Experience in dealing with financial services regulators, standard setters and members of Board of Directors and senior executives.
* Preferably experience in the development and implementation of regulatory standards and policy analysis.
* Experience of country self\-assessments against the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 recommendations; national risk assessments pursuant to FATF Recommendation 1; and involvement with a FATF country mutual evaluation would be considered an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong and up to date knowledge and technical expertise in dealing with financial services regulations and relevant international standard setters.
* Robust understanding of the responsibilities/role of the regulator and of what it means to be a risk\-based regulator.
* An in\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and its unique characteristics with proven technical knowledge and understanding of the key risks in the sector.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging risk management trends/issues.
* Appreciation of the unique features of the regulatory regime in the DIFC and understanding of the nature of the financial service activities offered by Authorised Firms operating in the DIFC.
* Strategic vision, strong analytical thinking and creativity; capacity to clearly articulate options and trade\-offs and ability to apply judgment.
* Influential skills and ability to lead meetings and deliver difficult messages, when necessary.
* Excellent people leadership, planning, organisation and time management skills embodied in a professional, diplomatic and ethical attitude.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to address senior executives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to engage effectively and confidently with international counterparts.
* Capacity to deliver high quality work to demanding timescales.
* Be able to work flexibility, autonomously, and co\-operatively in a collaborative team environment.

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going.  Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director Digital UI/UX is accountable for defining and leading Kerzner International’s digital experience strategy and design execution across the global brand portfolio, including Atlantis, One\&Only, SIRO, and Rare Finds.
   

  

 The role owns the end\-to\-end experience, vision, design quality, and user ‑centred execution across all digital products and channels, ensuring guest journeys are intuitive, premium, accessible, and conversion effective. Acting as the design authority for digital experience, the Director‑ Digital UI/UX establishes experience principles, design systems, and optimisation practices that consistently translate brand intent into high q‑uality digital interactions.
   

  

 The Director Digital UI/UX works in close partnership with the Director Digital Products, who owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, and platform decisions. Together, the roles ensure digital products deliver measurable business results while maintaining a differentiated, guest centric experience aligned with Kerzner’s luxury positioning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Experience Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and own Kerzner’s global digital experience strategy across web, mobile, booking, and supporting platforms
* Translate brand, guest, and business objectives into clear experience principles and design direction
* Ensure consistency of experience across brands while allowing for brand specific expression where required
* Act as the senior design authority for all guest facing digital experience


**Guest Journey Design \& Optimisation**
* Lead the design of end\-to\-end guest journeys across discovery, inspiration, booking, and post booking touchpoints
* Drive continuous experience optimisation to improve usability, engagement, and conversion
* Partner with the Director Digital Products to align experience led optimisation initiatives with commercial priorities and targets
* Balance ‑guest centric design with performance, scalability, and delivery constraints


**Design Systems, Standards \& Governance**
* Establish, evolve, and govern Kerzner’s digital design systems, component libraries, and experience standards
* Define UX/UI best practices, accessibility standards, and quality benchmarks
* Ensure consistent application of design standards across internal teams, agencies, and partners
* Review and approve experience and design decisions for major initiatives and releases
* Maintain hands‑on proficiency in industry‑standard tools (e.g. Figma) and emerging AI‑powered design capabilities


**User Research, Insights \& Experimentation**
* Own user research practices, including qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, and journey validation
* Interpret analytics, experimentation results, and guest feedback to identify experience improvement opportunities
* Translate insights into actionable design recommendations and priorities
* Collaborate with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to ensure insights inform roadmap and optimisation decisions


**Cross Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Partner closely with Digital Products, Technology, Marketing, Brand, and Content teams
* Support agile and product oriented delivery models with embedded design practices
* Provide clear executive level communication on experience vision, priorities, and outcomes
* Engage and manage external design agencies and partners to deliver against experience standards


**Ways of Working**
 The Director Digital UI/UX and Director Digital Products operate as peer leaders within the Digital \& Technology leadership team. The Director Digital UI/UX owns experience strategy, design quality, and user ‑centred execution, while the Director Digital Products owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, platform strategy, and technical decision making. Decisions impacting both domains are made collaboratively, with escalation to the Chief Digital \& Information Officer where required‑.
   

  

**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 10\+ years’ experience in UX/UI, digital experience design, or customer experience roles
* 5\+ years’ experience leading design teams in complex, global digital environments
* Experience in hospitality, luxury, travel, or consumer facing digital platforms preferred


**Design \& Experience Expertise**
* Deep expertise in UX/UI design, interaction design, and experience strategy
* Strong experience designing for complex ecosystems including content, commerce, and booking journeys
* Proven track record of improving conversion and engagement through experience led design
* Strong understanding of accessibility, usability standards, and inclusive design


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




  





 talabat is the leading on\-demand food and non\-food delivery platform in MENA, operating across 8 countries and processing hundreds of millions of orders annually.
 



 We're part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce, and we're engineering\-first. Our teams operate under
 **eXtreme Programming (XP) principles** 
 — TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development. We believe
 **quality enables speed** 
 , and our hiring reflects that. Our engineering culture is a key competitive advantage, and we're looking for leaders who embody it.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





**What you'll own** 




  





 As
 **Senior Engineering Manager** 
 , you'll lead multiple engineering teams (typically 4 squads, \~20 engineers) across a single technical domain. You're accountable for:
 


* **Domain\-level technical strategy** 
 — Work with product leadership and your teams to define a 12–18 month technical vision for your domain
* **Team health and growth** 
 — Build an environment where engineers thrive: hiring, developing ICs, mentoring junior managers, and creating psychological safety
* **Delivery excellence** 
 — Guide your teams through discovery, planning, and execution using small\-batch delivery and continuous feedback loops
* **Business impact** 
 — Translate product objectives into technical solutions; quantify and communicate the impact of your domain's work
* **Cross\-functional leadership** 
 — Work closely with product, design, and business partners to resolve ambiguity and drive alignment
* **Technical decision\-making** 
 — Guide your teams on system design, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining talabat's standards for scalability, security, and performance



  





**90\-day, 6\-month, and 12\-month outcomes** 




  





**90 days:** 
 You've onboarded your teams, understood their technical roadmap and pain points, and delivered your first feedback to your manager on domain health and near\-term priorities.
 



**6 months:** 
 Your teams are shipping value consistently; you've identified one emerging technical leader and started mentoring them; you've coached your teams through at least one cross\-domain initiative; code quality and shipping velocity are on track or improving.
 



**12 months:** 
 Your domain has a clear technical vision communicated across the org; you've grown at least one engineer significantly (either toward IC4/Staff or toward management); your teams ship with confidence; you're contributing to 1–2 strategic initiatives beyond your domain; you're mentoring or developing a potential future manager.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**What you'll bring** 




  





**Leadership \& people management** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on technical leadership experience managing engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and grow engineers — we care about your track record of developing people, not just technical skills
* Comfort with cross\-functional leadership: working with product, design, business partners, and other engineering teams
* Emotional intelligence: you navigate ambiguity, handle conflict constructively, and create psychological safety for your teams



  





**Technical depth** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience in production systems
* Deep understanding of
 **at least one** 
 of: distributed systems, backend systems, data platforms, mobile platforms, or web\-scale infrastructure
* Proven ability to work
 **across diverse technology stacks** 
 — we care that you've made architecture decisions that matter, not that you've used every specific tool
* Hands\-on understanding of XP practices: TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development (or strong willingness to learn and lead talabat's approach)



  





**Engineering sense** 



* You think about non\-functional requirements: scalability, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, and security — not just feature delivery
* You've navigated the tradeoffs between speed and technical debt; you know when to optimize and when to simplify
* You've led or been part of domain\-level decisions (tech stack migrations, architectural changes, platform initiatives)



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Experience leading multiple teams or a domain in a high\-growth environment
* Exposure to eXtreme Programming practices (XP culture is learnable but experience is valuable)
* Background in marketplace, delivery, or logistics optimization
* Experience mentoring or developing other engineering managers
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)



  





**Additional information** 




  





**Why this role, why talabat** 




  




* **Scale with purpose:** 
 You'll impact millions of daily orders across MENA while building a technical foundation that's proven to scale
* **Engineering culture that works:** 
 We practice XP genuinely — TDD, pair programming, continuous delivery — not as Agile theater. Our engineers ship faster
 *because* 
 we focus on quality
* **Autonomous teams:** 
 Your teams own their roadmap and their quality. You're not a bottleneck; you're an enabler
* **Mentoring and growth:** 
 If you want to grow into a Director role, we have a clear path: multi\-domain scope → tribe leadership → org strategy
* **Real problems:** 
 Food delivery in MENA is complex. You'll solve problems that matter: serving millions, operating across 8 countries, balancing fast delivery with sustainability

 Reporting to the Senior Client D
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


**Essential**
 ABOUT YOU
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.

**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About this role:**
 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
   

  

 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat


**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
   

  

**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
   

  

**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**You must have**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data


**Bonus If You Have**
* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams


**This role is for you if...**
* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought


**This role is NOT for you if...**
* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices


**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
 Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
   

  

**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
   

  

**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

**Job Description**

* To respond to medical questions from customers and company colleagues

* To validate team’s medical information
* To work with field teams on public relations or symposia with healthcare professionals.

 Qualifications:

 All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

 At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first\-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

By effectively turning our research into ground\-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

 As project manager he/she is the primary point for all project\-related activities, holding the overall responsibility for the successful execution of the project. **Project Execution and Monitoring**
* Manage end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring deliverables meet or exceed expectations in terms of quality, timelines, and budget.

* Maintain accurate project records and complete close\-out documentation.

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred

data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

data.jd_text:
We are currently seeking an experienced Architect to join a leading real estate developer in Dubai. Reporting directly to the Head of Design, this is a client\-side position offering the opportunity to oversee the successful delivery of a high\-profile development from a design quality and architectural compliance perspective.
 



  





 The role will be split between the developer's Head Office in Dubai (3 days per week) and the project site office (2 days per week), providing a balance between design coordination and on\-site project oversight. As the developer's representative, you will play a key role in safeguarding the original design intent throughout the construction phase through technical query management, shop drawing review, material submittal review and ongoing site inspections. You will ensure the highest standards of architectural execution are maintained and that the completed product accurately reflects the approved design vision.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the primary architectural representative for the developer during the construction phase.
* Respond to technical and design\-related queries raised by contractors, consultants and project stakeholders.
* Conduct regular site inspections and site walks to monitor construction progress and quality.
* Review shop drawings and provide feedback to ensure alignment with the approved design intent and project requirements.
* Review material submittals, samples and mock\-ups to ensure compliance with approved specifications, finishes and design standards.
* Review architectural works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and design standards.
* Ensure all architectural elements, materials, finishes and spatial decisions accurately reflect the approved design package.
* Identify and resolve design\-related issues arising during construction.
* Coordinate closely with consultants, contractors and internal stakeholders to maintain alignment between design intent and site execution.
* Monitor architectural quality and workmanship standards throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide clear recommendations and decisive technical guidance to support project delivery.
* Support the Head of Design in maintaining consistency, quality and adherence to the project's architectural vision.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture.
* Minimum 8–10 years of professional architectural experience.
* Proven experience overseeing projects during the construction stage.
* Strong understanding of architectural detailing, materials, construction methodologies and quality control.
* Previous experience representing a developer, client\-side organisation, consultancy or architectural practice during site delivery phases is highly desirable.
* Experience reviewing shop drawings, material submittals and architectural technical documentation.
* Ability to confidently interpret drawings, specifications and construction documentation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive, hands\-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working both on\-site and within a corporate office environment.



  





 This is a highly proactive role requiring regular site presence, sound technical judgement and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional architectural quality. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on a landmark development and play a key role in ensuring the finished product reflects the original vision and design excellence expected by the developer.

data.jd_text:
We’re looking for a Director Supply Chain to join the team and focus on growing our own Grocery Store “tMart”. THis role is critical leadership role at the core of tMart UAE's business performance. This position owns both Demand Planning (DP) and Supply Chain (SC), ensuring seamless integration between forecasting, inventory management, warehouse operations, transportation, and network optimization.
 



  





 The role is responsible for maximizing product availability while optimizing inventory, transportation costs, working capital, and overall profitability. As a key member of the UAE leadership team, the successful candidate will proactively design scalable supply chain solutions, drive operational excellence, and lead innovation initiatives that directly impact GMV growth, free cash flow, and customer experience.
 



  





**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?** 




  





**Demand Planning \& Inventory Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end demand forecasting accuracy across all categories and channels.
* Drive product availability as the primary business metric through optimized forecasting and replenishment strategies.
* Manage inventory health and Days on Hand (DOH) targets across warehouses and stores.
* Optimize stock allocation across stores and distribution centers.
* Lead forecasting enhancement initiatives through advanced analytics, AI, and Intelligent Demand Planning (IDP) tools.
* Balance service levels, inventory investment, and waste reduction to maximize profitability.
* Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, and Inventory teams to anticipate business needs and proactively plan capacity and stock requirements.



  





**Supply Chain Network \& Logistics** 



* Own the design, optimization, and performance of the UAE supply chain network
* Optimize transportation flows, routes, network design, truck utilization, and contract structures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce logistics costs while improving service levels and fill rates.
* Lead warehouse and network optimization projects, incorporating automation and industry best practices.
* Proactively map and implement new operational flows and processes as the business scales.



  





**Warehouse Operations \& Inventory Accuracy** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for warehouse and transportation 3PL partners.
* Monitor and improve key contractual KPIs including:
* On\-Time Delivery
* Damage Rates
* Service Compliance
* Cost Efficiency
* Maintain inventory accuracy targets through robust reconciliation processes between warehouse systems and operational platforms.
* Oversee cycle count programs and inventory controls across all distribution centers and across all tMart stores.
* Drive SOP compliance and continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain functions.
* Ensure optimal space utilization, stock positioning, and inventory valuation management.



  





**Process Excellence \& Business Transformation** 



* Develop, implement, and continuously improve SOPs across supply chain processes including:
* Lead supply chain innovation initiatives leveraging technology, automation, and data\-driven decision making.
* Introduce external best practices to improve scalability, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Build proactive planning capabilities that anticipate future business needs rather than reacting to operational challenges.



  





**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead and develop Supply Chain and Distribution Center Teams
* Build a high\-performing organization with clear accountability, ownership, and succession planning.
* Establish and deliver shared OKRs across functions.
* Lead executive\-level business reviews and strategic discussions with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration to improve business outcomes rather than optimize individual functions in isolation.



  





**WHAT DID WE ORDER?** 




  





**Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Network Optimization.
* Proven leadership experience managing multi\-functional supply chain teams.
* Experience operating within complex distribution networks involving multiple warehouses, stores, cross\-docks, and third\-party logistics providers.
* Strong background in inventory management, forecasting, transportation optimization, and warehouse operations.
* Experience leading large\-scale transformation, automation, or systems implementation projects.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Exceptional analytical and quantitative capabilities.
* Strong business and financial acumen with understanding of P\&L, working capital, and cash flow drivers.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Deep understanding of supply chain flows, inventory dynamics, and operational processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and solve business\-wide problems rather than functional issues alone.
* Comfortable presenting to senior leadership and leading executive discussions.
* High agility with data, systems, and supply chain technology platforms.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview**
 The Arbor School seeks a special individual for an exciting opportunity that has arisen within our school. The successful candidate will play a key role in fulfilling the school’s ecological and sustainability vision, as well as challenging students to fulfil their potential within the academic disciplines. The Arbor School is seeking a highly motivated  Head of Design and Technology to lead the Food Technology and Resistant Materials department in the Secondary School.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced teacher/leader with a passion for this subject area. The successful applicant will be able to teach students of all abilities as well as demonstrate a proven track record of securing outstanding student outcomes. Proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology, ideally with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC.
   

  

***Enough For All, For Ever***
 The Arbor School opened in 2018 with a very different vision of what education could and should be – experiential, authentic and inspired by the natural beauty, human ingenuity, and profound ecological and social challenges of the Arabian Peninsula.
   

  

 The cultivation of a learning community uniquely committed to understanding and restoring the health of ecological and human communities as interconnected parts of a whole requires equal parts optimism, ambition, and humility. A fundamental belief in the inherit goodness of people and their capacity to act with empathy and compassion underscores the sense of hope that is fundamental to learning for a sustainable future. The resilience and determination to tackle challenges that have grown to global proportion is essential to finding sustainable solutions and orchestrating the social changes needed to grow them to scale. The realisation that comes from recognising that we are all students – never a master – drives our commitment to ignite a lifelong love of learning.
   

  

**Role**
 Recognising the interconnected nature of the cognitive, affective, and participative domains, and their roles in shaping learning, we are pursuing a holistic approach to teaching and learning, designed to prepare learners:
   

  

* to understand the interconnected concepts of sustainability, individual and collective well\-being, and environmental and social justice;
* to find purpose, meaning and joy in their interactions with the natural world and with each other, and to seek to understand people who are different to themselves;
* to experience a sense of accomplishment and self\-efficacy through their actions at home, in school and in the wider world.


  

  

**The Arbor Promise**
 Arbor teachers are a part of a community which is inclusive, fun\-loving, and active. Arbor teachers enjoy authentic friendships with their colleagues, positive relationships with school leaders, who care for their wellbeing, and are a team in the true sense. Arbor teachers are resilient in the face of challenge, are stable and calm in the face of change, and creative and flexible when solving problems. Arbor teachers bring their passions and interests to enrich our school and are clear that there is an expectation to do so. We commit to meeting agreed deadlines, to communicating proactively with an assumption of positive intent and share a passion to provide an education of the highest quality to our students.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The successful candidate will be proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC. You will lead the team, with responsibilities across KS3, KS4, and KS5, overseeing Design Technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Doing all that you can to ensure that you safeguard and promote the welfare of students (in line with Arbor’s Safeguarding framework/policy/Code of Conduct).
* Positively and actively promoting the Arbor vision, mission, and values.
* Ensuring your practice is in line with the Arbor Staff Handbook, the Arbor Support Teacher: A Framework for Outstanding Support.
* Implementing, where appropriate, school policies, procedures and expected practices, as identified by the Senior Leadership Team at the Arbor School.
* Undertake specific operational tasks as agreed upon with the Assistant Head of Curriculum, including some or all of the following areas:
* To support in developing and reviewing the Design Technology curriculum and schemes of work at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* Support in the preparation, delivery and evaluation of schemes of work for the school in accordance with the National Curriculum requirements; with a particular focus on challenge, pace, high order questioning and thinking skills to facilitate students accessing the highest grades at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* To ensure that the learning environment is well\-ordered, safe and stimulating, leading by example to encourage a high standard of display work in classrooms and communal areas with a clear emphasis on celebrating success, sharing achievements and highlighting specialist subject knowledge.


**Required Candidate Profile**
* Native\-level English language skills
* Bachelor’s degree in Design Technology or similar, with a PGCE in Education with QTS or equivalent
* A minimum of 3 years experience teaching Design and Technology in the UK or a reputable British school overseas
* A track record of outstanding GSCE and/or A Level examination results.
* A track record of outstanding teaching and learning and an ability to create a caring and nurturing classroom environment.


**Remuneration:** 
 A competitive tax\-free compensation package will be provided in accordance with School's policy and UAE labour law regulations.
   

  

**Application:** 
 To apply for this position, please complete the application on TES and upload:
   

  

* An up\-to\-date CV with a recent photograph to be included.
* A letter of application, no longer than two pages in length, which outlines your educational philosophy and suitability for the Arbor School.


***The Arbor School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all the students in our care and expects all applicants to share this commitment. We hold ourselves to a high standard of effective, safer recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All appointments are subject to CV and qualification checks, interview, identity checks, criminal record checks, and successful references.***
***All appointments are subject to the approval of the Knowledge and Human Development Authority and the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.***
