data.jd_text:
**Process Safety Management Specialist / Senior PSE** 




 The Process Safety Management (PSM) Specialist reports to the Head of Health \& Safety and supports the effective implementation of process safety management across the Generation International (GI) fleet.
 



 Working closely with the Process Safety manager, this role focuses on supporting the development of local PSM champions, coordinating process safety network activities, and facilitating hazard identification and risk analysis to help mitigate risks across assets. The role will contribute to training delivery, performance monitoring, incident investigations, and sharing lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
 



 The position is based in Dubai, with frequent travel across the GI perimeter, including GCC, KSA, Africa, Chile, Peru, Mexico, Canada, and Australia to support site activities.
 



  





**Role Details** 



* **Reporting to:** 
 Head of Health and Safety, Generation International
* **Location:** 
 Dubai
* **Travel:** 
 \~70% across international sites
* **Employment Type:** 
 Permanent, Full\-Time



  





**Key Activities and Responsibilities** 




**Strategic** 



* Support the implementation and enhancement of process safety management practices across the GI fleet
* Contribute to the development of the fleet risk profile and support mitigation action tracking
* Assist in promoting process safety awareness across regions, countries, and asset teams
* Share process safety knowledge and lessons learned across the organization
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange between sites and business units



  





**Operational** 



* Support compliance with Engie Group Rules, standards, and procedures (including GR09 H\&S in Industrial Projects and GEN PSM Fundamentals)
* Coordinate and contribute to process safety network meetings, reporting, and data sharing
* Participate in or support Process Hazard Risk Assessments (PHRA), including BowTie workshops and reviews
* Assist with tracking and close\-out of actions arising from risk assessments and audits
* Support implementation of hazard identification and risk assessment processes, including Safety Critical Elements (SCEs)
* Participate in safety reviews (HAZID, HAZOP, audits, inspections) across O\&M and project sites
* Support project teams in meeting process safety requirements throughout the project lifecycle
* Maintain and update process safety documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with site conditions
* Contribute to incident investigations and root cause analysis (e.g., TapRoot methodology)
* Ensure timely reporting of Process Safety Events (PSEs) in the One Safety Tool (OST)



  





**Organisational** 



* Support the development and rollout of PSM training programs and materials
* Contribute to competency development of site teams and PSM champions
* Assist in setting and tracking process safety objectives and KPIs



  





**Planning \& Performance Monitoring** 



* Support the maintenance of process safety dashboards and KPIs
* Monitor process safety performance and highlight trends or areas for improvement
* Assist in identifying and tracking corrective and preventive actions



  





**Decision Making** 



* Provide input into project safety reviews and derogation requests
* Participate in investigation teams for process safety events
* Escalate key risks and support mitigation planning



  





**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with asset PSM champions and support their development
* Collaborate with Industrial Projects H\&S teams and site management
* Promote sharing of process safety knowledge across all levels of the organization



  





**Leadership \& Contribution** 



* Act as a key contributor to process safety initiatives within GI
* Support awareness campaigns and training delivery
* Participate actively in safety reviews, audits, and investigations
* Contribute to a strong process safety culture across the organization



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field
* NEBOSH Certificate in Process Safety Management (or equivalent) preferred



  





**Experience** 



* **6–8 years’ experience** 
 in process safety, industrial safety, or related fields
* Experience in power generation, energy, or industrial environments is advantageous
* Exposure to hazard analysis techniques (e.g., HAZOP, BowTie) preferred



  





**Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Understanding of industrial processes and associated risks
* Familiarity with process safety management systems and standards
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Good communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders
* Ability to support training delivery and knowledge sharing
* Basic incident investigation and root cause analysis skills
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across geographies

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions


**Responsibilities**
* Expertise in electrical modelling and analysis software (ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, CDEGS, or similar)
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (Navisworks, AutoCAD, single\-line diagram tools)
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks and certifications (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) as they apply to data centres
* Experience with and understanding of the selection of electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities
* Familiarity with industry design standards and specifications (Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ISO standards for data centres)
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) certification preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency strategies, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewable energy integration in data centres
* Experience with utility (DEWA, TAQA, SEC) coordination, power infrastructure planning, and large load interconnection processes with regional utilities
* Knowledge of data centre monitoring and control systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS integration)
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project economics, risk management, and value engineering
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

data.jd_text:
**Some brands sell products.** 




**We help shape decisions that change lives.** 




  





 Every day, 24 million measurements are taken on a seca device somewhere in the world. In hospitals in Tokyo, clinics in São Paulo, GP practices in Hamburg. The data that flows from those moments helps doctors, nurses, and specialists make decisions that matter — sometimes routine, sometimes life\-changing.
 



  





 We are not a tech startup. We are not a challenger brand reinventing ourselves every 18 months. We are a 185\-year\-old family business with the discipline of a world market leader, the curiosity of engineers who still love what they build, and a marketing team that thinks in campaigns — not content calendars.
 



  





**And we have one open seat.** 




  





**What this role actually is:** 




 As
 **Senior Creative \- Campaign Art Direction (m/f/d)** 
 you will be a central creative force behind our international campaigns across Medical and Fitness — two demanding, visually distinct segments, both requiring the kind of strategic depth and executional craft that only comes from real agency experience.
 



  





 This is not a production role. This is not a "make it beautiful" role. This is a thinking\-and\-making role, where concept and execution are inseparable and where the quality of the idea is just as accountable as the quality of the layout.
 



  





 You will join an international team at our
 **office in Dubai, UAE** 
 and work closely with our Global Marketing and Creative teams at our headquarters in Hamburg, Germany inside our inhouse creative studio — structured and resourced like an agency, embedded in one of the most internationally active Health Tech companies in the world. Working closely with and under the creative direction of our Head of Creative, you will develop campaigns from brief to delivery across digital\-first formats: landing pages, paid social, display, video, and interactive platforms. You bring the craft, the concept discipline, and the drive to see an idea through without needing someone to push it. What you do not bring is the ego of someone who needs to run the room.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for:** 



* Developing campaign concepts from strategic brief to final execution — under creative direction, but with genuine ownership of your work
* Executing the visual language of integrated campaigns across digital, social, and where relevant, linear formats including trade fair and print
* Creating and art directing digital experiences: landing pages, UI concepts, interactive campaign formats
* Maintaining creative quality across global rollouts adapted for up to 16 international markets and languages
* Collaborating directly with Marketing and Product Management, with the professionalism to represent the creative work clearly and confidently



  





**What you bring:** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in advertising or brand communications, with a substantial part of that in an agency environment
* A portfolio that demonstrates both conceptual strength and executional mastery — campaigns you conceived and built, not just approved
* Deep expertise in Figma and Adobe CC; you work in the tools, not around them
* Proven experience in digital campaign production: landing pages, paid social, motion graphics
* Experience in Medical, Health Tech, or Fitness marketing is a significant advantage — you understand that this audience demands precision, not flair for its own sake
* Fluent English, written and spoken — our campaigns are global, our briefs are often in English, and your presentations will be too
* Linear advertising experience (TV, OOH, AV) is a bonus, not a barrier
* The maturity to thrive within a defined creative direction while still bringing your own strong point of view to every brief



  





**What we offer:** 




 We will skip the part about the coffee and the fruit basket. You have read that before. What we can offer that most can not: the creative ambition of an agency environment, inside a company with genuine market authority, a 185\-year legacy that is not a limitation but a creative challenge, and a product portfolio that genuinely affects human health. Your work will reach healthcare professionals across 17 international branches and over 175,000 customers worldwide.
 



  





 Join a workplace that connects, motivates, and moves forward together – where your work has real impact.
 



  





**About seca** 




 Founded in Hamburg in 1840, seca has grown from a precision scale workshop into a global Health Tech brand. For over 185 years, we have built devices and software solutions that help healthcare professionals make better decisions — in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and fitness facilities around the world. As a family\-owned company now in its fourth generation, we operate 17 international branches.
 



  





**Ready to shape international campaigns for a global Health Tech brand?** 
 Apply today and help define how seca communicates across Medical, Fitness, and digital platforms. We look forward to receiving your complete application.
 



  





**Please note that only applications including a relevant portfolio or selected work samples will be considered.**

data.jd_text:
***Summary***




 The Sr. Manager \- Oracle Practice is accountable for the end\-to\-end ownership, governance, and continuous evolution of the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform across Finance (ERP), Procurement, and Human Capital Management (HCM). The role leads the strategy, delivery, and operations of all Fusion modules — partnering with CFO, CHRO, and CPO organizations to translate business priorities into a stable, secure, and value\-generating cloud platform. The incumbent oversees implementation programs, quarterly release management, integrations, support, vendor governance, and a multi\-disciplinary team of functional and technical consultants.
 



  





***Role***




**Strategic \& Governance** 



* Define and own the Oracle Fusion roadmap aligned with enterprise digital strategy and three\-year business plan.
* Establish Fusion governance: steering committee cadence, change advisory board, prioritization framework, and KPIs.
* Manage the annual Fusion budget (OPEX/CAPEX), license optimization, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership.
* Lead vendor governance for Oracle, implementation partners, and managed\-services providers — SLAs, performance reviews, and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure compliance with UAE regulations, IFRS, VAT, WPS, and group internal controls (SOX\-equivalent) within the Fusion environment.



**Finance (ERP) Module Ownership** 



* Own General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Tax, and Intercompany.
* Drive month\-end / year\-end close optimization, financial reporting via OTBI / FRS / Smart View, and consolidations.
* Govern Chart of Accounts, ledger structures, and the Enterprise Structures Configurator.
* Lead enhancements in Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Revenue Management, and Subledger Accounting where applicable.



**Procurement Module Ownership** 



* Own Self\-Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Portal, Supplier Qualification Management, and Procurement Contracts.
* Drive supplier onboarding, sourcing automation (RFx, auctions), and contract compliance.
* Align Fusion Procurement with adjacent platforms (e.g., Primavera Unifier for project tendering and commitments) and ensure clean data handoff between systems.
* Implement approval hierarchies, document categories, and policy controls to enforce procurement governance.



**Human Capital Management (HCM) Module Ownership** 



* Own Core HR, Absence, Talent, Performance, Compensation, Payroll (or Payroll Interface to ADP/Mercans), and Workforce Management.
* Lead annual HR cycles in the system: merit, bonus, talent review, and performance calibration.
* Manage WPS payroll compliance, gratuity calculations, and Emiratization reporting.
* Deploy self\-service experiences (Redwood / Journeys) to improve employee and manager adoption.



**Delivery, Operations \& Integration** 



* Lead implementations, rollouts to new entities, and quarterly Oracle release uptake (impact assessment, regression, go/no\-go).
* Govern integrations through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) with banks, MOHRE, tax authority, BI tools, and other enterprise systems.
* Ensure platform security: role design, SoD analysis, data privacy, and audit readiness.
* Own incident, problem, and change management for Fusion; drive a 99%\+ availability and target SLA adherence.
* Sponsor data quality, master data management, and reconciliation across Finance, Procurement, and HCM.



**People Leadership** 



* Build and develop a high\-performing team of functional consultants, technical developers, and integration engineers.
* Define competency frameworks, certification plans, and career paths for the Fusion practice.
* Foster a product\-mindset, business\-partnership culture inside IT.



  





***Competencies***



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline; Master's/MBA preferred.
* Oracle Cloud certifications in Financials, Procurement, or HCM (Implementation Specialist or higher) strongly preferred.
* CPA / ACCA / CMA, CIPS, or SHRM/CIPD certifications are an advantage.



**Experience** 



* 15\+ years in enterprise applications, with at least 8 years on Oracle Cloud (Fusion) — covering minimum two of Finance, Procurement, HCM end\-to\-end.
* Track record of leading at least two full\-cycle Fusion implementations or major upgrades from EBS / PeopleSoft / JD Edwards / SAP to Oracle Cloud.
* Experience managing multi\-entity, multi\-currency, multi\-jurisdiction deployments (UAE / GCC preferred).
* Demonstrated leadership of teams of 15\+ across functional, technical, and partner resources.
* Industry background in real estate, construction, hospitality, or large diversified groups is a strong plus.



**Technical Competencies** 



* Deep functional knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM data models and configuration.
* Hands\-on familiarity with OIC, FBDI, HDL, HCM Extracts, BI Publisher, OTBI, Fast Formulas, and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of security model, role design, and SoD (Risk Management / Advanced Controls).
* Working knowledge of adjacent Oracle products (Primavera Unifier, EPM, Analytics Cloud) and common integrations (banks, payroll bureaus, regulatory portals).

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**

 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**

* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.

* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.

* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.

**What you will get in return:**

* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.

**Overview**
 This global portfolio operations team is seeking an experienced Executive Director to play a key leadership role within a rapidly growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for originating, evaluating, executing, and managing investments across multiple asset classes while contributing to portfolio strategy, capital allocation decisions, and overall business growth.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership, the Executive Director will lead transaction execution, manage stakeholder relationships, mentor investment professionals, and help shape the long\-term investment strategy of the platform.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Support the development and execution of investment strategy across targeted sectors, geographies, and asset classes
* Identify investment themes, market trends, and emerging opportunities aligned with strategic objectives
* Provide recommendations on capital allocation, portfolio construction, and risk management
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend value creation initiatives


**Deal Origination \& Execution**
* Source and originate investment opportunities through established industry networks and strategic relationships
* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution
* Prepare investment memoranda and present recommendations to senior management and investment committees
* Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, commercial, and financial advisors throughout transaction processes


**Asset Management \& Value Creation**
* Work closely with portfolio companies, operating partners, and management teams to drive performance improvement and strategic initiatives
* Support business transformation, operational optimisation, growth strategies, and capital planning across investments
* Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and report on portfolio developments


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, financial institutions, advisors, developers, operators, and strategic partners
* Represent the organisation in negotiations, industry events, and key stakeholder meetings
* Mentor and develop junior investment professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with finance, legal, risk, treasury, and business leadership teams


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure all investments adhere to internal governance frameworks, investment policies, and risk management standards
* Present investment opportunities and portfolio updates to governance committees and senior leadership
* Maintain high standards of compliance, transparency, and fiduciary responsibility


**Skills \& Experience**
**Essential Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related discipline
* 12\-18\+ years of relevant experience in private equity, sovereign wealth funds, investment management, principal investing, infrastructure, real estate, private credit, or investment banking
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions from origination through execution
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis capabilities
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to investment committees and boards
* Excellent commercial judgement and strategic thinking skills
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing teams
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience investing across real estate, infrastructure, private equity, credit, or alternative investments
* Exposure to large\-scale investment platforms and institutional capital deployment
* Experience operating in international markets with strong understanding of regional investment dynamics
* Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast\-paced environment


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to shape investment strategy and drive value creation across multiple asset classes within a rapidly growing platform. The role provides significant exposure to senior leadership, complex transaction execution, and the chance to mentor and develop investment professionals while contributing to long\-term strategic objectives.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

**Our Purpose**

**Title And Summary**
 Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard’s Transfer Solutions team in EEMEA is driving at scale innovation and growth to meet today’s demands for simple, certain, and secure international and domestic payments by individuals and businesses of all sizes. Mastercard Move is a portfolio of integrated assets and capabilities designed to service key verticals, customer segments and multiple payment flows. Through simple connectivity means, we enable partners the ability to reach a variety of endpoints—account, card, mobile wallet, cards and cash out locations —nearly anywhere in the world.
   

  

 The organization is looking for a Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance), Mastercard Move as part of the EEMEA Product Management Team for Cross Border Payments, to work with customers, who are primarily large Financial Institutions, Fin Techs, Bureau De Changes / Exchange Houses or Government Clearing Schemes to further the strategic and commercial agenda of Mastercard in the region focused on Cross Border Payments, which includes Low Value B2B / Commercial Payments, P2P Remittances and Purpose\-based payments like Bill Payments, Tuition Payments, Utility, Social Security etc.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is aware of the Cross\-Border Payments landscape and is aware of the intricate dynamics of how money moves between Institutions and Borders, being familiar with the role Correspondent and Bilateral Banking arrangements play in the setup, the evolving nature of SWIFT (and its evolution to ISO messaging standards), existing Settlement \& Funding mediums, helping to identify the gaps and solutionize areas where Mastercard’s own and partner led solutions can add value.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* This is a Pricing and Assurance role at its heart where you will work with Product Sales teams / Account Managers to ensure we are able to provide best commercial value to our customers alongside safeguarding long\-term financial interests for the company.
* Often, you would work with customers directly to help them formulate the right value story / financial model to ensure the product is able to provide the best Value Proposition to our clients and their customers.
* Prepare / facilitate complex business cases within Mastercard at a customer / deal / portfolio level to ensure the right investments / financial support / prioritization is done for opportunities worth the merit.
* Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle for the business, and partner with Finance colleagues upstream and Sales colleagues downstream to ensure we can project and hit the business numbers.
* Formulate and track underlying business driver and enabler metrics on weekly / fortnightly / monthly level with cross\-functional teams – including delivery timelines, growth rates etc. as relevant.
* Executive presentation outlining business direction and facilitation of QBR / MBR with senior leaders and often with strategic clients. Partner for strategy refresh cycles to evaluate what’s working v/s not.
* Act as PMO for key internal work\-streams which affects revenue realization – like Network health and breadth, FX constructs, Deal Incentive structures etc.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Understands cross\-border payments at its’ core and the lever(s) that influence the commercial health of the product and the business at large.
* Understanding of financial and reporting principles of key metrices that influence business development.
* Be able to work horizontally in a highly matrixed organization with overlapping ownership and influence. Be able to get the work done through influence, reasoning rather than authority.
* Very strong with Excel and PowerPoint as that would effectively be 70% of your work – pricing, governance, reporting.
* Strong communicator and have the temperament to be able to lead client facing conversations independently.
* If you have done a pricing role in the past in the industry – it’s a plus. Product FP\&A candidates may also be fit with extension.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Commodities (Metals), Equities \& Derivatives

 We are seeking a highly experienced Head of Trading Strategy \& Operations to oversee and strengthen the operational and strategic infrastructure supporting the firm’s trading activities across base metals, commodities, equities, and derivatives markets. The role combines trading operations leadership with close involvement in market analysis, trading strategy coordination, execution oversight, and risk\-focused operational management. This position is suited to an individual with strong operational expertise, commercial acumen, and a sophisticated understanding of global base metals and commodity markets within fast\-moving trading environments.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 •Lead and oversee trading operations across physical base metals, commodity derivatives, and equities activities.

 •Manage relationships with brokers, FCMs, banks, exchanges, and trading counterparties.
 



 •Supervise margin, collateral, funding, and liquidity management processes.
 



 •Oversee operational reporting including exposures, MTM, P\&L support, and trading control frameworks.
 



 •Drive process improvement, automation initiatives, and operational scalability across the trading platform.
 



 •Build and lead a high\-performing trading operations team with strong accountability and governance standards.
 



 •Ensure robust operational risk controls and institutional best practices are maintained across all trading activities.
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 •10\+ years of experience within commodity trading, derivatives operations, trading strategy support, or trading desk management environments.
 



 •Strong experience and understanding of base metals markets, commodity derivatives, and physical\-to\-paper hedging dynamics.
 



 •Demonstrated experience supporting or operating within base metals trading environments is essential.
 



 •Strong understanding of futures, options, OTC products, exchange\-traded instruments, and market structure.
 



 •Demonstrated ability to operate closely alongside senior trading stakeholders within active trading environments.
 



 •Strong commercial judgment with the ability to interpret market developments, trading risks, and execution considerations.
 



 •Experience within commodity trading houses, investment banks, hedge funds, brokers, or FCMs preferred.

**Director of Marketing \& Business Development – Health, Wellness** 




**Relocation to Chiang Mai, Thailand** 




**$100,000 \+ Negotiable based on experience** 




**Seeking candidates with experience of driving medical tourism** 




  





**The Organisation** 




  





 This is a rare opportunity to join one of Asia's most established and respected residential rehabilitation groups — an organisation with a 10 year\+ heritage of transforming lives, treating thousands of clients from more than 20 countries, and building a reputation as the premium destination of choice for individuals seeking discreet, high\-quality addiction and mental health care.
 



  





 The business operates a flagship 30\-bed residential site and has recently expanded into Europe with a specialist 10\-bed programme — reflecting an ambitious international growth agenda under the leadership of a highly experienced CEO with a background in world\-class medical tourism operations.
 



  





 The model is built on medical tourism: clients travel from the UK, Australia, the Middle East, Singapore, the Netherlands, the US, and Canada to access a programme that delivers demonstrably better outcomes at approximately 40% of the cost of comparable UK providers — with private rooms, comprehensive clinical programming, and a destination environment that facilitates genuine recovery.
 



  





 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. Your role is to lead, elevate, and execute — bringing strategic rigour, digital expertise, and commercial edge to a business that has earned its reputation through exceptional clinical outcomes and now needs to accelerate its market presence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and deliver revenue performance across all markets and service lines
* Lead the Admissions function to ensure a seamless, high\-conversion client journey
* Expand the international referral network — outpatient centres, clinicians, concierge providers, and wellness operators
* Develop targeted growth strategies across the UK, Australia, Asia, Middle East, and US
* Represent the organisation at international forums and industry events



  





**Marketing \& Digital Acquisition** 



* Lead the internal marketing team and external agency partners
* Drive performance across online search, AI\-driven discovery platforms, SEO, and digital channels
* Own the content strategy across all pillars: search, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and thought leadership
* Improve visibility on AI discovery platforms where the business is currently underrepresented
* Maintain rigorous oversight of ROI, attribution, and brand integrity



  





**Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care
* Lead content creation that reflects the business's evolution toward holistic, nervous system\-informed, mental health\-integrated approaches
* Ensure a consistent, premium brand voice across all touchpoints and markets
* Strengthen trust through PR, media, strategic partnerships, and expert positioning



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 The successful candidate will be hands\-on, hungry, and commercially sharp — someone who leads by doing, not just by directing. You will be as comfortable shaping content strategy as you are reviewing conversion data or meeting a clinical referral partner.
 



  





**You will bring:** 



* Demonstrable experience leading Sales and/or Marketing functions at Director level in a healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or international services environment
* Deep expertise in digital marketing — particularly SEO, AI\-driven discovery, content strategy, and omnichannel acquisition
* Proven track record working with and holding external agency partners accountable
* Experience serving or acquiring high\-net\-worth, international, or premium client bases
* Strong people leadership — able to develop and motivate a small, technically skilled team
* Exceptional written English — essential for content oversight and brand governance given a non\-native English speaking team
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to work sensitively within a healthcare environment that includes staff and clients in recovery
* The ability to read and align to a brand's heritage, tone, and values — and build strategically from that foundation



  





**Highly desirable:** 



* Background in addiction treatment, mental health, or international patient services
* Lived recovery experience — genuinely valued, not required
* Prior experience living or working in Asia, or demonstrable international living experience
* Familiarity with medical tourism as a business model and client acquisition channel



  





**The Package \& Location** 




  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Base salary: \~$100,000 USD per annum
* 25 days combined annual leave
* Relocation flights to Thailand covered
* Temporary housing provided on arrival (2–4 weeks)
* Visa sponsorship and application support provided
* Results\-focused role — effectiveness prioritised over hours



**Why Chiang Mai?** 



* Low cost of living — $100k USD goes significantly further than UK equivalent
* Lower Thai income tax rates — take\-home substantially higher than UK
* Vibrant international expat community and thriving lifestyle
* World\-class food, culture, and outdoor environment

 To be considered for this role, in the first instance contact scousins@compassltd.co.uk with a detailed CV. Please note we will only consider candidates with direct experience of driving referrals from an international patient/customer base

**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview**
 BlackRock Aladdin business is uniquely positioned to address the industry’s investment management and financial technology demands. The various business departments within Aladdin entity are focused on providing clients with highly scalable end to end investment management solutions for both Public and Private markets. The Aladdin Client Business (ACB) entity is effectively responsible for growing the Aladdin business with our existing external clients, implementing our solutions and managing the relationship \& services across the lifetime of our clients.
   

  

 The role sits within our Aladdin Client Engagement team that is responsible for expanding our footprint withing our existing client base as well as minimizing churn and providing best in class user experience on our technologies: user adoption, value delivery and client satisfaction are key objectives for our teams. The successful candidate will be an integral part of the Client Engagement team and will assume a Client Relationship Manager position, servicing our clients across a range of activities including relationship management, business development, churn prevention and value delivery. The candidate must have a solid finger pulse of the client’s entire organization and be imbedded into the client’s key Decision Makers and Business leaders to drive adoption and growth. BlackRock as a firm expects significant growth in the Middle East region and the successful candidate will be an integral part of the local team who will be going to make this possible.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and establish strong relationships with clients based in the Middle East and represent all of BlackRock in a compelling fashion.
* Liaise with the clients’ key stakeholders and provide strong leadership for the Aladdin and eFront relationships. Specifically tasked to build senior connectivity within our client base. Develop a strong working relationship with clients to promote adoption of our technologies, including developing training and marketing materials for client use.
* Develop strong relationships with all groups within BlackRock Aladdin and BlackRock to ensure an excellent client experience and convey client requirements to product teams as necessary.
* Work with local Business Development, implementation, and asset management teams to build an integrated single client experience.
* Coordinate with our Support organization and our Product Management \& Engineering organization to provide best service to clients.
* In charge of client management across Public \& Private asset classes
* Clients are large to medium sized SWFs, Asset Managers, Pensions Funds and Family offices
* Manage the relationship with clients with 3 major objectives:
* Expand footprint, prevent revenue attrition and ensure client satisfaction
* Regular travel in the region is required.


**Skills And Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess some combination of all the following:
   

  

* Fluent in English, Arabic is a plus.
* 10 years \+ in the Fintech industry (as a client, in a consulting company, with a technology provider)
* Uncovers and meets the need of external clients; builds strong working partnerships with clients and internal organization; acts with urgency and works hard to address client demands; effectively manages clients’ expectations and delivers value\-added service; Capable to manage client relationship from tactical/operational to strategic.
* Deep knowledge of capital markets – both public and private; she/he understands the business, financial and technical terminology, including how organizations operate, compete, profit and grow. Keeps abreast of developments in own field and considers how this knowledge can be applied.
* Technologically “aware” to be conversant with clients and visualize opportunities. Technology knowledge is important, but a deep skillset is not necessary.
* Demonstrated experience successfully leading strategic initiatives within a global organization.
* Committed to gaining relevant knowledge, skills and experience in commercial markets; utilizes market expertise and savvy to leverage this role; stays passionate about the business and maintains current knowledge about competitor products and services.
* Strong project management, coordination, problem solving/analytical thinking.
* Superior communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts simply and clearly to clients. Capable of connecting with multiple audiences and articulating lines of reasoning
* Ability to operate as a self\-starter, operating with limited guidance in a highly matrixed organization.
* Enjoy a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment; able to manage multiple priorities.
* Proven track record in managing clients (harvesting, churn, client satisfaction)
* Comfortable working in diverse and multi\-cultural environment
* Used to manage her/his business and report with data \& analytics


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well\-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock \| Twitter: @blackrock \| LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

( 20117 )
   

  

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Following our mission of enriching lives by connecting people, places and meaningful experiences, Kerzner International has created iconic destination resorts, luxury hotels, and private homes. With the continuous expansion of our portfolio, we are looking for Revenue Management professionals who are willing to relocate to Southern Europe/Eastern Europe region for a property\-based role.
   

  

 Cluster Director of Revenue Management across Kerzner International properties will be responsible for executing the implementation of the strategic long\-term Total Revenue Plan into actionable results that directly affect properties’ performance for Rooms, Food and Beverage, Spa, Retail and other Revenue Centers. The role is based on\-site and oversees multiple properties, reporting to the General Manager, with a dotted line to Global Revenue Team in Dubai.
   

  

**Key duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
* Further develop the property distribution platform by identifying best solution for CRS/GDS and ensuring available revenue management technology is fully utilized and understood according to property specific business mix and requirements
* Ensure optimal use, and measure performance on all distribution channels, to ensure that fair market share is achieved if not surpassed
* Assist the Sales \& Marketing Team in devising marketing campaigns, to ensure that the Hotel reaches the right source markets, at the right time, in the right place
* Monitor competitor availability and pricing and subsequently analyze \& report actual performance versus competitive set.
* Implement pricing strategies, yield strategies, selling strategies and revenue management best practices; investigate and communicate new ways to capture optimal revenue potentials.
* Develop \& implement rationally related pricing structures for Direct, Wholesale, Groups \& Corporate with cohesive synergies between the segments.
* Understand the dynamics of the Global, National, Regional \& Local Political and Economic Market, local Competitors and all demand generators for the destination.
* Carry out analysis of Booking Patterns \& Market Trends and ensure that these are recorded to facilitate future decisions.
* Conduct annual revenue management audits for all revenue generating departments.
* Drive Projects related to revenue management.


**We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate the below skills and qualities:**
* at least 5 years in similar position within luxury hospitality, ideally in a relevant 5 star property based capacity
* fluency with revenue management essential systems and online tools (STR Portal, Opera PMS, Infor Vision, Bi\-Tools, Rate Shopping Tools)
* Advanced CRS and channel management systems knowledge
* Bachelor’s in Hospitality/Finance/Revenue Management, or any related field
* full working proficiency in English and ability to effectively communicate with all levels in the organization


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who We Are?**
 When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.
   

  

 Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!
   

  

 Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* Owns regional value creation, translating strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives with measurable impact.
* Leads complex, cross\-market programs, ensuring rigorous project management, senior\-level alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Establishes scalable commercial frameworks, enabling consistent decision\-making while preserving local market flexibility.
* Drives insight\-led decisions through advanced analytics, turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Shapes executive dialogue, influencing stakeholders through structured communication and fact\-based narratives.
* Deploys technology as a performance lever, improving productivity, transparency, and speed to impact.
* Builds durable capabilities, strengthening commercial skill sets across teams and markets.
* Responsible for driving long\-term growth plans, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure success.


**What's On Your Plate?**
* Applies a strong understanding of industry trends and internal business processes to adapt strategies to changing market conditions.
* Develops frameworks that address regional challenges by combining market insights, competitor analysis, and operational considerations.
* Leads financial and operational performance at the regional level by optimizing pricing, promotions, and product offerings.
* Drives improvements by implementing tools and practices that enhance efficiency and business outcomes.
* Builds and develops a high\-performing regional commercial team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Supports succession planning by mentoring senior managers and aligning team skills with business objectives.
* Partners with other functions to deliver cohesive strategies and ensure smooth cross\-departmental coordination.
* Directly influences business growth through initiatives like optimizing commercial processes, improving market penetration, and enhancing customer retention strategies.
* Provides critical support to cross\-functional teams, ensuring alignment between commercial goals and overall company objectives


**What Did We Order?**
* Problem Solving: Resolves complex business challenges by using data\-driven analysis and developing innovative solutions. Handles critical decisions such as market entry strategies, pricing adjustments, and operational improvements with a focus on sustainable results. implements processes that empower teams to identify and address challenges independently.
* Interpersonal Skills: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior executives, cross\-functional leaders, and external partners, to ensure alignment on key strategies and objectives. Communicates complex business challenges and solutions effectively, tailoring the message to different audiences to gain alignment and drive informed decision\-making. Excels in influencing and persuading stakeholders to adopt strategies that drive long\-term business success, using a combination of data\-driven insights and a deep understanding of market dynamics. Cultivates high\-performing teams by fostering collaboration, empowering team members, and creating an environment that encourages innovation and accountability

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly capable PMO Manager to lead the project management office for a real estate developer in Riyadh.
   

  

 The PMO Manager will oversee the full development delivery cycle: feasibility support, design management, consultant and contractor coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement tracking, risk management, project reporting, handover, and close\-out.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and manage PMO governance, reporting standards, project controls, templates, and approval workflows across the development portfolio
* Monitor projects from design stage through construction, handover, and final close\-out on behalf of the developer
* Prepare executive dashboards and weekly/monthly reports covering project progress, cost, cash flow, risks, design status, procurement, variations, sales readiness, and key decisions required
* Verify actual site progress through regular site inspections and independent validation, rather than relying solely on contractor reports
* Control approved budgets, BOQs, commitments, variations, forecasts, and cost\-to\-complete for each project
* Track master schedules, identify delays early, assess recovery plans, and escalate critical risks to management
* Lead coordination between development, design, finance, procurement, sales, legal, consultants, contractors, and government\-related stakeholders
* Review design deliverables, consultant outputs, BOQs, specifications, tender packages, and construction documentation for completeness before execution
* Monitor consultant and contractor performance against their contractual scope, deliverables, milestones, quality requirements, and approved budgets
* Maintain project risk registers, issue logs, decision trackers, action plans, and mitigation measures
* Support tender evaluations, consultant and contractor appointments, variation reviews, claims assessments, and project close\-out
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with approved product positioning, financial objectives, delivery timelines, and quality standards
* Identify operational gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accountability, reporting quality, and delivery performance


**Requirements**
**Mandatory Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline
* Minimum 8 years of total experience in real estate development, project management, project controls, or construction delivery
* Minimum 3 years of direct experience working for a real estate developer / owner / master developer is mandatory
* Demonstrated experience managing residential, mixed\-use, commercial, or hospitality development projects from the developer side
* Proven experience in managing consultants, contractors, design coordination, budgets, BOQs, procurement, variations, project schedules, and handover
* Strong understanding of the full real estate development lifecycle, not only construction execution
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting/dashboard tools
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, cash\-flow tracking, cost forecasting, and variation control
* Experience establishing or working within PMO governance frameworks, including project controls, reporting standards, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and stage\-gate processes
* Experience in project scheduling, critical\-path analysis, recovery planning, progress measurement, and executive reporting
* Experience with tender evaluation, procurement planning, variation assessment, and contractor performance monitoring
* Business\-fluent English
* Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
* Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate
* Able to conduct regular site visits across active development and construction projects in Riyadh
* Able to work in both office and construction\-site environments
* Able to attend project meetings, inspections, and site walks as required
* Proficient in using a laptop and standard Microsoft Office tools for day\-to\-day work
* Able to work effectively with digital project documentation, drawings, BOQs, schedules, and cloud\-based collaboration platforms


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PMI\-SP, PMI\-RMP, RICS, Primavera, or equivalent certification
* Experience with project management systems, ERP platforms, or real estate development software
* Experience managing multiple projects or a development portfolio simultaneously
* Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration, preferred for engineering\-degree holders
* Availability to join within 30 to 60 days is a plus


**What We Are Looking For**
* A developer\-side PMO professional who understands the owner's commercial, technical, and delivery priorities
* Someone who can challenge consultants and contractors constructively and protect the developer's interests
* A hands\-on manager with strong site awareness, disciplined reporting, and the ability to identify issues before they become delays or cost overruns
* A leader who can create accountability across internal teams and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage
* Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities

Lead the City Technology Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for portfolio governance, delivery assurance, demand intake, stage\-gate control, and operational readiness across all IT and OT technology towers within QIC City Technology.
   

  

 This role ensures that City Technology programs and vendors deliver technology solutions in a controlled, auditable manner, and that all deliverables meet defined governance requirements for readiness, documentation, cybersecurity gating, and transition into
 **technology L2/L3 support** 
 .
   

  

 The PMO acts as the control tower for all City Technology projects transitioning into run\-state operations.
   

  

**Reporting Line**
 Reports to:
 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**
**Direct Reports:** 
 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts
   

  

**Role Scope (City Technology Only)**
**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)
* City OT \& Smart Systems technology
* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls
* Integrated Program Controls
* Maintain an integrated view of City Technology delivery progress across towers and suppliers
* Track delivery milestones, critical path items, and cross\-tower dependencies
* Identify schedule slippage, scope creep, and delivery risk early and escalate through governance forums
* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)
* Govern and enforce delivery stage gates, including:
* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support
* Ensure no system progresses through gates without evidence and sign\-offs


**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)
* Own RAID governance standards across all City Technology delivery programs
* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers
* Vendor Delivery \& Handover Governance Support (non\-commercial)
* Ensure vendors comply with City Technology Delivery \& Handover Governance requirements:
+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

* Provide delivery performance evidence to:
+ Commercials/Vendor Management function (for contract governance)
+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

* Alignment to Governance, Architecture, and Cybersecurity
* Ensure delivery programs comply with:
+ corporate technology governance processes (where applicable)
+ City Technology governance and architecture standards
+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements
+ Track and report exceptions and required waivers through the correct forums


**Key Interfaces**
**Internal:**
* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function
* Director — City Technology Operations (City) (for transition readiness alignment only)
* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**
* Define acceptance criteria for transition from Project to Operations
* Ensure support documentation, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs and vendor contracts are in place
* Validate security hardening and compliance sign\-offs
* Coordinate CAB approvals and go\-live governance
* Confirm training and knowledge transfer completion


**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**
* Track total technology investment portfolio (CAPEX and transformation OPEX)
* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**
* Engage Directors across all City Technology tower
* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required
* Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification preferred
* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

data.jd_text:
Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 Join one of Riyadh’s most ambitious mixed\-use development programmes, spanning more than 200 projects across cultural and heritage assets, hospitality, retail, commercial, and education. This is a rare opportunity to play a leading commercial role on a high\-profile programme that is helping shape one of the region’s most significant destinations.
   

  

 As PMO Masterplan Commercial Lead, you will take a pivotal role in shaping and leading programme\-wide commercial management and cost reporting across a complex, fast\-paced environment. We are looking for a senior commercial professional who combines strong quantity surveying and commercial leadership with advanced data and analytics capability, and who can turn complex information into clear, insightful reporting that supports executive decision\-making.
   

  

 If you are motivated by scale, complexity and impact, and want to help drive commercial excellence on a flagship programme, this is an outstanding opportunity to make your mark with Mace.
   

  

**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Lead the commercial team in delivering programme\-wide commercial management and cost reporting, reporting directly to the Commercial Director.
* Develop and enhance the cost and commercial reporting framework, including requirements, reporting cadence and outputs across key control areas.
* Budget management, Cost planning and benchmarking, Monthly cost reporting, Contract and procurement status reporting, Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including executive and C\-suite leaders, to support successful delivery of the cost and commercial function.
* Support the implementation of new systems, processes and reporting solutions to improve commercial visibility and control. Implementation of programme cost management systems, Development of cost reports and dashboards.
* Own quality assurance and quality control for cost and commercial information, ensuring accuracy, consistency and confidence in reporting.
* Provide commercial service to the related programme with key deliverables like Commercial Monthly presentation to the client’s C suite.
* Drive service excellence across all aspects of PMO commercial reporting.
* Lead, manage and develop the commercial team to deliver high standards of performance. Providing guidance, direction and support decision making for their line.
* Oversee and support the development and maintenance of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) frameworks.
* Coordinate commercial processes with wider PMO and functional leads to ensure alignment across the programme.
* Prepare clear, insightful ad hoc reporting and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PMO functions on contractual deliverables, coordinating the commercial effort to meet client commitments.
* Provide oversight and governance across cost planning, benchmarking, cost reporting, cashflow reporting, procurement, contract reporting and claims reporting.

 📍 الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية \| دوام كامل
 



  





 عن شور
 



 شور منصة صحية رقمية متكاملة تربط بين الطب الاتصالي، المختبرات، الرعاية المنزلية، والصيدلية الرقمية تحت سقف واحد — برؤية تتماشى مع مستهدفات رؤية 2030 في القطاع الصحي. نعمل بشراكة استراتيجية مع شبكة مختبرات رائدة (77 فرع) لتوسيع نطاق الوصول للخدمات الصحية في المملكة.
 



 الدور
 



 نبحث عن مدير تشغيل يقود التوسع التشغيلي لشور عبر شبكة الفروع، ويضمن جودة التنفيذ اليومي وانضباط مؤشرات الأداء، بالتنسيق المباشر مع فريق القيادة.
 



 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 



  




* الإشراف على خطة تفعيل الفروع وتوسيعها بشكل تدريجي ومنظم

* تطوير وتحسين العمليات التشغيلية اليومية (SOPs) لضمان جودة الخدمة
* متابعة مؤشرات الأداء التشغيلي (KPIs) وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة
* التنسيق مع الشريك الاستراتيجي (المختبرات) لحل أي تعارضات تشغيلية
* المساهمة في حل المشكلات التشغيلية بسرعة وكفاءة لدعم نمو الشركة



 المؤهلات المطلوبة
 



  




* خبةة لاتقل عن ١٠ سنوات في إدارة العمليات، ويُفضّل خبرة في القطاع الصحي أو الستارت أب
* مهارات تنظيمية قوية وقدرة على إدارة فرق متعددة في مواقع مختلفة
* القدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة التغيّر مع موارد محدودة
* إجادة العربية والإنجليزية
* شخصية قيادية، حاسمة، وتتحمل ضغط بيئة النمو السريع
