data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will be responsible for providing overall leadership, strategic direction, and execution oversight for the conventional railway and freight rail project from award through delivery. The role requires a seasoned delivery leader with extensive experience in major conventional rail and freight rail infrastructure projects, with the ability to direct multidisciplinary teams, manage stakeholder and client relationships, oversee complex interfaces, and drive successful outcomes across all phases of delivery in line with schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational objectives
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead the overall planning, execution, and delivery of the railway project.
* Provide strategic and operational leadership across all project functions.
* Manage project delivery performance with a focus on schedule, cost, quality, safety, and risk.
* Oversee multidisciplinary teams including engineering, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the client, consultants, authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and company standards.
* Drive project governance, reporting, decision\-making, and performance management processes.
* Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, and issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support bid\-stage planning, methodology development, staffing strategy, and delivery planning as required.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support successful project execution.
* Ensure a strong culture of HSE, quality assurance, and operational excellence across the project.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 25 years of total experience in large\-scale infrastructure and construction projects.
* Mandatory prior experience in conventional railway and freight rail projects.
* Proven project delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from initiation to completion.
* Prior experience in a Project Director or similarly senior leadership role, ideally on major conventional and freight railway projects.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of project management principles, contract administration, commercial management, and project controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, multicultural, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent client management, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of HSE, quality, risk, and compliance requirements for major projects, including conventional and freight railway systems.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Job description:
   

  

**About Us** 

 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.  
 



  
 


**Line of Service Overview** 

 At PwC Consulting, you’ll shape strategies that redefine industries and drive national visions. We partner with leaders to deliver transformative solutions in enterprise strategy, digital innovation, operational excellence, cyber resilience, and risk management. Join a community that values bold thinking, collaboration, and measurable impact—where your expertise accelerates change and creates lasting value. 
 



  
 


**Business Unit Overview** 

 The Strategy \& Transformation business unit brings together purpose\-driven teams and deep sector expertise to address the region’s most pressing priorities. From shaping national visions and enabling economic resilience to advancing Cities, sustainable destinations, and future\-ready industries, we work across a diverse portfolio of sectors including Cities, Government \& Public Sector, Destinations, Energy, Resources \& Sustainability, Financial Services, Technology, Media \& Telecommunications, Health Sectors, and Transportation \& Logistics to deliver meaningful, measurable impact.
 



  
 


**How You’ll Contribute** 

 As a Director within the Cities sector, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 


* Lead vertical proposition in the municipal sector, i.e. inspection, Permitting, etc
* Create a case for change with measurable impact and outcomes.
* Bridge strategy to execution – translate high\-level vision into customized solutions, actionable roadmaps, operating models, and transformation initiatives across smart cities, municipal services, and urban governance.
* Own executive\-level client relationships – build trusted partnerships with public sector stakeholders, navigating complex environments with credibility, insight, and confidence.
* Direct complex, multi\-workstream programs – lead large\-scale city transformation engagements end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery excellence across scope, timelines, budgets, and quality.
* Drive growth and shape the market – expand PwC’s Cities offering by developing differentiated propositions, contributing to bids, and identifying opportunities across municipalities, giga\-projects, and government entities.
* Lead and inspire high\-performing teams – build, mentor, and develop consulting teams, fostering a collaborative and high\-energy environment where people are motivated to deliver their best.


**What You’ll Bring** 
* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Urban Planning, Public Policy, or a related field; Master’s preferred.
* 13\+ years of experience in consulting, with a strong focus on municipalities, or development authorities.
* Deep expertise in municipal transformation, urban development, and city services.
* Proven experience working with municipalities, ministries, authorities, or national programs.
* Demonstrated leadership of large, complex, multi\-workstream engagements, with ownership of client relationships, delivery, and commercial outcomes.
* Commercial and growth mindset – experience in business development, proposal shaping, and expanding client accounts.
* Vision \& Strategic Influence – ability to connect city transformation initiatives to broader economic, social, and digital agendas.
* Excellent command of English; Arabic fluency highly desirable to deepen regional collaboration and influence.



  
 


**How You’ll Make a Difference** 

 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.  
 



  
 


**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC** 

 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

**Location \-** 
 Al Khobar/Riyadh
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The KSA Buildings \& Infrastructure (B\&I) Director is responsible for leading, growing, and elevating Bureau Veritas’ B\&I portfolio across the region. This strategic leadership role oversees the full product line performance—shaping the long‑term vision, delivering the annual P\&L, and ensuring excellence across all operations.
   

  

 The Director drives topline and gross margin delivery in close partnership with regional leadership, steering commercial strategy, optimizing delivery models, and ensuring high‑quality, efficient, and client‑centric execution. The role leads multidisciplinary teams across
 **Asset Management, Infrastructure Technical Inspections, Project \& Program Management, Environmental Services, and Commissioning** 
 , ensuring cohesive, high‑value solutions for clients.
   

  

 The Director also strengthens BV’s market presence across major sectors including
 **Hospitality, Entertainment, Tourism, Mega Projects, Developers, Contractors, Government Authorities, Urban Development, Smart Cities, Transportation Infrastructure, and Aviation** 
 , building trusted relationships and expanding BV’s impact on safe, sustainable, and resilient built environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement the regional B\&I growth strategy aligned with regional and global Product Line priorities.
* Drive portfolio expansion, commercial performance, and market penetration across all B\&I service domains.
* Lead the annual budgeting cycle and manage end‑to‑end P\&L accountability for revenue, sales, and gross margin.
* Ensure delivery quality in line with BV’s Operational Excellence standards and performance KPIs.
* Oversee regional commercial activities and support major pursuits, tenders, and key account development.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key customers across priority sectors.
* Lead operational governance through structured meetings, reviews, and performance follow‑up.
* Coach and develop teams, drive a high‑performance culture, and lead recruitment and performance assessments.
* Collaborate with Product Line and Area leadership to build a strong B\&I talent pipeline.
* Uphold BV’s Core Values, Code of Ethics, and the 3 Absolutes.
* Ensure rigorous compliance with BV procedures for technical governance, risk, and quality.


**Core Competencies**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Strategic thinker with strong decision‑making, accountability, and change‑leadership capability.
* Effective people leader who empowers teams and navigates matrix environments with ease.


**Commercial \& Client Excellence**
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to drive growth across diverse B\&I markets, including Transportation Infrastructure and Aviation.
* Skilled at long‑term client relationship development and key account management.


**Operational Excellence**
* Proven ability to ensure consistent quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Experience managing complex, multi‑disciplinary programs.


**Technical \& Market Insight**
* Solid understanding of B\&I service lines including inspections, commissioning, and asset management.
* Strong knowledge of regional standards, regulations, and industry dynamics across built‑environment and infrastructure sectors.


**Personal Attributes**
* High integrity, resilient, client‑centric, with strong communication and stakeholder influence.

* Foster a strong client relationship by consistently delivering exceptional service and acting as the primary point of contact.
* Build and manage high\-performing multidisciplinary teams, ensuring collaboration and accountability.
* Ensure assigned projects are completed within budget and schedule, while meeting client requirements and business objectives.
* Oversee all aspects of project execution, including design management, construction supervision, cost control, and stakeholder engagement.
* Provide strategic leadership and guidance throughout the full project lifecycle.
* Drive innovation, sustainability, and digital best practices in project delivery.
* Represent WSP at senior\-level meetings and within broader industry forums as required.


**Qualifications/Experience**

* A degree in a discipline suited to the work to be delivered, with the ability to converse in technical matters across all disciplines associated with our Construction Supervision projects.

* Working for an international consultancy for 20\+ years and over 5 years of experience in the Middle East.

* Proven experience in managing large\-scale tunnelling and hospitality projects, with a deep understanding of the technical aspects involved.

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Project Controls Manager – Utility Compounds is responsible for establishing and leading all project controls functions (planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change, and reporting) across one or more utility compounds and associated infrastructure works. This role provides strategic oversight and assurance that scope, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved, while maintaining robust governance, transparent reporting, and proactive risk management for complex, multi‑contract utility developments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Controls Leadership**
* Lead the project controls strategy and implementation for utility compound programs.
* Develop and maintain integrated project controls plans, aligning schedule, cost, risk, change, and reporting processes with corporate and client requirements.
* Provide expert guidance to project managers, engineers, and commercial teams on project controls best practices.
* Ensure consistency and standardization of project controls procedures across all contracts and work packages.


**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Establish, review, and approve baseline schedules in collaboration with planning engineers and project leads.
* Integrate multiple contractor and internal schedules into a single program\-level master schedule.
* Monitor schedule performance, analyze critical paths, float, and interfaces between utility compounds and wider network works.
* Lead schedule risk analysis and scenario planning to assess and mitigate potential delays.
* Review contractors’ recovery plans and assess their viability.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Develop and manage project budgets, cash flow forecasts, and cost control frameworks for utility compounds.
* Oversee cost tracking, commitment control, and monthly cost/value reconciliations.
* Lead cost forecasting and estimate\-at\-completion reviews, ensuring alignment with schedule and risk.
* Identify cost variances, trends, and opportunities for savings; recommend corrective and optimizing measures.


**Change \& Risk Management**
* Set up and manage robust change control processes, including impact assessments on scope, time, cost, and risk.
* Chair or support change control boards, ensuring timely review, approval, and documentation of changes.
* Establish and maintain project risk registers, facilitating risk identification, qualitative/quantitative assessment, and mitigation planning.
* Coordinate schedule and cost risk analyses and integrate results into forecasts and management reporting.


**Performance Measurement \& Reporting**
* Implement earned value management or equivalent performance measurement techniques.
* Define and monitor KPIs for schedule adherence, cost performance, productivity, and change/risk effectiveness.
* Produce clear, concise monthly and ad‑hoc project controls reports for senior management, clients, and stakeholders.
* Provide early warning on emerging issues and propose data‑driven mitigation and recovery strategies.


**Data, Systems \& Governance**
* Oversee configuration and use of project controls tools (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, cost management and reporting systems).
* Ensure data integrity, version control, and alignment between planning, cost, and reporting systems.
* Develop and maintain project controls procedures, templates, and standards tailored to utility compound delivery.
* Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with company governance and client requirements.


**Stakeholder \& Interface Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for project controls matters with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal leadership.
* Coordinate interfaces between utility compounds and related packages (transmission/distribution, MEP systems, building works, enabling works).
* Present project status, trends, and recommendations in steering committees, progress meetings, and executive reviews.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of planners, cost engineers, risk analysts, and reporting specialists.
* Allocate resources effectively across projects and phases, ensuring adequate coverage for critical milestones.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the project controls function.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 15 years experience in project controls with at least 5 – 10 years on major construction or infrastructure projects, with significant exposure to utilities or industrial compounds.
* Demonstrated experience leading project controls on complex, multi‑contract programs from initiation through closeout.
* Strong understanding of planning, cost control, risk management, change control, and EVM principles.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or Business.
* Professional certification such as , , , , or equivalent.
* Experience in power / utilities (substations, utility hubs, process plants, or similar compound\-type developments).

The advisor will provide graduate\-level papers, executive summaries, and briefings to the Commander and senior leadership, as well as facilitate timely and comprehensive coordination with external agencies.
   

  

 The Senior Executive Advisor will support the RSAF Commander by:
   

  

* Providing advice on the operational procedures and transformation initiatives for the RSAF.
* Preparing recommendations for aircraft retrofit, recapitalization, sustainment, and disposal.

Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non\-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large\-scale events scene.
   

  





 Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record\-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape \- the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA \- a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East \- the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
   

  





 Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large\-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 This role brings deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making into the Investor and Startup Programme infrastructure. The primary mandate is designing the investment programmes and deal\-making activations that make Gaming event the strongest investment event in the global gaming calendar. The role also flexes across the broader Investor and startup program portfolio, supporting investor programming at other events where sector knowledge and investor relationships add value. The event provides the structure; this person provides the sector depth, does the heavy lifting with the gaming and tech investment community, and raises the bar on investor experience across every event they touch.
   

  





**Gaming Investment Programme**



* Design investment programmes and deal\-making formats for gaming conference that attract international investors, publishers, and funds and set a global standard for capital\-meets\-talent events


* Build and own the gaming investor pipeline from scratch: identify gaming VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks, and accelerator programmes, and conduct targeted outreach.


* Manage the investor application and vetting process verifying fund credentials, investment thesis alignment, and genuine intent to engage with gaming studios and founders.


* Develop the content and format for all gaming investment activations: reverse pitches, hosted buyer programmes, closed\-door investor roundtables, and live deal\-making showcases.


* Work with the B2B Content Producer to ensure the investment content track is credible, current, and attracts the right calibre of participant.


* Design the investor experience end\-to\-end: investor lounge, curated sessions, concierge meetings, and investor\-only programming that delivers a premium environment.


* Own the investor\-side matchmaking process by working with internal teams to ensure match quality and deal relevance are high.


* Manage investor delegate communications, matchmaking logistics, and on\-site facilitation to ensure the programme delivers real outcomes, not just introductions.


* Track and report on investment programme outcomes: deals initiated, capital committed, follow\-up meetings generated.



**Cross\-Portfolio Investor Support**



* Support the investor programme across other Investor \& Startup program portfolio events contributing investor relationships, outreach, and programming input where sector knowledge adds value.


* Contribute to investor outreach campaigns across portfolio events with the marketing and cross\-functional teams.


* Provide investor program cover for senior team members during high\-volume pre\-event and on\-ground periods.


* Curate a balanced, high\-quality investor room for each assigned event, reflecting that event’s sector focus and strategic objectives.


* Programme investor\-focused roundtables, LP introductions, and deal\-flow sessions in collaboration with the special value programmes team.


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date investor records in internal management tools covering fund details, investment thesis, meeting history, and post\-event feedback.


* Track investor programme KPIs across assigned events: investor count, AUM represented, meetings held, investment signals generated, and investor NPS.


* Conduct post\-event investor debriefs, gather feedback, and share improvement recommendations with the program lead.


* Maintain and nurture investor relationships year\-round, ensuring warm relationships carry forward into future editions.


* Develop new ideas for value\-driven investor programme features and lead on concept note development for future editions.


**Qualifications**

  

  




* 4–5 years of experience in investor relations, investor programme management, or VC/LP engagement ideally within an event, ecosystem, or gaming industry context.
* Demonstrated expertise in the gaming investment landscape: VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks. This is the core credential.
* Demonstrable experience curating and managing high\-touch investor experiences, not just registration and logistics, but genuine investor engagement design.
* Strong existing network within the gaming and tech investment community, particularly in MENA, APAC, or Europe.
* Understanding of how the gaming investment chain works from pre\-seed accelerators through to sovereign capital deployment.
* Sector knowledge in cybersecurity, fintech, or other technology verticals is an advantage for cross\-portfolio event support.
* Excellent relationship management skills, able to manage senior investor relationships with professionalism and discretion.
* Comfortable working across multiple simultaneous events with different investors, geographies, and sector focuses.
* Experience with investor management platforms, CRM tools, and event management systems.
* Strong written English is mandatory; Arabic is a meaningful advantage.
* **What You will bring**




 Deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making is the non\-negotiable. Must understand how funding rounds, publishing deals, and M\&A transactions work in gaming and know the regional investors, funds, and studios that matter, particularly across Saudi Arabia and MENA. Comfortable in investor conversations and able to hold their own in a room with fund managers, portfolio directors, and publishing executives. Able to design investor programmes from the ground up that bring international capital to an event and raise the bar on what a gaming investment activation can be. Equally capable of plugging into broader Investor and startup programs across events and adding immediate value through relationships and sector credibility.


**Additional Information**

**Please note this is a 6 month contract role. It can be performed remotely. We are not able to provide relocation or sponsorship support with the position.**




 We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances and base hiring decisions on relevant qualifications and merit. We are proud to provide a disability\-friendly environment. If you require any support or adjustments to participate in our interview or selection processes, please let us know.

data.jd_text:
****Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project, it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up, Qiddiya is calling for you.****
**General Summary**
 The Director of Railway Depot, Rolling Stock, Track and Systems (DRSS) leads the client\-side delivery of this D\&B package and is responsible for the successful planning, integrated design, delivery, testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness of the complete railway system associated with a major new metro railway programme.
   

  

 The role will act as the Owner's lead representative for all Depot, Rollingstock and Systems scope, ensuring that they are coordinated and integrated with the VST package and that the metro system overall is delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with operational, technical, regulatory, and programme requirements.
   

  

 A key challenge of the role is managing complex interfaces between railway systems, civil infrastructure, operational assets, utility providers, government stakeholders, developers, future operators, and contractors within a rapidly developing city where some surrounding infrastructure is operational while other assets remain under design and construction.
   

  

 The DRSS Director works closely with the separate Viaduct, Stations and Tunnels (VST) package to achieve the overall integrated delivery outcome across both packages, and subsequent delivery to the Operator/Maintainer. This includes managing complex design interfaces across packages, regulatory bodies, utility providers and adjacent asset owners.
   

  

 The role also leads, develops, and supports a high\-performing team, setting clear expectations, building capability, and fostering a collaborative culture focused on safety, accountability, and successful project outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead strategy, delivery, and governance for depot facilities, rolling stock, track, and railway systems.
* Oversee design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover of depot infrastructure.
* Manage rolling stock procurement, supplier performance, testing, acceptance, and lifecycle requirements.
* Provide leadership across railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, traction power, E\&M systems, platform screen doors, AFC, cybersecurity, track, and depot systems.
* Ensure systems integration, interface management, configuration control, safety assurance, and regulatory compliance.
* Coordinate interfaces with civil works, utilities, roads, developers, operators, regulators, and third\-party stakeholders.
* Lead testing, commissioning, trial operations, and operational readiness activities to support successful service commencement.
* Support procurement, contract management, technical approvals, change control, claims review, and commercial negotiations.
* Drive risk management, quality assurance, safety culture, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle


**Requirements**
****Qualifications****
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Railway Engineering, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
* Professional Engineering registration or equivalent accreditation.
* Master's degree, Chartered Engineer (CEng), PE, PMP, or similar certification preferred.


****Experience****
* Minimum 20 years of experience in railway, metro, transit, or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Proven client\-side leadership experience on large rail programmes.
* Strong background in depot development, rolling stock delivery, railway systems integration, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary international teams and complex stakeholder interfaces.
* Preferred experience with driverless metro systems, greenfield metro projects, and international railway standards (EN).


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision\-making.
* Railway systems integration, rolling stock engineering, depot operations, safety, and asset management.
* Programme delivery, interface management, risk management, contract administration, and change management.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 Atkins are searching for a Candidate to join our team with experience of managing large\-scale multi\-disciplinary projects within KSA and the GCC Region.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Project Delivery**
* Communicate scope, fee, deliverables and programme with the team through Project Kick\-Offs and regular updates.
* Management of sub\-consultants' agreements and payments (technical management through Design Management function).
* Ensure that the Project Execution Plan addresses design management requirements, including integration and interface management between Client requirements, sub\-consultant design packages.
* Support the PD in production of the Project Management suite of documents and standard forms.
* Assist in risk identification and management.
* Assist PD to identify and manage scope changes, scope extensions.
* Identify resourcing issues and requirements and coordinate these with the Technical Team Leads.
* Escalate to PD when/if required.
* Provide timely external and internal monthly reporting by implementing a planned delivery schedule for routine reporting.
* Ensure Quality Systems processes are adhered to in the delivery of projects.
* Undertake debriefs with Client.
* Assisting in managing the work financially, technically and contractually.


**Financial Management**
* Monitor Design Team progress and costs – Highlight where costs are not tracking as planned and coordinate with the Project Technical Leads to mitigate against potential over\-runs / underspends.
* Have a good understanding of Risk and the need to use their commercial acumen.
* Manage Risks proactively through use of the tools provided and regular team and Client engagement and update Contingency requirements regularly (min. once per design stage).
* Prepare Invoices for review and sign\-off by the Project Director and keep financial registers up to date.
* Drive the change process and be responsible for compilation of variations.


**Client Management**
* Liaise and interact with the client for the technical delivery components of the project.


**About You**
* The candidate is to have a minimum of 8 years experience within the Middle East, with at least 4 years in the role of APM or PM.
* The selected candidate will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects within the UAE and GCC Region. They will be responsible for leading and managing projects within the business. Their primary role is to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet client requirements.
* The selected candidate will work with the Atkins team and Client to establish project objectives, develop project plans, manage project budgets, and oversee project scheduling. They will be responsible for managing the project team, ensuring that team members are completing tasks on time and communication is maintained at all times.
* Other roles also include managing project risk, developing contingency plans and ensuring that health and safety standards are followed in addition to adherence of Atkins' project management methodology requirements.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Tax\-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation \& housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
   

  

**About AtkinsRéalis**
 We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
   

  

 Find out more.

Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **HSE Directo** 
 r to join our team!
   

  

 In this role, you will provide strategic leadership and governance for health, safety, environmental, and sustainability performance across a major airport infrastructure program.
   

  

 You will oversee HSE strategy, regulatory compliance, construction safety, environmental management, incident response, stakeholder coordination, and performance reporting across the full project lifecycle.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Lead the overall HSE strategy, governance framework, policies, procedures, and performance standards for the program.
* Provide leadership and direction to HSE teams across multiple project packages and contractor environments.
* Drive a proactive safety culture across contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aviation, construction safety, environmental, and local authority requirements.
* Manage regulatory audits, inspections, permits, approvals, and authority engagements.
* Oversee construction safety across airfield works, terminals, utilities, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure effective safety controls are in place for high\-risk activities including lifting, excavation, working at height, confined spaces, and live operations.
* Review risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, and contractor HSE performance.
* Oversee environmental compliance, sustainability performance, environmental management plans, and impact mitigation measures.
* Lead investigations into major incidents, near misses, and high\-potential events, ensuring root cause analysis and corrective actions are implemented.
* Act as the primary HSE interface with airport authorities, regulators, clients, consultants, contractors, and senior leadership.
* Support emergency preparedness, crisis management planning, HSE workshops, safety forums, and coordination meetings.
* Establish HSE KPIs, dashboards, reporting systems, audits, inspections, and assurance processes.
* Promote workforce engagement, behavioral safety, induction programs, and continuous improvement in safety culture.


**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Safety Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 25 years of experience in HSE leadership roles across major infrastructure, aviation, airport, or airfield development programs.
* Proven experience within airport, airfield, EPC, PMC, or delivery partner environments.
* Strong background in construction safety management across complex, multidisciplinary projects.
* Deep knowledge of international HSE standards including ICAO, FAA, OSHA, NFPA, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001\.
* Experience managing large HSE teams and multi\-contractor project environments.
* Strong capability in auditing, compliance management, reporting, incident investigation, and corrective action management.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and crisis management skills.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Master’s Degree in Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Chartered status or equivalent HSE professional certification, such as NEBOSH IGC / IDIP, CSP, CIH, or CMIOSH.
* Experience on GCC airport megaprojects or complex aviation infrastructure programs.
* Background in ESG, sustainability reporting, carbon management, FIDIC\-based contracts, and digital HSE systems.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
   

  

 AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work\-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 This is an exciting time to join our growing Middle East Digital and Technology team. You will be able to help evolve our offerings in a number of our core sectors as we are supporting our clients to tackle some of their most complex business problems. You will take an integral role in identifying, shaping and cultivating new opportunities to work with clients, much of the time in close partnership with other areas of the firm.
   

  

 This Director opportunity is a permanent position located in Riyadh and reports to a Partner.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be at home operating at the intersection of business strategy and technology, partnering with corporate C\-suite executives and Private Equity Operating Partners to drive business growth, transformation, and long\-term value creation.
   

  

 We bring a distinctive combination of deep technical expertise and sharp commercial acumen to deliver sustainable impact hands\-on.
   

  

 Examples of our past work include helping some of the world’s best known companies leverage technology to realise their business objectives, working with private equity investors to evolve their company portfolios, and supporting high\-profile turnaround cases.
   

  

 This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
   

  

**What You’ll Need**
* The ideal candidate will have a mixture of 15\+ years, digital consulting and industry experience
* Hands\-on leadership experience from a highly relevant Digital and Technology role in industry, in Saudi Arabia, would be desirable
* Extensive blue chip consulting experience in Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design is essential
* Experience of delivering large and complex Digital transformation and technology execution programmes with multiple workstreams
* Industry experience preferred in Telecom, Retail, Oil \& Gas
* Strong experience in relationship management, proposal development and strong commercial instincts are key. In addition, an ability to generate growing demand for our wider firm capabilities and resources in prospective and existing clients
* Demonstrable ability to understand AI concepts and how they are applied to the technology solutions
* Deep expertise with Technology stack(s), IT Architecture, Technology Operating Model and Organizational Design as well as ERP solutions etc.
* Experience working with clients formulating hypotheses of potential business issues and reasons for financial performance, and an ability to develop data\-driven and analytical approaches for improving performance using Technology
* You will hold valid residency for Saudi Arabia, or be able to obtain such, (administrative support will be provided by AlixPartners to obtain permits); ability to obtain work permit to travel and work across EU
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, Arabic is advantageous
* Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
* Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
* Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation


 Office Location: KAFD, Riyadh
   

  

 Working hours: 8:30am – 5:30pm, Sunday to Thursday, hybrid model

*This advert will be removed once a suitable candidate has been identified.*
*AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer.*

Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the leader for Joby’s future presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, you will build the business from the ground up, establishing the foundational relationships, operating model, and multi\-year strategy needed to launch a safe, compliant, and scalable service. Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 11,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra) team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 A\&M continues to expand in EMEA, and we are looking to recruit a Director \& Senior Director to be based in our Riyadh office. Working with some of the industry's brightest and most experienced colleagues, you will:
   

  

* Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the assigned tasks.
* Conduct meetings and presentations with clients, as well as internal managerial and executive stakeholders, showcasing proficiency and confidence in discussing project matters.
* Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.
* Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in project management and business development, ideally within consulting or related industries.
* 8\+ years experience within public sector large scale projects experience is necessary.
* Arabic language skills is required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of articulating ideas to diverse audiences.
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation.
* Thrives in a high\-energy, fast\-paced, and dynamic culture.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
   

  

 We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

 Culture \& Values
   

  

 At Alvarez \& Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here.
   

  

 Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters
   

  

 Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

**Overview**
 The ITS Director for Fare Collection Systems with a minimum of 12 years senior technical and management experience and a university degree, shall be responsible for the overall management, performance, and integration of the fare collection system of the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) across the Public Transport Network. This includes AFC (Automatic Fare Collection), CCC (Customer Contact Center) and associated systems and interfaces, including integration with external stakeholders such as the Metro Network. He shall ensure that the interfaces between the ITS Contractors and the other project transport operators are efficient and implemented in sufficient time to allow for the smooth operation of the Bus and metro systems. He shall be responsible for all ITS\-related technical deliverables on behalf of the Employer and shall ensure that no scope or responsibility gaps exist across Contractors or systems. He shall be responsible for system performance, revenue management, Central Clearing House, stakeholder reporting, vendor management and compliance with RCRC/contract obligations. The role ensures that all ITS systems operate efficiently, meet contractual KPIs, and support seamless public transport operations across around 1,000 metro and bus stations.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Oversee the performance, reliability of the Fare collection systems including AFC, CCC as well as all integration with AVM and Journey Planning systems.
* Ensure effective interface management between Bus Contractors, ITS Contractors, and external systems and stakeholders such as Metro.
* Monitor system performance and resolve inconsistencies, faults, and integration issues.
* Ensure robust revenue collection and management processes are implemented between the operators and the Client finance department.
* Ensure contractors meet contractual KPIs and performance targets.
* Oversee maintenance, backup, cybersecurity, and data protection practices for all systems.
* Lead vendor and contractor management related to ITS systems.
* Ensure proper implementation of software management best practices and data security requirements.
* Review and approve all technical deliverables submitted by ITS contractors.
* Identify and close any responsibility gaps related to ITS scope.
* Ensure timely implementation of interfaces to support smooth bus operations.
* Lead stakeholder reporting related to ITS performance and compliance.
* Support operational readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Qualification \& Education Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor degree in Engineering, IT, or related field


**Mandatory Experience**
* Minimum 12 years of experience in ITS and transport systems or related fields
* Proven experience in managing large\-scale ITS systems integrations and management of their operations and maintenance
* Experience in contractor and stakeholder management
* Strong understanding of system interfaces, software management, and cybersecurity
* Experience in KPI monitoring and performance management


**Additional Notes**
* Proven ability to lead diverse, multidisciplinary teams and foster a culture of technical excellence.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to manage complex, multi\-contractor environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Full\-time on project site in Riyadh

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Design Director – Utility Compounds is responsible for directing and managing the overall design delivery process for utility compounds (substations, switching/control compounds, utility hubs, and associated buildings and infrastructure). The role is focused on project and process management rather than performing detailed design. It ensures that all design activities are properly planned, coordinated, and controlled so that scope, schedule, cost, quality, and stakeholder requirements are achieved and effectively interfaced with construction, commercial, HSE, and operations objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design Governance \& Process Leadership
* Define and implement the design management strategy, plans, and procedures for utility compound projects and programs.
* Establish the overall design delivery roadmap, including stage gates, key milestones, and approval processes.
* Set up and maintain the design responsibility matrix, clarifying scope boundaries, interfaces, and deliverables for all parties.
* Ensure consistent application of company and client design management standards across all utility compound projects.
* Design Planning, Schedule \& Cost Control
* Develop and own the integrated design schedule in coordination with planning and project controls teams.
* Monitor progress of design deliverables against agreed baselines; identify deviations and lead recovery planning.
* Coordinate with commercial and finance teams to set and manage design budgets, consultancy fees, and internal resource allocations.
* Track and report design productivity, progress curves, and cost versus budget for design activities.
* Multi‑Disciplinary Coordination (Process‑Focused)
* Lead coordination of all design contributors (internal teams and external consultants) across civil, structural, architectural, MEP, power systems, protection \& control, SCADA, and site infrastructure.
* Chair regular design coordination and progress meetings; ensure actions, decisions, and interfaces are clearly recorded and closed.
* Ensure design outputs are aligned with construction sequences, procurement plans, and commissioning strategies.
* Drive alignment between compound designs and external networks (transmission/distribution, access roads, external utilities).
* Design Change \& Risk Management
* Establish and manage a formal design change control process, including impact assessments on scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk.
* Maintain a design risk register; facilitate risk identification, ownership, and mitigation with design and project teams.
* Ensure that approved changes are properly documented, communicated, and incorporated into design deliverables, contracts, and schedules.
* Quality, Compliance \& Assurance (Management Role)
* Ensure that design activities follow agreed review, verification, and approval processes, including peer reviews and stage‑gate approvals led by technical authorities.
* Coordinate technical and constructability reviews, HAZID/HAZOP, operability and maintainability assessments with discipline leads and HSE.
* Oversee compliance with relevant codes, standards, client requirements, and regulatory approvals from a process and documentation standpoint.
* Ensure robust document control for all design deliverables, including revision control, transmittals, and traceability.
* Stakeholder, Client \& Authority Management
* Act as the senior point of contact for all design management matters with the client, utility owners, third‑party stakeholders, and authorities.
* Lead design‑related workshops, presentations, and coordination meetings, clearly articulating status, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate and track responses to client comments, authority review comments, and utility standards requirements.
* Support planning, permitting, and approvals by ensuring timely, coordinated design submissions and responses.
* Digital Engineering \& Information Management
* Oversee implementation of BIM and digital engineering processes in collaboration with BIM managers and design teams.
* Ensure that models, drawings, and data are produced, exchanged, and approved in line with project information management plans and CDE protocols.
* Promote consistent data structures to support downstream construction, commissioning, and asset management needs.
* Interface with Construction, Commercial \& Operations

data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Executive Director \- MMC \& Delivery Learning Systems is responsible for institutionalising innovation and structured learning across the Qiddiya City Programme.
   

  

 The role leads two strategic programme enablers:
   

  

* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) \- to enhance productivity, scalability, quality consistency, safety, and delivery predictability
* Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems \- to reduce systemic repeat failures, accelerate decision\-making, and embed institutional delivery intelligence across Business Units (BUs)


 Operating at programme scale, the role ensures that Qiddiya moves from fragmented project\-based execution toward structured, repeatable, and performance\-driven delivery systems.
   

  

**Strategic Mandate**
* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC)
* Define and steer Qiddiya's MMC ambition, roadmap, and governance framework
* Identify scalable MMC opportunities across asset typologies
* Establish standards, decision pathways, and adoption frameworks to enable BU implementation
* Align with Procurement and Supply Chain to support manufacturing agreements and market feasibility
* Translate pilot outcomes into institutionalised standards and repeatable playbooks
* Monitor measurable impact on cost, schedule, quality, HSE, and sustainability performance


 The role does not replace BU delivery accountability; it enables structured and scalable adoption across the programme.
   

  

**Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems**
* Establish and govern a structured delivery knowledge\-sharing system across the Qiddiya programme
* Institutionalise lessons learned, best practices, and repeatable standards
* Create cross\-BU transparency mechanisms to reduce duplication and rework
* Implement structured feedback loops between Delivery, Logistics, Engineering, Procurement, and Commercial functions
* Embed a culture of constructive transparency, where learning accelerates performance rather than assigning blame


 Knowledge sharing is positioned as a performance accelerator and delivery control mechanism — not documentation.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide executive leadership for MMC and Delivery Learning initiatives in alignment with SDU mandate and TOM
* Translate systemic delivery risks and recurring failure patterns into structured institutional solutions
* Secure executive alignment and approvals for frameworks, governance models, and scaling strategies
* Ensure integration across Delivery, Procurement, Engineering/Design, Logistics, Commercial, and Digital functions
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery predictability, productivity, and cross\-BU coordination


**Success Measures**
**MMC**
* Demonstrable adoption of MMC solutions on eligible assets
* Improved schedule confidence and delivery consistency
* Established supplier/manufacturing pathways supporting scalable adoption
* Measurable performance gains on pilot implementations


**Delivery Learning**
* Reduction in repeat systemic issues and avoidable rework
* Increased cross\-BU coordination and visibility
* Sustained platform adoption and knowledge reuse
* Faster issue resolution cycles across delivery ecosystem


**Stakeholder Environment**
**Internal:**
 SDU Leadership; BU Delivery Directors; CDU/Implementation; Engineering/Design; Procurement \& Supply Chain; Logistics; Commercial/Contracts; Digital/IT; People \& Culture.
   

  

**External:**
 Delivery partners; Tier 1 contractors; modular/offsite manufacturers; technology providers; specialist consultants; supply chain ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Profile Requirements**
 This role requires a senior international development and delivery executive with demonstrated experience leading major programmes or large\-scale master developments.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 18 years' progressive experience in international real estate development, infrastructure, or complex construction environments
* Proven leadership in multi\-asset or giga\-project settings with concurrent project portfolios
* Experience operating in high\-growth, high\-complexity environments (e.g., national transformation or large urban developments)
* Demonstrated exposure to construction innovation, industrialised construction, modular delivery, or transformation initiatives at scale
* Experience engaging senior executive committees and securing approval for strategic frameworks
* Strong understanding of programme governance, stage\-gate processes, and cross\-functional integration
* Track record interfacing with contractors, manufacturers, consultants, and supply chain ecosystems


**Role Positioning Summary**
 This is a programme capability and transformation role designed to:
   

  

* Enable scalable construction innovation (MMC)
* Institutionalise delivery learning across Business Units
* Improve predictability and performance at programme scale


 The Executive Director operates as a strategic enabler — strengthening delivery maturity, governance capability, and structured transparency across the Qiddiya City Programme.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Attractive compensations and benefits package

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) is seeking a highly experienced and design\-literate Executive Director \- Transport Hubs to lead the planning, design management, and delivery of all major transport facilities across the Qiddiya development.
   

  

 This role will have overarching responsibility for a portfolio of complex transport\-related projects, including multimodal stations, interchanges, terminals, and supporting infrastructure that form critical components of the city's mobility network and will becomes pivotal places within the public realm and customer experience for visitors to Qiddiya.
   

  

 The Executive Director will operate at both strategic and delivery levels, setting design direction, overseeing engineering integration, and ensuring safe, timely, and coordinated project execution. This includes building team culture, leading project governance, overseeing multidisciplinary teams, and serving as the key interface between architecture, engineering, transport planning, and construction delivery. The role is expected to balance operational requirements with architectural and public space quality, acting as a connector across design and technical domains.
   

  

 Drawing on a background in both architecture and infrastructure delivery, you will oversee the delivery of high\-profile metro, rail, public transport station and associated public domain programs leading the full asset lifecycle. This includes early\-stage planning and feasibility, through procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
   

  

 The position plays a key leadership role in shaping the future of Qiddiya's transport system, ensuring that hubs and interchanges are not only technically functional but also embedded in the broader civic and urban contexts supporting a seamless, intuitive, and high\-quality customer experience.
   

  

 Define and lead delivery of station and interchange infrastructure across Qiddiya
   

  

 Coordinate integration of transport components (e.g., metro stations, rail platforms, bus terminals, public domain elements) into the urban masterplan with spatial and functional coherence.
   

  

 Manage multi\-disciplinary teams of architects, engineers, transport planners, and contractors through all project phases.
   

  

 Consider the customer experience in all facets of planning, delivery and operations and embed the customer team in all interchange planning
   

  

 Consider phased delivery over time and the possible need for interim measures to be in place as surrounding precinct assets are progressively opened.
   

  

 Collaborate across all districts of Qiddiya and understand district needs, land use mix, customer access needs, peak and normal visitation flows and the mobility solutions that lead to success.
   

  

 Balance architectural quality, structural performance, accessibility, and passenger flow in design and execution.
   

  

 Establish divisional design standards, procurement strategies, and technical governance.
   

  

 Oversee connectivity across modes—rail, metro, road, autonomous vehicles, cycling, and pedestrian networks.
   

  

 Lead program\-level oversight on cost, risk, schedule, quality, and safety
   

  

 Coordinate with government, regulators, infrastructure partners for approvals and compliance
   

  

 Advise executive leadership on strategic phasing, prioritization, and operational readiness.
   

  

 Engage with government agencies, regulatory bodies, and delivery partners to secure approvals and maintain compliance.
   

  

 Ensure technical performance, spatial quality, accessibility, and user experience are appropriately balanced in all transport\-related assets.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-disciplinary teams and interface between design ambition and technical delivery.
   

  

 Proven experience leading complex projects blending both transport infrastructure with civic\-scaled public domain, place making, activation and customer experience outcomes.
   

  

 Familiarity with project governance, stakeholder engagement, and regulatory coordination.
   

  

 Strong collaborator and proven ability to build quality internal team and external stakeholder relationships.
   

  

 Ability to balance program\-wide oversight with attention to project\-level design, functionality, and constructability.
   

  

 Effective communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 18 years of experience leading complex transport\-related projects, including significant public transport buildings or interchanges.
   

  

 Degree in Architecture (preferred) or Engineering postgraduate qualification preferred.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Competitive salary and attractive benefits package

Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.

Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery

**Job Summary**
 The Preparatory Year Program (PYP) at Prince Sultan University is inviting
 **qualified candidates (priority is for Saudi candidates)** 
 to apply for the following faculty positions for the 2025\-2026 Academic Year, Second Semester:
   

  

* PYP \- Math LECTURER (Male)


**Applicants Are Expected To**
* have a Bachelor's and Master's degree in the relevant field.
* have earned a degree from an accredited university and completed it on\-site as a full\-time student.
* have experience teaching in higher education.
* be proficient in English (As all teaching and advising are in English, an excellent standard of spoken and written English is required.
* have very good interpersonal skills.
* use information technology effectively.
* be willing to make valuable contributions to the program, departmental committees, and workshops/seminars/scholarly/student activities.
* teach 16\-20 contact hours per semester.


 Applicants should submit a cover letter, CV, Bachelor's and Master's Certificates, transcripts, and the names of two references. Review of applications will begin immediately, and applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.
   

  

**Notes**
* The Program will only contact candidates who qualify for an interview.
* Incomplete applications (i.e., missing documents) will not be considered.


**About The Preparatory Year Program (pyp)**
 The Preparatory Year Program is a vibrant, energetic, one\-year program that bridges the gap between high school and higher education. In the PYP, students develop the numerical, linguistic, digital, practical, and study skills necessary to succeed at the college level as required by academic discipline. On a daily basis, students engage with a diverse group of highly experienced and enthusiastic faculty members and administrative staff. During the one\-year program, PYP students are encouraged to immerse themselves in a range of academic and extracurricular activities in a supportive and collaborative learning environment.
   

  

**Salary And Benefits**
 The University is continuously expanding, and its campus is located in north\-central Riyadh.
   

  

* We offer a one\-year renewable contract (renewable subject to Dean/Director and student evaluations) and a competitive salary package based on academic qualification, rank, and teaching experience as stated above.
* Other benefits include: medical insurance coverage for the employee \& dependents residing within the Kingdom, (spouse \& 4 children below 24 years of age);
* Transport allowance;
* Round\-trip tickets (maximum 4: employee, spouse, and 2 children below 18 years of age) for annual leave with paid annual (summer) vacation of two (2\) months, plus 2 local paid holidays of about 15 days each (as applicable);
* Tuition fees of up to 30,000 Saudi Riyals for children attending school within the Kingdom. Details will be specified in the contract.
* Free, furnished accommodation plus essential utilities and maintenance will be provided, subject to availability, OR the successful candidate will be provided a housing allowance based on academic rank.
* End\-of\-service yearly gratuity, which starts on the 2nd year of continuous service (if the candidate has completed a minimum of 2 years).


**About Prince Sultan University**
 Prince Sultan University is the first private university in Saudi Arabia that emphasizes excellence in teaching, research and community services. It is also the first private university to have been awarded ACCREDITATION by the NCAAA (National Commission for Assessment \& Academic Accreditation). Further, it is the youngest university to have achieved such a milestone.
   

  

**Required**

* Computer and Information Systems

* Engineering

* Architecture and Interior Design

**Email:** 
*pyprecruitment\_cvs@psu.edu.sa*
