To manage, monitor and oversee all mechanical engineering\-related matters for the Company's development projects during the design, construction, and testing \& commissioning phases. Provide consultation and support for mechanical engineering\-related matters once the project is transitioned as an operating property.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





 Manages, supervises, and controls all mechanical engineering\-related matters in the projects under development by the Company throughout their lifecycle, including, but not limited to the following:
 


* Understand the Company’s business case, policies, and procedures.
* Gathers and provides technical and financial information required by the Company for competitions or opportunities it intends to participate .
* Assists in reviewing, analysing, and recommend companies suitable to design and/or execute, and supervise electric works.
* Prepares the mechanical engineering requirements and documentations necessary for issuing TORs, RFQs and/or RFPs to entities selected by the company.
* Studies and review the proposals submitted by the contractors / consultants invited by the company for the development of its projects and provide technical and financial feedback.
* Prepares all mechanical engineering\-related input required for the project management plan, charter, budget, and/or master schedule.
* Conducts the necessary reviews and provided technical comments on the design documents during all design stages (concept, schematic, developed and detailed design).
* Follows up the design consultant to ensure obtaining all necessary approvals are obtained from MEW and other relevant local authorities for the mechanical engineering loads and design standards for all project systems.
* Reviews IFC documents and ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and the requirements of relevant local authorities.
* Ensures proper coordination between mechanical engineering works and all other disciplines to avoid scope conflicts.
* Administers the supervision process for mechanical engineering works in progress on site and ensure its compliance with the contract documents.
* Monitors the progress of mechanical engineering works on site and ensure that execution is in line with the approved schedule.
* Attends technical coordination and progress meetings with stakeholders and provide technical
* support and feedback on project works.
* Prepares all necessary periodic reports related to mechanical engineering works on ongoing projects.
* Reviews and provide technical evaluation of proposed MEP sub\-contractors for the Project.
* Reviews and provide technical feedback on proposed mechanical engineering materials, equipment, and/or mock\-ups submitted by the contractor.
* Reviews the interim payments for the contractors and provide technical and financial comments regarding the percent completion of mechanical engineering works and entitlement of the contractor to the claimed amounts.
* Studies the contractors’ claims and provide technical and financial comments on the percentage completion of mechanical engineering works and contractor’s entitlement to the claimed amounts. • Assists in preparation of change orders for mechanical engineering works.
* Monitors and follow up with the consultant the testing and commissioning procedures and ensure compliance with the contractual requirements.
* Conducts the necessary coordination with the supervision consultant for managing the close out procedures and ensure fulfilment of all contractual requirements in relation to the mechanical engineering works.
* Reviews mechanical engineering related section in the handover status reports at the completion of the projects’ works for release of final payment or necessary deductions as applicable. Contract Administration
* Prepares prequalification documents, issue, evaluate and make a recommendation to the management on the construction contractors.
* Prepares the project Terms of Reference/Tenders, including contract documents, specifications, and drawings, where applicable, for the Client/Management to invite bids from the pre\-qualified construction contractors.
* Responds to queries, resolves issues, and conducts the evaluation of submittals where applicable.
* Analyzes submitted tenders in terms of their technical, financial, and contractual packages and makes recommendations to the management.
* Provides technical consultation upon request for operational facilities.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
* Masters degree in mechanical engineering is an added advantage.
* Strong English language skills (written and spoken). Arabic is preferred
* 10 – 20 years of relevant experience.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description** 




 About the Role:
 



 BÖWE is an award\-winning architecture and design firm seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Project Engineer Fit\-Out to join our team in Kuwait.
 



 This role is ideal for candidates currently residing in Kuwait with a valid transferable residency and with around 5 years of experience in construction, interior fit\-out, site supervision, and project coordination.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day site activities, coordinating with contractors, suppliers, consultants, and internal design teams, while ensuring that all works are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, project timelines, and client requirements.
 



  





**Project \& Technical Skills:** 



* Strong experience in site supervision for interior fit\-out and construction projects.
* Good knowledge of construction methods, finishing works, materials, and site execution standards.
* Ability to read and understand architectural drawings, shop drawings, reflected ceiling plans, joinery details, MEP coordination drawings, and technical specifications.
* Experience in coordinating fit\-out works including civil, gypsum, flooring, painting, joinery, glass, metal, MEP, lighting, and finishing works.
* Ability to monitor site progress, manpower, materials, subcontractors, and daily work activities.
* Strong understanding of quality control, site safety, project timelines, and work sequencing.
* Ability to identify site issues, technical conflicts, delays, and coordination problems, and report them clearly to the Project Manager.
* Good communication skills with contractors, suppliers, consultants, clients, and internal departments.
* Strong reporting, documentation, and follow\-up skills.








**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Supervise day\-to\-day site activities and ensure works are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Review drawings, shop drawings, technical details, and site instructions before execution.
* Monitor site progress and ensure works are completed according to the approved project schedule.
* Check quality of materials, workmanship, installation, and finishing works on site.
* Ensure that all fit\-out works are aligned with approved design, client requirements, and BÖWE quality standards.
* Coordinate with MEP teams to avoid conflicts between architectural, electrical, mechanical, and plumbing works.
* Prepare daily site reports, progress updates, material requests, and work status reports.
* Follow up on material delivery, subcontractor attendance, manpower allocation, and site requirements.
* Identify site obstacles, delays, technical issues, and variation items, and report them to the Project Manager.
* Attend site meetings and coordinate required actions with all related parties.
* Ensure compliance with safety requirements and maintain proper site organization.
* Support project handover activities, snagging, rectification works, and final inspections.
* Maintain accurate site documentation, including approvals, inspection records, progress photos, and site correspondence.








**Key Competencies:** 



* Strong site supervision and coordination skills.
* Good technical understanding of fit\-out and construction works.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage site priorities.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Strong communication and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and subcontractors.
* Professional attitude with client\-facing communication ability.
* Organized approach to reporting, documentation, and site control.



  





**Required Software Skills:** 



* AutoCAD
* Microsoft Office Suite: Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* Microsoft Project is an advantage
* Revit knowledge is an advantage
* Project reporting and documentation tools








**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 



* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.
* 5 years of proven experience in site engineering, project engineering, fit\-out supervision, or construction site coordination.
* Strong experience in interior fit\-out, finishing works, and construction execution.
* Good knowledge of materials, shop drawings, site measurements, and installation standards.
* Ability to read and coordinate architectural, civil, and MEP drawings.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and progress monitoring skills.
* Ability to manage subcontractors, suppliers, manpower, and site activities.
* Excellent communication skills in English. Arabic is an advantage.
* Valid transferable Kuwait residency is required.
* Candidates currently based in Kuwait are preferred.
* Immediate joining or short notice availability is preferred.



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 If you are a detail\-oriented Site Engineer / Project Engineer with around 5 years of proven experience in construction fit\-out, interior fit\-out, site supervision, project coordination, and finishing works, we would be delighted to review your application.
 



 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 



  





 Please send your CV to:
 



 mz@bowe.me
 



 Please include the subject line: “Site Engineer – Fit\-Out – Kuwait”

**وصف الشركة** 




 شركة
 **YOUSEF ALKOOT DESIGN \& BUILD** 
 هي شركة متخصصة في التصميم والتنفيذ مقرها الكويت. نركز على تقديم حلول إنشائية وهندسية مبتكرة وعالية الجودة. يلتزم فريقنا بتحقيق التميز في جميع المشاريع، مع ضمان رضا العملاء وتقديم أفضل النتائج. وبفضل خبرتنا في مجالي التصميم والبناء، نخدم مجموعة متنوعة من المشاريع والعملاء.
 







  





**الوصف الوظيفي** 




 تعلن الشركة عن توفر وظيفة
 **مهندس مدني** 
 بدوام كامل للعمل في موقع المشروع في مدينة الكويت.
 



 سيكون مهندس المدني مسؤولاً عن مراجعة المخططات الهندسيه المعماريه و الانشائيه والإشراف على المشاريع الهندسية المدنية، ومتابعة جداول الكميات (BOQ) وشهادات الدفعات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد ومتابعة عروض الأسعار. كما تشمل المهام التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق، وضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة، وتقديم الحلول الفنية أثناء تنفيذ المشاريع.
 







  





**المؤهلات المطلوبة** 



* إجادة الهندسي المدنيه والتمتع بأساس قوي في مبادئ الهندسة المدنية.
* خبرة عملية مثبتة في مشاريع التشطيبات الفاخرة (High\-End Finishing).
* خبرة في التخطيط وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية.
* إجادة استخدام البرامج التالية:
* Primavera
* AutoCAD
* Revit
* Microsoft Office
* معرفة جيدة بالممارسات والمعايير الهندسية المدنية والقدرة على إدارة المشاريع.
* مهارات قوية في حل المشكلات والتحليل والتنظيم.
* درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو تخصص ذي صلة.
* الشهادات المهنية والعضويات المهنية ذات الصلة تعتبر ميزة إضافية.
* خبرة لا تقل عن  من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في المجال.



**نوع الوظيفة:** 
 دوام كامل
 



**مكان العمل:** 
 الكويت (في موقع العمل)
 



  
 



**مهندس مدني (Civil Engineer)** 




**عن الشركة** 




 تُعد شركة يوسف الكوت للتجارة العامة والمقاولات إحدى الشركات الكويتية الرائدة في مجال التصميم والبناء والتنفيذ، حيث تقدم حلولاً هندسية وإنشائية متكاملة وفق أعلى معايير الجودة والاحترافية. نلتزم بتقديم مشاريع متميزة تحقق تطلعات عملائنا من خلال الابتكار، الدقة، والعمل بروح الفريق.
 



**المسمى الوظيفي** 




 مهندس مدني (خبرة من سنتين إلى خمس سنوات)
 



**موقع العمل** 




 الكويت – موقع المقر الشركة و مواقع المشاريع
 



**الوصف الوظيفي** 




 نسعى إلى استقطاب مهندس مدني طموح ومتميز للانضمام إلى فريقنا، يتمتع بخبرة عملية في إدارة وتنفيذ المشاريع وأعمال التشطيبات، وقادر على متابعة الأعمال الفنية والإدارية بكفاءة عالية، والمساهمة في تحقيق مستهدفات المشاريع ضمن الجداول الزمنية المعتمدة.
 



**المسؤوليات الرئيسية** 



* مراجعة واعتماد المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية والتأكد من توافقها مع متطلبات المشروع.
* الإشراف المباشر على أعمال التنفيذ بالموقع ومراقبة جودة الأعمال وفق المواصفات المعتمدة.
* إعداد ومراجعة جداول الكميات (BOQ) وحصر الأعمال والكميات المنفذة.
* إعداد ومتابعة شهادات الدفعات والمستخلصات للمقاولين والموردين.
* إعداد طلبات التسعير وعروض الأسعار الفنية والمالية ومقارنتها وتحليلها.
* إعداد وتحديث خطط العمل والجداول الزمنية ومتابعة نسب الإنجاز الفعلية للمشاريع.
* إعداد التقارير الدورية الخاصة بسير العمل ورفعها للإدارة.
* متابعة الأعمال من خلال الأنظمة الإلكترونية وبرامج إدارة المشاريع وإعداد التقارير الفنية.
* التنسيق مع فرق التصميم والتنفيذ والموردين والاستشاريين لضمان سير المشروع بكفاءة.
* المساهمة في حل المشكلات الفنية وإيجاد الحلول الهندسية المناسبة أثناء التنفيذ.
* تطبيق معايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية والالتزام باللوائح والأنظمة المعتمدة.
* العمل بروح الفريق والمساهمة في تطوير الأداء وتحقيق أهداف الشركة والمشاريع.



**المؤهلات والمتطلبات** 



* درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية.
* خبرة عملية من (2 – 5\) سنوات في مجال الإنشاءات والتشطيبات.

* AutoCAD

* القدرة على قراءة وتحليل المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية.
* مهارات قوية في التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة الوقت.
* مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والمتابعة الفنية والإدارية.
* القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة الأولويات بكفاءة.
* مهارات تواصل عالية والعمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات.
* عضوية جمعية المهندسين الكويتية أو إمكانية اعتمادها تعتبر ميزة إضافية.



**المهارات السلوكية المطلوبة** 



* روح المبادرة وتحمل المسؤولية.
* الالتزام والجودة والدقة في التنفيذ.

* القدرة على قيادة فرق العمل والتنسيق بين مختلف الأطراف.



**ما نقدمه** 



* بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة.

* المشاركة في مشاريع متميزة ومتنوعة.
* مسار وظيفي واضح للنمو والتقدم المهني.



 إذا كنت ترى في نفسك الكفاءة والطموح للانضمام إلى فريق عمل احترافي يسعى للتميز والإنجاز، نتطلع لاستقبال طلبك.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one.
 



 We are hiring a Project Manager to run the internal programme. This is the person who owns the plan, the budget, the risk log, and the delivery team. The Programme Director holds overall accountability and is principally focused externally. The Project Manager runs everything inside.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Owning the integrated delivery plan across design, build, test, operational readiness, and regulatory submission readiness; driving it relentlessly
* Sequencing work across technology, operations, risk, data, corporate services, and the build vendor; identifying dependencies and blockers early and resolving or escalating fast
* Owning the Build CAPEX and OPEX budgets; tracking actual against forecast and bringing options, not just problems, to the Programme Director
* Chairing the weekly delivery forum and programme risk forum; running the programme governance rhythm from daily stand\-ups through to quarterly board updates
* Setting and upholding the quality bar at each stage gate across the programme
* Line managing the Programme Office Executive, Business Analysts, Test Manager, and testing team
* Providing candid, evidenced delivery reporting to the Programme Director and board



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in programme or project management, with a minimum of seven years running large technology and operational change programmes in financial services. Direct, demonstrable experience personally leading a programme of comparable scale and complexity from a standing start: this is non\-negotiable. Domain credibility in financial market infrastructure (CSD, CCP, exchange, or payment system) or capital markets platform delivery; able to speak the language of settlement, custody, clearing, and post\-trade fluently. A track record of delivering against fixed regulatory or external deadlines. Recognised qualification: PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or equivalent. Fluent in English.
 



 Experience working with global system integrators or major financial services build vendors is an advantage. So is familiarity with CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures and Arabic language skills.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The post\-holder must be able to walk into rooms with vendors, regulators, advisors, and senior stakeholders and command respect from day one. Authority here comes from competence and credibility, not title. If you have genuinely led a regulated platform build of comparable weight from a standing start, and you have the drive and composure to do it again in a fast\-moving greenfield environment, this is worth a conversation.

 The Integrated Gas Company (IGC) was established in December 2022 to manage all allocations, assets, rights, and obligations related to the purchase, sale, import, export, and transportation of natural gas and related products on behalf of the government of the Sultanate of Oman. IGC’s mandate is to enhance the efficiency of the gas sector by overseeing contract performance with both producers and end users. The company develops and implements gas allocation strategies that align with government policies on gas pricing and quantities assigned to various sectors. By selling gas to gas\-based projects and related activities, IGC seeks to expand economic activity and maximize in\-country value from the gas sector. The organization offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in strategic energy sector development and public value creation.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Lead long\-term planning, pricing analysis, and sector studies by providing strategic direction and oversight of gas supply and demand planning, infrastructure development, and resource allocation. Ensure effective risk management, stakeholder alignment, and compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices to support national objectives.

* Lead long\-term gas supply and demand planning, pricing analysis, and strategic gas sector studies.

* Monitor market trends, competition, and organisational performance to identify opportunities and risks.

* Lead gas pricing analysis, including pricing formulas, market forecasts, and scenario development.

**Gas Sector Strategic Studies** 



* Lead gas sector studies, infrastructure expansion planning, and maintenance program reviews.
* Oversee integrated gas sector planning, ensuring alignment with government strategies and stakeholder requirements.
* Identify, evaluate, and coordinate strategic value\-creation initiatives across the gas sector.
* Assess energy transition impacts on gas supply and demand and support long\-term sector planning.

* Unit: Internal Audit
* Division: CAE
* Location: HQ


**Grade:** 
 L2
   

  

**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s in accounting /finance /business or related subjects. CIA certification is a must.
* Professional certification including CA, CPA, ACCA, CISA, will be highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 8 years of total experience \& at least 3 years in a managerial position.


**Key Accountabilities**
 Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program
   

  

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program (QAIP), develop and implement necessary quality assessment methodology, models, tools, etc.

* Facilitate external quality assessments.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement of audit quality.


 Performance Management

* Support performance evaluation processes in coordination with audit leadership.
* Provide insights to CAE on productivity, utilization, and capability development.


 Risk Based Internal Audit Plan
   

  

* Coordinate development of the annual risk\-based internal audit plan after consolidating inputs from Business Units, Internal Audit teams, second line functions and Senior Management and Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise risks, regulatory requirements, and strategic priorities and recommend adjustments in the plan where necessary.
* Monitor performance and delivery of audit engagement against the plan and produce MIS.


 Internal Audit Strategy
   

  

* Support the CAE in developing and monitoring of Internal Audit Strategy, initiatives and roadmap.
* Coordinate and where necessary implement strategic initiatives.


 Standardization \& Operational excellence
   

  

* Custodianship of IA manual and ensures IAU activities are in compliance with regulatory and Global IA standards.
* Continuously review, enhance, and update Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, and processes to ensure alignment with best practices and drive operational excellence.
* Standardize audit approaches, templates, tools, and reporting formats across the function.
* Benchmark audit practices against leading industry standards and peers.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices across the function.


 Continuous Audit \& Digital Enablement
   

  

* Ensure the smooth delivery of continuous audit engagements and where possible coordinate to embed the output in the planned audit engagements.
* Enable and support audit teams through data analytics and automation.

* Promote adoption of data\-driven auditing and digital tools across Internal Audit.


 Audit \& Risk Committee \& Executive Management Reporting
   

  

* Prepare and submit to CAE monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual MIS and other lAU performance related reports, including follow up / findings dashboard, internal quality assessment reports, state of lA report, etc.
* Assist CAE in preparation and administration of BAC Meetings.
* Provide insights on audit plan status, Key findings and themes, open findings, risk exposures and trends.
* Support CAE in presentation materials and stakeholder communications.
* Prepare and coordinate delivery of various awareness sessions on GRC \& Ethics.


 Follow\-Up Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate follow up and validation efforts to ensure timely closure and update of findings status.
* Centralize tracking of Internal Audit findings and management action plans.
* Monitor and report status of overdue and high\-risk issues.
* Escalate critical matters to CAE and senior management.


 Whistleblower Program \& Investigations
   

  

* Manage and coordinate investigations under the Whistleblower Program.
* Ensure investigations are conducted objectively, confidentially, and in line with policies.
* Coordinate with Legal, HR, and Compliance where required.
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and closure of cases.


 Resource Management /Audit Pool Administration
   

  

* Manage the centralized Internal Audit resource pool (\~20 staff). Schedule Audit engagements and serve as a focal point for consolidating individual engagement level assessment and leave management of the pool staff.
* Allocate resources to audit teams (GMs/SMs) based on audit priorities, skill requirements, capacity and utilization
* Oversee scheduling, utilization, and workforce planning.
* Manage administrative aspects including ERP\-related matters, timesheets, and coordination.


 Subsidiaries Audit Management \& Contract Governance
   

  

* Manage procurement and onboarding of outsourcing vendors for Internal Audit of unlisted subsidiaries in line with governance requirements.
* Coordinate closely with the appointed external audit service providers, Management of subsidiaries and respective GM Internal Audit to effectively plan, execute, and monitor audit activities across subsidiaries.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one
 



  





 We are hiring a Regulatory and Risk Lead to head the second line of defence. The role is accountable for the enterprise risk framework, regulatory relationship and compliance, financial crime prevention, and oversight of information security. The intention is that the post\-holder progresses into the Head of Risk and Compliance role in the Run phase.
 



  





 The first\-line functions own the day\-to\-day execution and the controls that surround it. The Regulatory and Risk Lead independently reviews, challenges, and reports on that first\-line execution; sets the policy and framework standards within which it must operate; and owns the relationship with the regulator across all matters except specific operational regulatory reporting. The post\-holder must be willing and able to challenge their peers, including those above them, without flinching, and to escalate to the Board where necessary.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the enterprise risk framework from a blank sheet: risk taxonomy, risk appetite, risk tolerances, key risk indicators, governance, and reporting
* Owning the day\-to\-day relationship with the regulator on all compliance and supervisory matters; leading the response to inspections and supervisory enquiries
* Owning the regulatory engagement plan: notifications, periodic submissions, supervisory meetings, thematic reviews, and ad hoc requests
* Providing second\-line oversight of adherence to CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures; leading engagement with PFMI assessors and international supervisory bodies
* Designing and owning the financial crime framework: AML, counter\-terrorism financing, sanctions, and anti\-bribery and corruption; discharging or designating MLRO accountability
* Setting the information security policy framework and providing second\-line oversight of first\-line information security; owning regulator\-facing reporting on cyber matters
* Owning the policy framework: structure, hierarchy, ownership, review cycles, and attestation
* Providing independent second\-line reporting to the Board Risk Committee on risk, compliance, financial crime, and information security
* Line managing the Cybersecurity and Information Security Manager, KYC/Compliance Expert, and wider Risk and Compliance team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in risk, compliance, or regulatory roles in financial services, with substantial time in a second\-line capacity at a regulated firm. Direct, demonstrable experience as the second\-line risk and compliance owner, or a senior member of the second\-line function, at a
 



 financial market infrastructure, custody bank, exchange, payment system, or major regulated financial institution: this is non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Direct experience engaging with a senior financial\-services regulator on licensing, supervisory matters, inspections, and policy development. Working knowledge of CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures. Direct experience designing and operating an AML and financial crime framework, including MLRO accountability or close support of an MLRO. Track record of independently challenging first\-line decisions and escalating to Board level where necessary. Fluent in English.
 



  





 A professional qualification (ICA Diploma, CISI, ACAMS, or equivalent) is an advantage. So is familiarity with the IFC Oman regulatory framework, direct experience in a CSD, CCP, or exchange, and Arabic language skills.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The second\-line function does not exist yet. The risk framework has not been written, the compliance monitoring plan has not been set, and the regulatory relationship is in its earliest stages. The person who takes this role will build all of it and carry it through licensing and into operation. If you are unquestionably credible with senior regulators, have the independence to challenge upward when the evidence demands it, and want to build a second\-line function at a regulated FMI from a blank sheet, this is worth a conversation.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is being built from scratch, to go\-live in 2027, and is designed to operate as a regulated financial market infrastructure from day one.
 



  





 We are hiring a Head of Product Technology to own the technology platform end\-to\-end: the application and the infrastructure on which it runs. This is not background plumbing. The application is the product. The infrastructure is the foundation on which settlement finality, system resilience, latency performance, and operational availability are delivered. The post\-holder must understand both layers as one integrated whole and own them as one.
 



  





 In Build, the post\-holder is the architect of the platform from a blank sheet: technology reference architecture, infrastructure topology, hosting strategy, network and database design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and disaster\-recovery architecture. In Run, the same person operates the platform and the team they have designed. This is not a sit\-in\-your\-office role.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the technology reference architecture from a blank sheet: application architecture, infrastructure topology, database platform, network design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and DR architecture
* Owning the application end\-to\-end: design, configuration, integration, data model, change management, and support
* Owning the infrastructure that hosts the platform: compute, storage, network, virtualisation, database, and middleware, whether on\-premise, hosted, or cloud
* Owning platform resilience: high availability design, backup and recovery architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and tested failover
* Owning end\-to\-end platform performance including transaction latency, capacity planning, and headroom strategy
* Owning first\-line platform security: secure configuration, hardening, identity and access management, vulnerability management, patching, and security incident response
* Owning the technical relationship with the build vendor; holding them to account on functional, technical, and operational delivery
* Designing the human operating model for the platform: team shape, shift patterns, on\-call rotations, incident command structure, runbooks, and third\-party support arrangements
* Owning all integrations between the platform and external systems: custodians, settlement banks, exchange, SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ISIN infrastructure
* Line managing the Application Managers, Database Administrator, and the wider platform engineering team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in financial\-services platform technology, with substantial time spent owning a mission\-critical platform end\-to\-end across both application and infrastructure layers. Direct, demonstrable experience architecting a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet: this is non\-negotiable. Direct, demonstrable experience as the technical authority on a CSD, custody platform, post\-trade platform, capital markets platform, or core banking system of comparable mission\-criticality: also non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Hands\-on technical credibility across both application and infrastructure layers: able to read code, query a database, design a network topology, debug an integration, and challenge a vendor's technical decisions with authority. Demonstrated experience holding a major build vendor or system integrator to account on technical delivery. Deep understanding of how a regulated financial\-services business works, not just the technology underneath it. Fluent in English.
 



  





 Experience in financial market infrastructure (CSD, CCP, exchange, or payment system) is an advantage. So is familiarity with CPMI\-IOSCO principles and experience designing SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ICSD integrations.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The platform does not exist yet. The architecture has not been designed, the infrastructure has not been built, and the operating model has not been written. The person who takes this role will have done all of it. If you have genuinely architected and owned a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet, and you have the hands\-on credibility and delivery drive to do it again, this is worth a conversation.

If you are unquestionably expert in CSD and post\-trade design, have personally led a build of comparable weight, and want to own a product from a blank sheet, this is worth a conversation.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Company Description:** 




 The Integrated Gas Company (IGC) was established in December 2022 to manage all allocations, assets, rights, and obligations related to the purchase, sale, import, export, and transportation of natural gas and related products on behalf of the Government of the Sultanate of Oman. IGC’s mission is to raise the efficiency of gas sector management and ensure that contract terms with producers and consumers are applied effectively. The company develops and implements gas allocation strategies, including policies on gas selling prices and quantities across sectors. By doing so, IGC seeks to expand economic activity and increase in\-country value within the gas sector and its related industries, positioning itself as a key enabler of Oman’s energy and economic objectives.
 



  





**Role Description:** 
  
 



 The Contracts Principal manages high\-value and complex contracts, focusing on the entire lifecycle of NGSAs, GPAs, and GSAs. This role is responsible for negotiating terms, mitigating risks, and ensuring compliance, while also supporting auctioning, tendering, and spot sales activities.
 



  





**Tasks and Responsibilities:** 




**Contract Negotiation and Commercial Management** 



* Lead negotiation, drafting, execution, and management of NGSAs, GPAs, GSAs, transportation agreements, amendments, and related contracts.
* Negotiate gas pricing, Take\-or\-Pay, liabilities, force majeure, Energy Transition requirements, and ICV commitments.
* Assess buyers' acceptance of revised terms and optimize contracts to maximize revenue and mitigate risk.
* Support gas pricing and market development strategies aligned with national energy policies.



**Gas Allocation and Commercial Evaluation** 



* Evaluate gas allocation requests using approved models and frameworks.
* Recommend allocations based on economic value, strategic priorities, gas availability, and policy requirements.
* Coordinate gas availability with Planning and support portfolio optimization through allocation prioritization, contract flexibility, and capacity utilization.
* Monitor energy transition trends, emerging markets, and regulatory changes impacting commercial strategies.



**Approvals, Governance, and Compliance** 



* Ensure agreements comply with legal, regulatory, governance, and company requirements.
* Secure required approvals before contract execution and allocation commitments.
* Issue allocation decisions, contract awards, and executed agreements.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and regulatory obligations throughout the contract lifecycle.



**Contract Renewal and Performance Management** 



* Manage NGSA renewals and renegotiations through an 18\-month rolling outlook.
* Review extension requests and secure contractual assurances, including Bank Guarantees (BGs), where required.
* Monitor contract performance, compliance, and milestones to enhance commercial outcomes.



**Auctioning, Tendering, and Spot Sales** 



* Support surplus gas commercialization through spot sales, auctions, and tenders.
* Lead RFP preparation, commercial evaluations, award recommendations, and contract execution.
* Manage tender processes and stakeholder engagement to ensure transparency, compliance, and revenue maximization.
* Identify opportunities to optimize gas utilization through the release of unused capacity.



**Risk Management, Disputes, and Claims** 



* Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, contractual, and operational risks.
* Incorporate contractual safeguards and risk mitigation measures into agreements.
* Manage disputes, claims, contract interpretation, and settlement negotiations.
* Support resolution of payment disputes, guarantees, non\-receivables, and recovery actions.



**Stakeholder Management and Reporting** 



* Manage relationships with buyers, producers, regulators, government entities, and internal stakeholders.
* Prepare commercial evaluations, reports, recommendations, and presentations for management and governance committees.
* Provide commercial advice on contracts, gas allocation, and market developments.
* Support Omanization through coaching, capability development, and succession planning for Omani commercial professionals.



**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in business, Law, or a related field; advanced degree or certification preferred.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in commercial, contracts, gas marketing, business development, or contract management roles within the energy sector.
* Strong negotiation, risk management, and leadership skills.
* Economic and Business Development Downstream knowledge/ experience is required
* Understanding of the Oman Gas Value Chain
* Experience in stakeholder management and presentations to Executive Leadership
* Working experience leading end\-to\-end processes related with Long Contract Management \& Negotiations



  





**Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted.** 




**This is a 4 Year Contract** 




**Application Deadline: 28 June 2026**

**Purpose/ Mission:**

data.jd_text:
**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The HSE \& Process Safety Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), and Process Safety activities throughout the DRI Plant lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC), Commissioning, Start\-up, and Operations.
   

  

 The role ensures full compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and international best practices while establishing a strong safety culture and safeguarding personnel, assets, the environment, and business continuity. The position plays a critical role in managing construction safety risks, process safety hazards, and operational excellence within a high\-hazard industrial environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* **HSE Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and implement the overall HSE strategy for the DRI Plant project and operational phases.
* Establish HSE objectives, targets, KPIs, and improvement programs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, permits, corporate requirements, and international standards.
* Promote a Zero Harm culture across employees, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Provide HSE leadership to project, operations, maintenance, engineering, and contractor teams.
* **Construction HSE Management**
* Lead all HSE activities during site preparation, civil works, structural erection, mechanical installation, piping, refractory works, electrical and instrumentation construction.
* Review contractor HSE plans, risk assessments, method statements, and mobilization requirements.
* Monitor contractor compliance with project HSE requirements.
* Oversee high\-risk construction activities including:
+ Working at heights
+ Heavy lifting and crane operations
+ Confined space entry
+ Hot work
+ Excavation activities
+ Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS)
+ Electrical isolation

* Conduct HSE audits, inspections, and contractor performance evaluations.
* Drive proactive hazard identification and intervention programs.
* **Commissioning \& Start\-up Safety**
* Develop and implement commissioning and start\-up HSE programs.
* Ensure safe introduction of energy, process gases, utilities, and raw materials into the facility.
* Lead Pre\-Start\-up Safety Reviews (PSSR).
* Verify readiness of emergency systems, fire protection systems, gas detection systems, and critical safety barriers.
* Participate in commissioning risk assessments and operational readiness reviews.
* Ensure safe execution of plant start\-up activities.
* **Process Safety Management (PSM)**
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive Process Safety Management system.
* Lead hazard identification and risk assessment studies including:
+ HAZID
+ HAZOP
+ LOPA
+ Bow\-Tie Analysis
+ What\-if Studies

* Manage Management of Change (MOC) processes.
* Ensure integrity of Safety Critical Equipment and Safety Instrumented Systems.
* Support Asset Integrity and Mechanical Integrity programs.
* Lead investigations of process safety incidents and near misses.


 Special focus areas include:
   

  

* Natural gas systems
* Hydrogen\-rich reducing gas systems
* Reformer operations
* Reduction furnace operations
* High\-temperature process equipment
* Dust explosion prevention
* Fire and explosion risk management
* **Operational HSE Management**
* Lead HSE programs during plant operation.
* Ensure implementation of:
+ Permit to Work (PTW)
+ Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO)
+ Confined Space Entry
+ Working at Height
+ Hot Work Control
+ Contractor Safety Management

* Conduct routine HSE audits and workplace inspections.
* Monitor occupational health and industrial hygiene programs.
* Ensure emergency preparedness and response capability.
* **Environmental Management**
* Manage environmental compliance programs.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee:
+ Air emissions monitoring
+ Dust control systems
+ Wastewater management
+ Hazardous waste management
+ Resource efficiency programs

* Lead initiatives related to sustainability, decarbonization, and environmental performance improvement.
* **Incident Investigation \& Risk Management**
* Lead investigations of injuries, property damage, environmental incidents, and process safety events.
* Conduct root cause analysis using recognized methodologies.
* Develop and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain site risk registers and risk mitigation plans.
* **Emergency Response \& Crisis Management**
* Establish site emergency response systems.
* Lead emergency preparedness planning.
* Conduct drills for:
+ Fire and explosion scenarios
+ Gas release incidents
+ Hydrogen leaks
+ Confined space rescue
+ Medical emergencies

* Coordinate with external emergency response agencies and authorities.
* **Team Leadership**
* Build and lead the HSE organization for both project and operational phases.
* Develop HSE competencies throughout the workforce.
* Coach managers and supervisors in safety leadership and risk management.
* Support workforce engagement and behavioral safety initiatives.
* Support the Oman Project Director in all relevant tasks where requested.


**Requirements/ Skills/ Experience:**
* Experience in at least one of the following industries:
+ DRI / Ironmaking
+ Steel Manufacturing
+ Petrochemical
+ Refinery
+ LNG
+ Oil \& Gas
+ Power Generation

* Experience supporting EPC construction projects and operational facilities.
* Experience in commissioning and start\-up of industrial plants is highly preferred.


**Required Education/ Qualification/ Training:**
* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Occupational Health \& Safety, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 10 years of HSE experience in heavy industrial environments.
* Minimum 5 years in a management role.
* NEBOSH International Diploma
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




 The Integrated Gas Company (IGC) was established in December 2022 to manage all allocations, assets, rights, and obligations related to the purchase, sale, import, export, and transportation of natural gas and related products on behalf of the government of the Sultanate of Oman. IGC’s mandate is to enhance the efficiency of the gas sector by overseeing contract performance with both producers and end users. The company develops and implements gas allocation strategies that align with government policies on gas pricing and quantities assigned to various sectors. By selling gas to gas\-based projects and related activities, IGC seeks to expand economic activity and maximize in\-country value from the gas sector. The organization offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in strategic energy sector development and public value creation.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Finance Principal serves as a critical control and value protection function, acting as the backbone of financial discipline, governance, risk management, and strategic decision support within IGC. The role provides independent financial oversight, strengthens accountability and controls, and supports executive decision making to drive sustainable value creation.
 



  
 



**Tasks and Responsibilities:** 



* Lead financial governance, internal controls, risk management, and compliance frameworks across the organisation.
* Evaluate and oversee complex commercial agreements, pricing structures, and contractual risk exposures to protect and enhance business value.
* Act as a strategic finance partner to the CFO, CEO, and Board, providing financial insights, challenge, and decision support.
* Drive finance transformation initiatives, including reporting excellence, process optimisation, ERP systems, and performance management.
* Lead, develop, and mentor high\-performing finance teams, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Manage key relationships with shareholders, regulators, auditors, government entities, and executive stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and governance at all levels.
* Strong expertise in treasury, liquidity, funding, and cash flow management.
* Proven experience in enterprise risk management, hedging, and FX/interest rate risk management.
* Advanced financial modelling, valuation, and commercial analysis capabilities.
* Extensive experience in budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
* Strong track record in performance management, KPI development, and driving value creation through data\-driven decision\-making.



  
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting skills, including scenario analysis and long\-term financial modeling.
* Expertise in financial analysis, valuation, and performance measurement, ideally with exposure to energy or commodity markets.
* Solid knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and internal controls; experience working with auditors and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency with financial systems and tools (e.g., advanced Excel, ERP systems, business intelligence or reporting tools).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and quantitative skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing reports and presentations for senior leadership and boards.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with commercial, operational, and policy teams, and to manage multiple priorities under tight timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; a relevant professional qualification (e.g., CFA, CPA, ACCA) or a master’s degree is preferred.
* Significant experience in a Senior Finance Role



  





**Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted** 




**This is a 4 Year Contract** 




**Application Deadline: 28 June 2026**

data.jd_text:
The Manager / Senior Manager – Portfolio \& Asset Management will support the execution of Asyad Group’s portfolio management function. The role will focus on driving asset\-level performance visibility, detailed financial and operational analysis, value creation planning, turnaround support, and capital efficiency across Asyad’s portfolio companies and strategic investments.
 



 The role requires a strong analytical profile, preferably with significant Financial Due Diligence experience, and the ability to work closely with business units, finance teams, operating companies and senior management to identify performance gaps, challenge assumptions, and support value creation initiatives.
 



  





**Performance Monitoring \& Business Plan Review** 



* Monitor performance against budget across revenue, EBITDA, cash flow and capex, and flag key risks and variances.
* Prepare monthly/ quarterly structured asset review packs and performance dashboards for management and board reporting.
* Identify early warning signals and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and challenge annual business plans, budgets and forecasts submitted by portfolio companies.
* Validate key assumptions and assess alignment with strategy and value creation objectives.
* Evaluate capex plans and expected returns to support capital allocation decisions.



  





**Financial Analysis** 



* Perform detailed analysis of financial performance, covering revenue, margins, cost structure, working capital, cash generation and capital efficiency.
* Assess sustainability of earnings and identify key performance gaps and drivers.
* Build and maintain asset\-level financial models to support performance tracking and decision making.



  





**Value Creation \& Turnaround** 



* Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities across growth, cost optimization, asset utilization and cash improvement.
* Support turnaround of underperforming assets through structured action plans and performance tracking.
* Quantify impact of initiatives and monitor delivery against targets.



**Governance \& Shareholder Oversight** 



* Prepare shareholder materials, portfolio reviews and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
* Track board resolutions, shareholder actions and key governance matters across portfolio companies.
* Identify governance, reporting and control gaps and escalate where required.



**Capital \& Strategic Support** 



* Assess capital structure, funding requirements, returns and capital efficiency across assets.
* Support follow\-on investments, restructuring initiatives and divestment analysis.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level capital allocation and strategic review discussions



  





**Skills** 



* Hands\-on and analytical with strong FDD and financial analysis capability.
* Ability to challenge numbers, assumptions and business plans.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to convert detailed analysis into clear management recommendations.
* Commercial judgment and ability to link operational drivers to financial performance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business units and portfolio companies.
* High attention to detail and ability to work with incomplete or inconsistent data.
* Clear written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate independently and manage multiple assets/workstreams.



 English language is mandatory. Fluent in Arabic preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related field.
* Professional qualification preferred: CPA, ACCA, CFA, ACA or equivalent.
* MBA or advanced finance qualification is an advantage.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Financial Due Diligence / Transaction Services, private equity, portfolio management or corporate finance.
* Strong experience in financial analysis, business performance review and working with management accounts.
* Demonstrable strong financial modelling experience.
* Extensive knowledge of financial accounting concepts and corporate finance.

data.raw_snippet: We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia
data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences.  The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.

 The incumbent will lead multi\-disciplinary squads, shape the digital roadmap, and drive the evolution of our business banking platforms (web, mobile, API, and partner integrations). **1\. Digital Strategy \& Channel Ownership** 



* Define and lead the end\-to\-end digital strategy for Business Banking across mobile, web, API, and ecosystem channels.

**2\. Customer Acquisition, Journeys \& Experience** 



* Own the full customer lifecycle across digital onboarding, activation, servicing, and cross\-sell touchpoints.

**7\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.

* Strong understanding of data analytics, customer experience design, and agile delivery models.
* Exposure to API banking, embedded finance, BaaS, or ecosystem integrations is a strong advantage.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals.  Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 280\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




 Dubai Holding is currently seeking a
 **Senior Manager – Digital Services** 
 , reporting to the Director – Infrastructure Operations. The role holder is responsible for the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of the organisation's web platform ecosystem, spanning a portfolio of 100\+ digital properties, enterprise API integrations, cloud\-hosted web applications, and internal business automation solutions.
 



 The role holds end\-to\-end ownership of web platform operations across the organisation, orchestrating the combined capabilities of internal development teams, strategic third\-party vendors, and emerging technologies to deliver secure, performant, and accessible digital experiences at scale.
 



 A core contributor to the group\-wide digital strategy and technology roadmap, the role plays an integral role in shaping and executing the direction of the organization's web platform function — ensuring all solutions and initiatives are grounded in sound architectural principles, aligned to security, compliance, and governance requirements, and structured to deliver tangible business value.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Define and own the organization's web platform architecture strategy, ensuring all digital solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives.
* Act as the senior solution architect across all web development initiatives, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical delivery.
* Oversee the full lifecycle management of web platform components, from planning, procurement, and development through to deployment and decommissioning, operating within defined budgets, risk appetites, and compliance frameworks.
* Take executive ownership of the availability, stability, performance, and compliance of all web platform services — including 100\+ Web flow\-managed digital properties, Azure\-hosted web applications, and associated integration services — ensuring they remain fit for purpose and aligned with agreed service levels.
* Drive a proactive performance culture across the function, ensuring continuous monitoring, technical SEO and AEO optimization, analytics configuration, and resolution of platform issues before they impact the business or end\-user experience.
* Provide 24/7 senior operational oversight for the digital portfolio, serving as the escalation point for critical incidents and urgent business requests, and applying deep technical expertise to rapidly coordinate resolution and minimize business impact.
* Serve as the organization's senior authority on web security and data protection, owning compliance with information security standards, proactively monitoring for vulnerabilities, and driving the implementation of security improvements across the entire digital portfolio.
* Champion rigorous standards for web accessibility, ensuring all digital properties meet WCAG compliance requirements, and embedding accessibility principles from design inception through to production delivery.
* Own and govern the organization's cookies consent framework across 100\+ digital properties, overseeing technical implementation, monitoring ongoing compliance, and managing the strategic relationship with the cookies consent solution vendor.
* Ensure all web platform solutions adhere to data protection, information security, and accessibility standards — embedding required principles and design patterns from inception through to delivery.
* Design, build, and steward enterprise\-grade API integrations — including Salesforce and custom microservices — applying best practices in REST API design, security, and documentation to ensure robust, maintainable, and scalable integration architecture.
* Lead the evaluation, onboarding, and governance of SaaS solutions and enterprise platforms — including enterprise contract and license management, user access management, and vendor relationships — ensuring all tools are adopted effectively and deliver measurable value.
* Manage and evolve the organization's internal Power Platform capability, overseeing the design and delivery of automation flows and applications.
* Develop and manage the web platform and digital operations budget in excess of $1M, balancing cost efficiency with operational excellence, and continuously identifying opportunities for financial optimization without compromising service quality or delivery capability.
* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with business, commercial, and marketing stakeholders, acting as a trusted technical consultant on new digital initiatives and providing expert guidance on platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary digital team — comprising web developers, operations manager, and microservices developer — setting clear direction, providing meaningful performance feedback, and creating pathways for professional growth and career development.

* Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ownership within the team, encouraging experimentation with emerging technologies while maintaining delivery discipline and quality standards.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Proven experience in enterprise web platform management, digital operations, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 8 years in a leadership role overseeing multi\-stakeholder digital environments.
 



  





**Education / Professional Certifications**

data.jd_text:
We’re KFC, an iconic brand serving world\-famous finger lickin’ good fried chicken since 1952\. With more than 28,000 restaurants across 150 countries and territories, our people and culture are at the heart of everything we do—creating an environment where individuals can be their best selves, make a difference, and have fun. Our KFC Global division, based in Dallas, TX, supports regional teams, franchise partners, and nearly one million team members worldwide. With a hybrid work environment and strong cross\-functional collaboration, we work together to share the joy of great\-tasting chicken across the globe. As part of Yum! Brands, we also collaborate with leading brands like Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and Habit Burger \& Grill.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to drive innovation and growth at KFC MENAPAKT FZ\-LLC. As the E\-Commerce \& Loyalty Director, you will own and lead the loyalty and e\-commerce agenda, setting the vision and strategy for a bold transformation. With a focus on loyalty, CRM, personalization, and owned digital channels, you will turn loyalty into a profit engine and a key differentiator for the brand. This role requires a data\-driven, fast\-paced leader who can navigate complexity and inspire high\-performing teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This is a unique leadership opportunity to build the loyalty and ecommerce agenda at a brand poised for bold transformation. As Ecommerce \& Loyalty Director, you will set the strategy and standard for loyalty, CRM, personalization, and owned digital channels (app, web, kiosk). You shape how the brand builds long\-term customer relationships through engagement, recognition, and behavioral design—making loyalty a genuine competitive differentiator rather than a cost of doing business. You will steer a high\-performing team of specialists while collaborating with cross\-functional partners, franchisees, and global stakeholders.
   

  

 This role calls for a loyalty leader who drives decisions with data, operates at speed, and thrives in complexity. You are not just a programme manager; you are an architect of customer relationships. You bring deep loyalty and personalization expertise, a strong grasp of technology, and comfort in ambiguity. Success requires more than individual excellence—the ability to inspire high\-performing teams, influence stakeholders, and lead cross\-functionally with clarity, confidence, and impact.
   

  

***Define and Lead the Loyalty Strategy (25%)***
 Own the loyalty strategy end to end and set the vision for customer engagement and commercial growth. Establish a unified loyalty framework that scales across markets. Act as the subject\-matter expert on loyalty, driving best practice in acquisition, activation, and retention. Bring a forward\-looking view on programme design—gamification, progression\-based engagement, and applied behavioural economics—to keep the programme distinctive and hard to replicate.
   

  

***Secure Franchisee Buy\-In \& Loyalty Adoption (20%)***
 This role sets the strategy; franchisees execute. The core skill is influence—turning loyalty strategy into a commercial case compelling enough that franchisees choose to adopt and fund it. Build the business case (incremental sales, frequency, retention, ROI, and funding model) and win franchisee investment market by market. Govern adoption, alignment on programme economics and data\-sharing, and consistent execution across markets. Enable franchise partners through capability\-building, loyalty playbooks, and transformation workshops—empowering them to run the programme well.
   

  

***Drive Ecommerce \& Owned Channel Growth (20%)***
 Define and lead the unified digital commerce vision across web, app, drive\-thru, and kiosk for a seamless, connected, and profitable customer journey, with franchisees executing in market. Make the app the single front door for ordering, payment, and loyalty. Tailor strategy by market maturity—from foundational enablement to advanced orchestration—ensuring omnichannel consistency, growth, and platform innovation. Set the UX, merchandising, and conversion standards that drive customer acquisition, penetration, basket, and repeat through owned channels. Set the direction for digital marketing and media that drives qualified traffic and acquisition into owned channels, with a test\-and\-learn discipline to optimize conversion. Strengthen the value of direct, owned channels as the primary route to acquire and retain the customer.
   

  

***Set the Personalization \& Lifecycle Strategy (15%)***
 Define the personalization strategy and the segmentation and lifecycle framework—onboarding, activation, frequency, win\-back—that markets and franchisees execute against. Set the standard for how customer data drives one\-to\-one engagement at scale, and hold the discipline that value comes from campaign and merchandiser execution exploiting the data, not the model alone. Guide markets on best practice and evolve loyalty from points math to emotional brand connection.
   

  

***Set the Platform, Data \& Measurement Direction (15%)***
 Set the reference architecture for the loyalty platform and the identity layer that gives a single customer view across app, web, kiosk, and delivery—franchisees build, this role sets the standards, feature direction, and the principles of scalability and modularity. Set the standard for the Martech and data stack that powers loyalty and personalization—CDP, decisioning, and CRM—and the direction for a cookie less, privacy\-centric future. Set a unified measurement framework—penetration, active engagement, frequency uplift, LTV, and ROI—and run regular performance reviews with markets to protect quality and programme impact.
   

  

***Lead the Team \& Align Stakeholders (5%)***
 Build and inspire a high\-performing team and agency partners across loyalty, CRM, personalization, and analytics. Partner with Marketing, Technology, Operations, and Finance to ensure the loyalty agenda delivers both brand and business value. Localize global strategy for market fit, and align markets to the global loyalty roadmap.
   

  

**Specialized /Technical Knowledge/Skills And Other Relevant Requirements**
***Strategic Vision \& Leadership***
* Deep loyalty expertise with a proven track record of scaling best\-in\-class loyalty programmes in large organisations—optimising for penetration, active engagement, frequency, and retention.
* Strong command of personalization and CRM—segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and decisioning—with the ability to architect scalable strategies from foundational enablement to advanced one\-to\-one engagement.
* Forward\-looking on loyalty design—gamification, progression\-based engagement, and applied behavioural economics—with a track record of making programmes distinctive and hard to replicate.


***Technology \& Martech Expertise***
* Strong understanding of the Martech and analytics ecosystem, including tools such as GA360, CDPs, Adobe Experience Cloud, Firebase—able to guide platform strategy and partner with technical experts for deployment and optimization.
* Well\-versed in performance marketing disciplines (SEM, SEO, Paid Media, App Marketing) with the ability to guide teams and agencies on strategy, execution standards, and KPIs.
* Able to evaluate and align Martech ecosystems across CRM, loyalty, media, and automation tools—ensuring interoperability, scalability, and business relevance.
* Fully capable of orchestrating cross\-functional teams, agencies, and vendors to deploy best\-in\-class digital and Martech solutions at scale.


***Data \& Analytics Leadership***
* Strong command of data strategy—including customer segmentation models (RFM, CLV), predictive analytics (churn, frequency), and behavioral insights—to inform decision\-making.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear strategic direction, ensuring the right metrics, dashboards, and insights are in place to measure what matters.
* Experienced in overseeing the development of enterprise\-wide reporting frameworks and real\-time dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Big Query)—in partnership with analytics leads and BI teams.
* Leads with a data\-first mindset—championing test\-and\-learn culture, performance optimization, and closed\-loop measurement across digital programs.


***Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management***
* Charismatic communicator and presenter with strong executive presence.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, agency partners, and franchisees across diverse markets.
* Skilled at influencing senior stakeholders, aligning on priorities, and presenting complex results in clear, actionable narrative formats.
* Able to lead through ambiguity with a solution\-first mindset and an agile, iterative approach.


***Soft Skills \& Personal Attributes***
* Visionary yet grounded, able to balance strategic foresight with day\-to\-day execution.
* Collaborative leader with a strong sense of accountability, values, and adaptability.
* Thrives in high\-performance, multi\-project environments with excellent attention to detail.
* Culturally intelligent and effective in multi\-market, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Fluent in English (Arabic is a plus).


***Qualification \& Prior experience***
* 12\+ years of progressive leadership in loyalty, CRM, or digital commerce roles, preferably in QSR, retail, or FMCG.
* Tertiary qualification in Marketing, Business, or Technology; MBA or postgraduate studies preferred.
* Proven track record scaling loyalty programmes that deliver measurable customer and commercial impact across multi\-unit franchise or regional markets.
* Proven experience operating across culturally diverse, multi\-market environments—ideally with exposure to franchise\-led or decentralized business models.
* Demonstrated ability to grow within a single organization or lead transformation across multiple business units.
* Comfortable bridging the gap between technical teams and commercial stakeholders, from franchise operators to C\-level executives.
